#354. Crimson Desert PC specs don't keep resolution and framerate targets a secret, and they don't use upscaling for everything either

📅 11 Mar 2026

Crimson Desert PC specs don't keep resolution and framerate targets a secret, and they don't use upscaling for everything either

Tanggal: 11 Mar 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/crimson-desert-pc-mac-console-specs-settings-presets

Finally, a PC specification list that actually indicates resolution and framerate targets, and doesn't leave console players behind.

Berdasarkan laporan, crimson desert is a little over one week away from release, and developer pearl abyss has delivered the official, final list of specs for the game. The twist is that the specs not only include useful information for PC players, they also cover similarly relevant details for console players, who traditionally don’t get mentioned in those reveals.

The specs are decently detailed, but more surprisingly - except for a single instance - they don’t include upscaling on PC, another thing games have gotten too comfortable using, even with their lowest specs.

Sebagaimana diketahui, on the official crimson desert website, developer pearl abyss has delivered a chunky post breaking down five different sets of pc requirements for the upcoming open-world action rpg. Each set indicates the graphics preset being used - and crucially, the resolution and framerate targets you can expect with each.

Sebagaimana diketahui, with the exception of the minimum spec, all other presets do not appear to rely on upscaling of any kind. They do not say, however, whether ray tracing is being used with any of them, which is a feature that will throw all of those specs out of whack.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that same transparency also extends to non-pc platforms, which traditionally get few, if any, details about their own resolution and framerate targets. The console set of specs are extensive, just like PC, covering both PlayStation, and Xbox.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it’s granular enough to indicate which upscaling tech is being used, where applicable. This is relevant for owners of a PS5 Pro, a console that has access to Sony’s PSSR upscaling, alongside the standard AMD FSR tech the base console - and Xbox - use.

The developer has also revealed the base resolution for each mode across each console, and the resolution the image will be upscaled to using whichever tech is being utilised.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and, if you’re one of the five people who play games on mac, you’ll be thrilled to know that the specs also include a section for mac devices, split between the different mac chips. The quality preset being used with each is not clear, however.

Finally, there's a set of specs for the Rog Xbox Ally, covering both the X and S models.

#356. Saving Mass Effect would take $200m+, says BioWare co-founder

Saving Mass Effect would take $200m+, says BioWare co-founder

Tanggal: 08 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/mass-effect-5-save-cost-200m-bioware-co-founder-trent-oster

Anyone hoping to buy Mass Effect from EA and finish what BioWare started needs to get saving now, as it could cost over $200 million (£150m).

That's according to BioWare co-founder Trent Oster, who reckons that's what a new Mass Effect game would need to meet fans' expectations.

"The scary component of Mass Effect is the audience is going to want the best of 'AAA' development," Oster said on Twitter/X, as spotted by GamesRadar.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the scary component of mass effect is the audience is going to want the best of “aaa” development. Rough ballpark (based on contemporaries) is $200M+. That is a big number to commit up front. There has to be a bigger plan in place for the IP to make the math work.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "rough ballpark (based on contemporaries) is $200m+. There has to be a bigger plan in place for the IP to make the math work. That is a big number to commit up front. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, he did add that it could be done for less, though. "That said, I think it can be done well for less than that amount with a disciplined approach and an experienced team," Oster said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "i think a game could be done cheaper, if you kept it simple and hit the big beats," he added in a separate tweet. The big push would be getting the IP free. "It wouldn’t be what the team described in the Universe concept. The fans deserve more than one game. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa i think a game could be done cheaper, if you kept it simple and hit the big beats. It wouldn’t be what the team described in the Universe concept. The big push would be getting the IP free. The fans deserve more than one game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, oster's comments come as the #savemasseffect campaign continues to grow following ea's decision to close bioware and cancel mass effect 5. Fans want EA to keep making Mass Effect games, or hand the series over to a studio that will.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, oster has backed the campaign too. "I think there is a still a great thesis for a well-funded RPG developer who can deliver. "I love seeing all the energy around #SaveMassEffect," he wrote on 4th November. Makes me want to get some of the original band back together. ".

EA has not confirmed whether or not it would consider selling the IP.

Diungkapkan bahwa the petition created to save bioware's well-loved sci-fi rpg, mass effect, topped 185,000 signatures in just days. It's now exceeded 317,000. Joe Smith, credited with starting the petition, isn't necessarily asking EA to change its mind about BioWare; instead, the petition calls for "decisive action by committing to the continued development of Mass Effect".

Berdasarkan laporan, we said a sad farewell to bioware last month. The closure, which came just months after Saudi Arabia's $55bn leveraged buyout of EA, was anticipated by experts, but drew widespread condemnation and messages of sympathy from across the industry.

Berdasarkan laporan, a new report claims ea closed bioware because it was forced to choose between investing in one of two sci-fi projects: a new mass effect game or a new star wars battlefront game. And it chose the latter.

Diungkapkan bahwa fans are trying other routes to keep bioware's doors open, too. Canadian fans of the studio have escalated their grievances to the governmental level, calling on the Canadian Government to step in and save the studio from closure, seemingly after Canada's New Democratic Party leader Avi Lewis called on the government to do so.

"Something's really possible" - Mass Effect cast rally around efforts to save the franchise on the first N7 Day after BioWare's closure.

"Is there any accountability left in this world?" Warren Spector pops off at EA executives and their massive payouts as BioWare shuts down.

A teenager who went missing in Utah more than 17 months ago has been rescued from a home in Oregon after she got in touch with another young player in Among Us.

According to a federal criminal complaint reported by Newsweek and KUTV (via IGN), the girl, who was 15 when she disappeared from Garden City, Utah, on 29th May 2025, began chatting with another teenager in Among Us on or around 15th October this year.

Berdasarkan laporan, the pair later moved their conversation to a different social media app, where she told them who she was and that she was being held against her will in oregon. She had been given a phone with no cellular data, which meant she could only get online via wi-fi.

Diungkapkan bahwa the other teen told their parent, who contacted the fbi on 1st november. Agents listened in on a video call between the parent and the girl, and she was recovered from the house later that day. She is now 17.

Adam Hunter Harmel, 39, of Huntington, Oregon, was arrested during a traffic stop.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, according to the us attorney's office for the district of utah, he allegedly met the girl online in may 2025, then drove to utah to pick her up and took her back to his home across state lines. He was charged on 2nd November with transportation with intent to engage in criminal sexual activity, and made his first court appearance in Boise, Idaho, on 4th November.

Diungkapkan bahwa "our priority in this case was the safe return of the minor victim," said us attorney melissa holyoak. "Those who allegedly exploit and prey upon the most vulnerable members of our communities will be relentlessly investigated and held accountable. ".

Utah's US Attorney's Office stresses that a complaint is merely an allegation, and that all defendants are presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

#364. Nioh 3 patch finally makes summons useful in boss fights, brings free armour for everyone

Nioh 3 patch finally makes summons useful in boss fights, brings free armour for everyone

Tanggal: 10 Mar 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/nioh-3-patch-1-04-all-details

There's a new Nioh 3 patch out in the wild, and it's one that any player who regularly summons in boss fights will really appreciate.

Diungkapkan bahwa team ninja continues to work on nioh 3. The developer has been releasing regular updates for the action RPG since its launch in early February. Earlier patches have addressed major bugs like healing item use inconsistencies, and more have arrived since to tackle various balance and loot-related issues.

Diungkapkan bahwa today’s patch, version 1. 04, is a major one, coming in at well over 1GB. There’s plenty here worth getting excited about, so let’s dig in.

Sebagaimana diketahui, to begin with, this is the patch that adds the promised free armour sets for both ninja, and samurai. When Nioh 3 reached one million sales, Team Ninja said it would gift every player the Thunderous set in celebration, and the set’s two variants are now available in-game.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the more interesting side of the patch is, unsurprisingly, its change log. There appears to be a focus on online co-op and AI summons in this one, with various tweaks to the make the process more rewarding, and, in some cases, worthwhile.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the amount of glory obtained when you complete a mission in multiplayer has been increased, regardless of which player was the host. The other major change mainly affects AI Benevolent Grave summons, making it so bosses will no longer target a single player for almost the entirety of the fight.

While summoning AI helpers has always been useful in Nioh 3, they didn’t always help in boss fights, specifically because the boss tended to focus on the player who summoned them, leaving the AI to run around eating AoE hits before dying.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, patch 1. 04 makes a couple of welcome gameplay tweaks to the feel of combat. Ninjutsu, and Onmyo Magic will now hit their targets more consistently in situations where there’s a difference in elevation between the player and the enemy.

Berdasarkan laporan, in the same vein, you’ll now be able to attack (quick/strong) right after jumping, which removes the pause that previously buffered the attack instead. This could mean even more air combos that don’t specifically require Martial Arts.

Diungkapkan bahwa you can look forward to a couple of quality of life tweaks in this patch, too, such as the change that allows the game to automatically send any sudama soul cores dropped by merchants to your item box. This happens from the second one onwards, which means you won’t have to pick half a dozen each time you go to sell a batch of items.

Berdasarkan laporan, speaking of the item box, the limit of forging materials has been increased for some of them. If you’ve been running Battle Scroll missions and Expeditions for gear, you’ll be happy to know that you can now exit the session from the main menu directly.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there’s plenty more to patch 1. 04, including fixes and balance tweaks for several weapons, such as Samurai dual swords, odachi, and more for a few Ninja weapons, too. The patch also brings several bug fixes to the game.

📅 07 Nov 2026

Echoes of Mirror's Edge, Dishonored and a dream set in Italy I once had can be found in Boars in Rome, an expressive parkour platformer set in dystopian Rome

Tanggal: 07 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/echoes-of-mirrors-edge-dishonored-and-a-dream-set-in-italy-i-once-had-can-be-found-in-boars-in-rome-an-expressive-parkour-platformer-set-in-dystopian-rome

Diungkapkan bahwa years ago, i had this dream where i was parkouring through a greatly sunken version of venice, no doubt sourced from the many hours i put into assassin's creed 2 as a teen who should have been studying for their gcses a lot more than they were. It's stuck with me after all this time mostly because of how much I wanted to capture that feeling again somehow, as the real Assassin's Creed didn't quite cut it. And lo and behold, there I was today browsing Bluesky when I came across Boars in Rome, a Mirror's Edge and Counter Strike Surf inspired parkour platformer set in a dystopian version of Rome.

Diungkapkan bahwa truthfully, witnessing the clip i've shared below was baffling to me. Earth has been abandoned," explains the game's Steam page. "This is what I dreamt of!" More or less, anyway, for the setting isn't quite the same; "You have been selected to start a new life off planet. "Machines keep working and nature claims what remains. Find out what happened while you were frozen in time by exploring the remnants of Rome where historical monuments mix with futurist megastructures. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, mirrors edge x counter strike surf where you parkour on anything! be smooth n stylish in dystopian rome. Or just jump around and explore, whatever works for you. It's called Boars in Rome! #PitchYaGame[image or embed].

Diungkapkan bahwa not all of it matches that dream of mine, some of it leans much more into brutalism than the typical, much older architecture you'd expect of rome, but it's there nonetheless. There is so much more control over the game's avatar than what my real body is capable of, or wants to do. You can run, jump, slide and wallrun, positioning it quite closely to VHOLUME mechanically. In motion, Boars in Rome feels quite oneiric too. Where it differs is in its additives, movement tech like being able to swing on lampposts or vault over low down obstacles.

Berdasarkan laporan, vholume is more of a game about providing you with a simple toolkit and leaving you to push it to its maximum. The levels you can romp around are linear, you have an end point to reach, only the journey is up to you. Boars in Roam is a touch more expressive, and I'd dare to even call it an immersive sim. It certainly feels appropriate to put it in the im sim camp given that, at least the game's first level, calls to mind Viktor Antonov's work on Dishonored (and Half-Life 2, too, honestly).

As it currently stands, there's no release date for Boars in Rome, but there is a playtest you can sign up and gain immediate access to if you fancy a go yourself; you can do so on Steam right here, or at least pop it a wishlist.

Diungkapkan bahwa stat sheets like this one are always fun, showcasing how exactly the larger community picked their way through zero company and where they stumbled. For a black sheep like Zero Company, which came out of nowhere between other big-budget Star Wars titles, it swung far above its weight class, giving the larger gaming space tactics they haven’t played with since the last XCOM title.

With a genre so focused on how its myriad mechanics intertwine, it’s up to the developers to give every kind of player the tools they could want.

#371. Marathon launch player numbers are about half those of the Server Slam, at least on PC

📅 06 Mar 2026

Marathon launch player numbers are about half those of the Server Slam, at least on PC

Tanggal: 06 Mar 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/marathon-launch-day-steam-player-numbers-server-slam

Marathon hasn't quite been able to attract the same volume of players the recent Server Slam did.

Sebagaimana diketahui, after a couple of delays, a plagiarism lawsuit, and at least one internal reboot, bungie’s next big game has officially launched. Marathon, the extraction shooter from the studio behind Destiny, has managed to find a decent, if a little small of an audience.

The game’s player numbers on Steam are being compared to its recent free, open weekend, and not in a favourable manner.

Prior to Marathon’s launch, Bungie held a multi-day Server Slam, which offered anyone interested in playing the game a chance to try out almost all of its classes, two of its maps, as well as many of its gameplay and progression systems.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the open test was largely well-received, and players actually showed up for it. It peaked at a very respectable 143,621 concurrent players on Steam, which put it within striking distance of the peak concurrent of its chief competitor, Arc Raiders - at least when you compare both of their pre-launch Server Slam events.

Berdasarkan laporan, in arc raiders’ case, those figures were far outpaced at the game’s actual launch, and the embark shooter continues to command a very active player base to this day. A paid product garnering far more players than the same product’s own free sampler is never not a good sign, so many hoped something similar would happen with Marathon.

Diungkapkan bahwa marathon has now officially launched, and it doesn’t look like it managed to pull an arc raiders - at least so far. At its peak, the Bungie shooter attracted 88,337 concurrent players on Steam (via SteamDB), which is a little over half of its Server Slam’s 143,621 peak concurrent.

Berdasarkan laporan, numbers have, of course, dropped since then, which is normal, as players log off for the night. This is obviously not the end of the road for Marathon. Friday, and the weekend, may well push numbers closer to the Server Slam heights.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, indeed, word of mouth is quite positive, with the game currently sitting at a very positive user review rating on steam, based on over 4,600 reviews. As has been proven time and time again in recent years, nothing catapults a game like players emphatically advocating for it to their friends, so it could simply be that mainstream players are cautious.

It will become clear where things settle over the weekend.

The towns are then partially procedurally generated as they get built up, slowly connecting to other nearby towns. You are not zooming into a single town - you are zooming out to see a whole county come to life. " A big part of the strategy comes down to how you navigate the map; finding resource deposits, picking appropriate terrain profiles, utilising rivers efficiently, finding a good climate, setting good trade routes, it's all about working with the land you've got.

Berdasarkan laporan, each settlement will produce different things depending on the materials available to them in close proximity, meaning each one has a unique function. You've got different types of characters to consider too: mayors, noble houses and cultures, all intersecting with different elements of how a town functions. Seems like a unique approach to city building! And as mentioned, it's out in early access; you can pick it up on Steam here.

#375. The Switch 2 Pro Controller Can Make Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Even Better

📅 06 Nov 2026

The Switch 2 Pro Controller Can Make Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Even Better

Tanggal: 06 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://gameinformer.com/tips/2026/11/06/the-switch-2-pro-controller-can-make-zelda-ocarina-of-time-even-better

Diungkapkan bahwa the legend of zelda: ocarina of time hit switch 2 today, and, as kyle hilliard pointed out in our review, it is pretty excellent. As part of that, Nintendo has added the ability to jump and sprint. Along with its remarkable visual upgrade, the new Switch 2 remake of Ocarina of Time adds quality-of-life improvements and modernizes the control scheme. While that works well to make the game feel new, I quickly realized it sometimes clashes with another new improvement: a free camera controlled by the right stick. Holding down the sprint button to get through areas as fast as possible can make it tricky to keep the camera where you want it, but thankfully, if you have the Switch 2 Pro Controller, there's an easy fix.

Sebagaimana diketahui, after hours of running around, i was awestruck by the level of detail and updates, but i found myself constantly fighting with the camera, or at the very least, needing to take a strange claw-style grip to be able to direct the camera with the right stick, while holding down the a button to sprint. Everyone has their own preferences, but, for example, for high-mobility shooters, I like remapping one of those to reload and one to jump. Those buttons can be remapped on a per-game basis and it's a simple process. If you're a casual Switch 2 player, you might not have even noticed the back buttons on the Pro Controller, or you just have no idea what they do. I've never felt the need to remap in a Zelda game, but after feeling the need to do so with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on Switch 2, I might do so going forward.

Diungkapkan bahwa if you, like me, struggle to comfortably steer the new free camera while running through hallways, towns, dungeons, and, yes, hyrule field, you might want to consider remapping your controller. As you can see in the above image, the placement of Jump and Dash on the face buttons can make it difficult to simultaneously control the camera and sprint. This isn't typically a problem in most modern games, as clicking the right stick is often a toggle to sprint, but in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Switch 2, you need to hold the button.

Diungkapkan bahwa if you have the nintendo switch 2 pro controller, copying one button's functionality to the buttons on the back of the controller is simple. All you need to do is hold the Home button on the Switch 2 Pro Controller for a moment until the Switch 2 system menu appears on the right side. Along with Power Options and any Bluetooth audio devices you have available, there is also the option to map GL and GR, the controller's back buttons on the left and right, respectively.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, navigate down the menu to the gl and gr, then select which one you'd like to map. Everyone can choose whatever makes sense in their own head, but mapping A (Roll and Dash) to GL and X (Jump) to GR made the most sense to me. It will ask you which button you want to assign to the one you selected. Now, while I'm using the Switch 2 Pro Controller, I can use my middle finger to hold the GL button to Dash around without removing my thumb from the camera-controlling right stick.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and the best part is that, since you're not removing the functionality of the a or x buttons, you can still use them when it makes sense. For example, A also controls actions like opening up a treasure chest or door, and in my head, that feels like a face-button action, whereas rolling and dashing feel right mapped to the back buttons. The only downside is that, since this functionality is new for Switch 2 Pro Controllers, it isn't available if you're using the Joy-Cons or a Switch 1 Pro Controller. Also, it can make switching over to handheld mode challenging, as you don't have access to the back buttons in that play style.

Berdasarkan laporan, even if you don't have the ability to take advantage of this tip, either because you don't own a switch 2 pro controller or because you prefer playing in handheld mode, you should still absolutely play the switch 2 remake of the legend of zelda: ocarina of time. To learn more about the experience and why it's a must-play, head to our review.

Shrek 2 Remastered Has No Official Reviews Yet, But The User Reviews Are Quite Bizarre

It has a high score on Xbox right now, but a Mixed one on Steam.

Yesterday marked the launch of Shrek 2 Remastered on Xbox Series X and Xbox Series S (along with other platforms), and if you're wondering why nobody seems to be talking about it, it's because there are no official reviews yet.

It seems codes were only sent out at launch for this one, which means it's going to take a while for the critics to catch up and share their thoughts on this remaster of an original Xbox cult classic.

Berdasarkan laporan, we can at least see what the initial user reviews are saying about it though, and if you look at the xbox store, everything seems to be pretty rosy. Shrek 2 Remastered has a 4. 3/5 rating on the US Xbox Store as things stand, with 76% of people giving it a 5-star review, while most of the (minimal) grumbles are focused on bugs and crashes.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the steam reviews for shrek 2 remastered are quite bizarre though. Over there, the game currently has a "Mixed" average rating based on over 350 user reviews, with 46% of people rating it "Positive" overall.

Berdasarkan laporan, if you look at the "most helpful" reviews that appear first, there are multiple people suggesting it's not a great port, highlighting issues with bugged cutscenes, a lack of settings options, and even claims that the cpus are less intelligent than they were in the original game (although others debate that it plays "exactly the same" as it used to!). There are also multiple accusations that the remaster might have been partially put together using generative AI, although this is just speculation and not confirmation by any means.

Some people are totally put off by all these issues, while others are still really enjoying their time with the game.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, satan claus on steam: "shrek 2 was one of my favourite games growing up, and i honestly can't explain how happy i am to have the chance to play it again after all these years. It's just as special as I remember, and seeing it brought back with changes that do the original justice is wonderful. Even better, being able to enjoy it on modern hardware, especially the Steam Deck, feels like a dream come true. Some childhood memories are worth revisiting, and this is absolutely one of them. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, mikey on steam: "i was really hyped for this remaster since this game is a game i grew up playing with my sister, but i am sort of disappointed with the state it is in right now. I'll wait for patches, since there still is hope. It's like they just threw a paint bucket on it and called it a day. Lots of camera bugs, cutscenes ending aprubtly, missing skybox textures, characters looking woody and uncanny and lots more. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as mentioned, shrek 2 remastered is getting a much better reception on xbox than steam right now, so perhaps we ended up getting the better version (or xbox fans are more lenient), and you can check it out for yourself at the price of £22. 49 / $26. 99 for Series X and Series S if you're interested.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, we do actually have a review copy of the game that we'll hopefully be able to check out soon, so stay tuned for our impressions in the near future. We'll also keep an eye out for raw Xbox Series X and Xbox Series S footage comparisons so you can get an idea of how it plays across both consoles.

For now though, we'll leave you with some basic gameplay from Shrek 2 Remastered down below.

#377. "This trailer is my way of saying goodbye": Have a listen to the Mass Effect 5 score that could have been, courtesy of one of the original games' composers

📅 07 Nov 2026

"This trailer is my way of saying goodbye": Have a listen to the Mass Effect 5 score that could have been, courtesy of one of the original games' composers

Tanggal: 07 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/this-trailer-is-my-way-of-saying-goodbye-have-a-listen-to-the-mass-effect-5-score-that-could-have-been-courtesy-of-one-of-the-original-games-composers

Sebagaimana diketahui, by this point i'm probably safe in assuming that you all know ea are shutting down bioware, and that mass effect 5 has been cancelled in turn. You may have also seen that an internal trailer for Mass Effect 5, or Universe as it was seemingly going to be called, was leaked not long after the news broke, and that Sam Hulick, one of the composers on the original trilogy of games, shared he was going to offer up his re-scored version of the trailer. Well, it's N7 Day, as rough as that will be for many of the developers on the game, but Hulick has stood by his word, and shared an oral glimpse at what the world of Mass Effect Universe could have sounded like.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, you can check out this new version of the trailer below, perhaps pop it on while you have a read of the rest of this post, as hulick did also write in a patreon blog about his experience with the series. "As part of my own closure, and as a love letter to the fans, I really wanted to re-score the leaked Mass Effect Universe trailer in time for N7 Day this year," he wrote. "BioWare edited a killer track called “Quartz” by French 79 to fit their trailer, which I think hinted at a slight directional shift in the score. Using that as inspiration, along with the musical tone from my work on the first three Mass Effect games, I hit the studio and got to work. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as it turns out, bioware had actually reached out to hulick asking him to potentially do some work for the project. "This year, BioWare emailed me asking if I was interested in working with them on an internal demo, and they said they were 'hoping to get some music written that would feel like Mass [Effect], supporting our new direction. ' Of course, I said yes!" This doesn't mean he wouldn't have composed the actual game, as a composer hadn't been officially selected, but Hulick said he was "more than happy to collaborate on the new game’s musical direction and help make their internal demo sound as good as it could. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, hulick also spoke of some of the ideas he had for the direction mass effect universe's soundtrack could take, noting how he "thought it would’ve been incredible to bring more songs with lyrics into the game," considering how many people loved the first game's end-credits song. Artists at the top of my collaboration list included Gunship, NINA, and The Midnight, all of whom have a moody, cinematic synthwave vibe that would’ve meshed well with the score in my head. "This would’ve been a great way to highlight more emotional moments in the narrative. And I’m pretty sure the Gunship guys are gamers, and if they’re Mass Effect fans, that would’ve been the icing on the cake!".

Diungkapkan bahwa of course, with the studio now closing, this never got to go very far, the news hitting hulick "particularly hard, as the mass effect trilogy is a core part of my origin story as a composer. " For the composer, ultimately "this trailer is my way of saying goodbye… at least for now. " This continues to be a horrendously sad moment in the industry! As always, solidarity with the team at BioWare.

#378. Diablo 4’s Warlock looks like an unhinged Necromancer with Sorcerer energy in first look at gameplay

📅 06 Mar 2026

Diablo 4’s Warlock looks like an unhinged Necromancer with Sorcerer energy in first look at gameplay

Tanggal: 06 Mar 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/diablo-4-warlock-gameplay-debut

Diablo 4's practitioner of forbidden arts, The Warlock, has been officially unveiled as the second class coming with Lord of Hatred.

Thanks to a meaty, well-produced Diablo 4 Developer Update, we got to have our promised first look at gameplay of the Warlock, the second of two classes coming to the game with the upcoming Lord of Hatred expansion.

The showcase offered a deep look at the Warlock’s core archetypes, its gameplay and skills loop, and where the class sits within the game’s existing roster of diverse classes.

Sebagaimana diketahui, since the initial reveal of lord of hatred, the warlock has remained the mysterious second class. Anyone who pre-purchased the expansion was able to get immediate access to The Paladin, the other class arriving with the expansion. It wasn’t until February that Blizzard officially revealed the class to the world, but we had to wait until this most recent Developer Update to actually see it in action.

Diungkapkan bahwa the warlock’s pragmatism exists as the counterpart to the paladin's purity, in that warlocks don’t shy away from harnessing the powers of hell to eliminate their enemies. The class can conjure up demons to do their bidding, and utilise attacks previously only available to legions of Hell.

Diungkapkan bahwa the warlock is a hybrid pet and caster class. They rely on two resources: Wrath, and Dominance. Their gameplay revolves around summoning demons, and undermining enemies with shadow arts. Casting Skills consumes Wrath, whereas Dominance is what allows the Warlock to summon and exploit demons.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the warlock has four archetypes players can spec into. Legions are traditional summoners who rely on overwhelming numbers to crush enemies. Vanguards are closer to Sorcerers, capable of dealing damage head-on. Masterminds utilise shadowcraft to slowly drain their enemies. Finally, Ritualists are summoners of the most terrifying Hell demons.

Berdasarkan laporan, the warlock is able to do this by fusing soul shards into their bodies. Each Soul Shard is tied to a certain demon, and its through that power that the Warlock is able to call upon them in combat. Going down any of the four paths becomes available after reaching level 30, which is when the class mechanic is unlocked. Your choice does, of course, affect your abilities going forward.

Warlocks arrive alongside new Uniques that cater to their specific playstyles, which is similar to what we’ve previously seen with The Paladin, and The Spiritborn before that.

Diungkapkan bahwa lord of hatred arrives april 28. While we wait, Diablo 4’s next season is kicking off next week to deliver a bit of mindless fun to hold us over until the big day.

Sebagaimana diketahui, starting today, il-2 sturmovik: battle of stalingrad will be free to play on steam, as part of the 25th anniversary celebration of the franchise. The flight simulator is also offering an 85% discount until November 15.

Diungkapkan bahwa il-2 sturmovik: battle of stalingrad centers on the battle of the same name that raged from july 1942 until february 1943. Although the Germans, led by the 6th Army, managed to enter the city, a massive Soviet counterattack led by Marshall Georgy Zhukov in November trapped Axis forces in.

Berdasarkan laporan, codenamed operation uranus, this move kicked off a brutal siege that would lead to the annihilation of the 6th army and the capture of its commander, field marshal fiedrich paulus. The German defeat marked the end of its expansionism to the East, and is often cited as the turning point of the war in Soviet favor.

The fight on the ground has become the stuff of legends, but airpower played a major part in the battle of Stalingrad.

Berdasarkan laporan, a massive german bombardment turned the city to rubble in august 1942, killing thousands of civilians and destroying almost all houses in the city. The German Luftflotte 4 averaged 1000 sorties per day between August 23 and November 22, 1942, putting immense pressure on the strained Soviet defenders.

Berdasarkan laporan, when zhukov's counterattack closed the door on the german troops in the city, the luftwaffe pivoted from offensive missions to airlift, using transports and bombers to haul supplies and wounded. German fighters and attack aircraft managed to inflict heavy losses on Soviet units during this period, but were comprehensively beaten on a strategic level.

The fight on the ground has become the stuff of legends, but airpower played a major part in the battle of Stalingrad.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, soviet aviation in stalingrad was outmatched in both quality and numbers when the axis offensive hit in the summer of 1942. Reinforcements in August eventually helped tip the scale in the Red Army's favor, especially with the widespread deployment of La-5 fighters, plus Il-2 and Pe-2 attack aircraft.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the siege of stalingrad allowed soviet fighters to hunt down german transports trying to reinforce the 6th army, in turn forcing german fighters to dedicate more and more time protecting these. Eventually, Soviet fighter activity pushed the Germans to primarily fly transports at night, which became increasingly prohibitive once the winter set in.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, meanwhile, il-2 sturmovik attack aircraft used the increasingly thin german fighter cover to pound enemy frontlines. Il-2 and Pe-2 units also took the fight to German airfields, hammering aircraft on the ground and helping seal the fate of the trapped garrison.

On its own merits, Il-2 Sturmovik: Battle of Stalingrad is one of the most realistic and advanced flight simulators in the market, and it remains the leading World War 2 game in its category.

Players are able to fly eight different aircraft in the standard edition.

On top of that, the Il-2 Sturmovik structure allows owners of any edition to play across maps in multiplayer servers, which means you’ll get to experience some of the newer maps if you choose to fly online.

Sebagaimana diketahui, server owners like the ad astra group are setting up special events for free weekend players to help them get a feel for the game. This Saturday, Ad Astra is running a Siege of Odessa event set in August 6, 1941. Free weekend players will have access to the LaGG-3, Ju-87 and He-111. You can find more information on the by clicking here.

The Il-2 Sturmovik: Battle of Stalingrad free weekend event runs from 13:00 today until 13:00 on Monday, November 16, Eastern Time.

Il-2 Sturmovik: Battle of Stalingrad is part of the Great Battles series, first released in November 2013 and available exclusively on PC.

#381. Review: Harold Halibut (Switch 2) - A Creative Marvel That Suffers In The Back Half

📅 12 Nov 2026

Review: Harold Halibut (Switch 2) - A Creative Marvel That Suffers In The Back Half

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/nintendo-switch-2/harold-halibut

Diungkapkan bahwa this won’t be the first harold halibut review to mention being wowed by one of the game’s pre-launch trailers during its release on other platforms back in 2024. Back then, the game’s stop-motion aesthetic — with character models based on scans of real marionettes, and its tactile hand-wrought sets — looked like nothing I’d ever seen.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, coupled with the atmospheric music and the promise of engaging characters and ambitious emotional storytelling, it became, in my eyes, an absolute must-play. And of course it did – its story of a crashed spaceship and its crew, stranded on an ocean planet, looked like a Wes Anderson animation, like Isle of Dogs or Fantastic Mr Fox. In terms of defining what games are capable of, I was ready for Harold Halibut to set new standards. I was convinced it would be a sure-fire 10/10.

Diungkapkan bahwa now as i write this review, i wonder if part of the stunned feeling was just a little confusion about how such an ambitious storytelling production would translate into a game. And it’s a fair question – after finishing Harold Halibut and watching that trailer again, I notice very little gameplay. A little walking around perhaps, but not much else.

Sebagaimana diketahui, 2024’s reviews were, indeed, mixed. The development team, Slow Bros, an independent game studio based in Cologne, had certainly left an impression. Some reviewers declared Harold Halibut a breath of fresh air and a work of art, while others clearly hit a wall when it came to a lack of gameplay. For me, at different times, I found myself in either camp.

Sebagaimana diketahui, my notes from the opening few hours are as excited as i’ve ever written. The pleasant world and characters set out their stall early. Harold Halibut is an enjoyable presence, a handyman surrounded as he goes about his days by a variety of memorable characters.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i enjoyed the atmosphere, the story, and how harold’s ship, the fedora 1, is run by a quirky corporation called all water, who themselves are balancing the commercial benefits of their transportation system with a lack of resources. Despite the risk for on-the-nose satire, nothing ever felt heavy-handed. At all times ‘character’ came first, to the game’s great benefit.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i controlled harold as he went about his janitorial tasks — cleaning filters, clearing rooms of boxes, fixing machinery — and liked the enjoyable if simple gameplay loop of exploring the ship, the social areas, the science areas, and having the freedom to choose where to go and who to chat to. These moments — controlling Harold’s marionette, seeing all the lovely sets, and discovering layers and depth in the characters, helped by impressive voice acting — fulfilled the initial promise I’d seen in that trailer.

Sebagaimana diketahui, harold halibut was over 10 years in the making, and took less than 10 seconds to fall in love with. However, it’s best played docked due to performance issues (primarily frame rate) whilst in handheld. As a whole, it’s a beautiful work of art, a thought-provoking story with excellent character development. Regardless, still worth a play.

Berdasarkan laporan, i was effectively playing an animation, and it was wonderful. For the best part of five hours, I was never bored, and in fact often delighted as little variations in the gameplay kept things fresh, as characters bonded, and as the plot became alive with subplots and the promise of a grand finale I just had to see.

But then, as my playtime extended, a few elements brought me back down to earth.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, first, i sensed some bloat creep into the gameplay, and i started to feel a little less happy about the repetitiveness of running about delivering messages and catching up with the crew. Second, there was a subtle slowdown in the overall pace of the story. And third, the narrative clearly started taking over the gameplay a little too much. There were long periods where I either didn’t even need to press a button, or otherwise do little more than walk around to trigger the next cutscene.

Diungkapkan bahwa harold halibut is, of course, a narrative-focused adventure. I’ve enjoyed games like Night in the Woods and Oxenfree, but for me the 11-hour runtime for the main storyline here could have done with a trim in the second half.

It’s not that the cutscenes were a problem, but coming back to short snippets of gameplay after long breaks only to be tasked with running back and forth multiple times between, say, two locations (which happened once) felt a bit like hard work.

Sebagaimana diketahui, just when i wanted the storytelling momentum to build, harold halibut lost a little of its focus. The themes and creativity established during the early interactions with the cast — the delightful running-enthusiast postman, the shopkeeper trying to adjust his work-life balance, and Harold’s ex Sunny, struggling to define her life goals — faded into the background as Harold’s storyline took over.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i loved harold, but except for one soliloquy, he had, for much of the game, seemed more of a fun, pleasant vessel for meeting the other citizens of the spaceship. This isn’t a big complaint, but it contributed to a sense of the second half leaving behind some of the things that made the opening so great.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the last thing to say is that the switch 2 port isn’t quite as pretty as other incarnations, while still being playable and enjoyable. The camera stutters during zooms and pans, which are frequent thanks to the game’s cinematic style.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it’s a shame because the visuals are clearly one of harold halibut’s big strengths, but, ultimately, this is still a very playable port. I can’t say these issues impacted my enjoyment at all.

Berdasarkan laporan, back in 2024, i imagined writing a review for harold halibut and rounding up the final score to a 10. I like Harold Halibut a lot. I enjoyed the story, the heart, the characters — and of course I loved the visuals — but I also felt the balance of gameplay, narrative, and pacing wasn’t quite there for me, and that this had an overall impact on how well it works as a game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, now looking back at those reviews from the original release — the spread of besotted 10s to the more cautious 6s — i think they all have a point. Ultimately, it’s a curiosity with a lot of heart. It is a work of art and it’s worth playing to appreciate all that wonderful craft. It struggles to balance its elements, but I’m very happy to have played it. Harold Halibut is a creative marvel. But the pace can also drag and sometimes gameplay takes a little too much of a back seat. If the visuals and storytelling style appeal, then it’s definitely worth a look.

#383. The Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Easter Eggs That Did And Did Not Make It Into The 2026 Remake

📅 05 Nov 2026

The Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Easter Eggs That Did And Did Not Make It Into The 2026 Remake

Tanggal: 05 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://gameinformer.com/2026/11/05/the-zelda-ocarina-of-time-easter-eggs-that-did-and-did-not-make-it-into-the-2026-remake

Diungkapkan bahwa the legend of zelda: ocarina of time for the nintendo 64 is a game full of easter eggs, secrets, and hidden mechanics (did you know if a butterfly lands on your deku stick, it summons a fairy?). Now in its second remake, not every secret has made its way forward through the previous iterations, but many have. Below you will learn about a few of the secrets that made the cut, and others that didn’t.

Diungkapkan bahwa in the courtyard where link first meets zelda, there is arguably the most fourth-wall-breaking easter egg in the whole game. If you don’t rush to Zelda and instead pause and enter first-person to look around, you will see portraits of other Nintendo characters through the windows, like Mario and Yoshi. In the 3DS remake, the portraits are replaced by an image of a Mario stage.

Berdasarkan laporan, for the 2026 remake, there are no references to other nintendo characters. Instead, the tapestry you build over the course of the game is on display. Removing the reference to Nintendo characters outside of the Zelda universe is understandable, but it is a little odd that art representing the full adventure of the game – an adventure that has not yet concluded – is on the wall.

Berdasarkan laporan, as stated above, the nintendo character portraits are gone, but there is still a guard you can annoy. If you fire a Deku Seed into the left window, a guard will pop out, yell at you, and then throw a bomb at you. You can’t pick up the bomb. In fact, at this point in the game, you haven’t even seen a bomb.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the hyrule castle portrait references to yoshi and mario are gone (though mario and luigi are still kind of in the game in a way), but bowser gets a pass for some reason. Both Malon and her dad, Talon, are still wearing Bowser pins on their clothes. And unlike the N64 game where the detail was a little vague, there is no mistaking it here.

Sebagaimana diketahui, gossip stones are all over ocarina of time and it takes a while to understand what they do. If you do the Happy Mask Salesman’s side quest, interacting with them while wearing the Mask of Truth offers little hints and details about the world. But then there are interactions that are just odd for no reason. If you hit them with a sword, they tell you the time, and if you play Zelda’s Lullaby near them, they refill your magic. Blowing up a bomb near a Gossip Stone still makes it take off like a rocket ship, and using the Megaton Hammer still flattens them for a moment like a Looney Tunes.

And speaking of playing Zelda’s Lullaby for inanimate objects, if you slash a sign to pieces with your sword and regret your words and deeds, you can play the iconic tune to make the signs reform and become readable again.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this detail was exclusive to the 3ds remake of ocarina of time, and surprising no one, it has been removed. For… marketing purposes, I guess, Skyward Sword art could be found in Lonlon Ranch, the Bombchu Shop in Hyrule Castle Town, and the Gerudo Fortress. Ocarina of Time launched in June 2011 and Nintendo released Skyward Sword about five months later in November. It was a fun Easter Egg to discover back in 2011, especially since Skyward Sword was still months away, but these days it’s a bit of an odd inclusion.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, though never explicit, the composer ghosts guarding the sun’s song (and link’s first redead encounter) have always been assumed to be inspired by mario and luigi. They still appear in Ocarina of Time this way, which isn't surprising, since they are important characters you must meet to get a very useful song. They are brothers; Flat is short, squat, and red; Sharp is lanky and green. Fans have also speculated that Talon and Ingo are Mario and Luigi-inspired for similar reasons, but it’s worth noting that they are not brothers.

Berdasarkan laporan, in the spirit temple there is a large statue of a woman and for reasons that have never been explained, link could attach his hookshot to her breasts. If anything, it was confusing. It served no purpose. It didn’t help solve a puzzle. But we all tried it and there is no shame in admitting it! That was removed for the 3DS remake, and it remains removed in 2026.

Diungkapkan bahwa this is a very subtle reference to wind waker/breath of the wild/tears of the kingdom and is potentially the only addition to the remake that looks toward the future of the zelda franchise. Obviously, plenty of characters in Ocarina later appear in Majora’s Mask (another remake of that is hopefully being considered), but it would be inaccurate to call those intentional Easter Eggs.

Diungkapkan bahwa however, in kokiri forest and in the neighboring lost woods, the magical debris floating in the air often resembles a korok as it would later appear in the series. It makes sense, too, because the Koroks are meant to be what the Kokiri transformed into following The Great Flood.

You'll also have two new classes to play around with, if you've gotten bored of the ones you've tried so far or just fancy something new.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the first is the shadow, which appropriately introduces a stealth mechanic. As you might expect of such a class, while you're in stealth, "monsters can't see you until you get within a short distance of them. You prepare these in stealth, "then trigger them automatically as you strike. " Being in said mode also bolsters your dagger with a range of bonuses, and the Shadow also has another weapon type available to them, traps. This lets you strengthen your sword skills, "enhancing each of them in different ways," with various stances allowing for "even deadlier combinations. The passive skill tree has also seen a makeover, and a number of classes have also received some improvements. You can read about all of that in more detail right here.

#386. Diablo 4's next season is short, but it lets you become The Butcher, and it has Doom: The Dark Ages skins you probably can't afford

📅 06 Mar 2026

Diablo 4's next season is short, but it lets you become The Butcher, and it has Doom: The Dark Ages skins you probably can't afford

Tanggal: 06 Mar 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/diablo-4-season-of-slaughter-gameplay-details-killstreaks-the-butcher-doom-collab

Blizzard has unveiled the next Diablo 4 season, which kicks off next week to hold us over until the launch of the game's big expansion in April.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the big diablo 4 developer update has indeed delivered the goods. One of the livestream’s big topics was, of course, the game’s upcoming mini-season, which is set to kick off next week and run until the launch of Lord of Hatred, the game’s anticipated next expansion.

You can tell Blizzard wanted to have a bit of fun with Season of Slaughter, as many of its major features make it look like a limited-time event, but there is plenty to be excited about here.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, season of slaughter kicks off march 11, and will run until the following season kicks off april 28, with the launch of the lord of hatred expansion. Many of the season’s biggest additions were available to preview in the 2. 6. 0 Public Test Realm.

Sebagaimana diketahui, patch 2. 6. 0, as you might have guessed, is the one that will kick off the slaughter next week. The headline feature here is ability to become The Butcher, the iconic in-game boss who randomly invades players’ games.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when you play as the butcher, you’ll be rewarded the more kills you get in quick succession. Your skills hotbar will transform to become something more fitting of The Butcher, making them more brutal. You’ll also earn a seasonal currency as you play.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, starting the seasonal questline is how you can begin to assume the butcher’s form. A Taste of Power can be initiated from Gea Kul. As you play, you’ll earn Meaty Offerings, which can later be spent on Shrines of Slaughter in the new Helltide. Transforming into The Butcher can be done in a few ways. Once activated, the shrine will draw more enemies towards you.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you never venture into pvp zones in diablo 4, this season may change your mind. The standard PvP combat that could only be found in Fields of Hatred has been replaced with a Ceremony of Slaughter, a new event that rewards you for killing enemies quickly. See it through and The Butcher’s Idol will spawn, allowing you to transform into it.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, elsewhere in the world, you’ll also be able to attain the same power at slaughterhouses, a new activity type available this season. Inside, you immediately become The Butcher for the entirety of the run.

Diungkapkan bahwa the butcher’s arrival also ties into two of the other season of slaughter’s more interesting additions. First, the Killstreak system finally arrives in Diablo 4, rewarding you for being as efficient as possible in carving your way through enemies.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, anyone who played diablo 3 should be familiar with how it works. It kicks off the moment you get a kill, and has a visible timer where you’ll need continue performing the same action to up your streak. The more kills you get, the more often your timer will refresh.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there are five tiers to climb through: killstreak, carnage, devastation, bloodbath, and massacre. You’re awarded for the tier you manage to reach before the timer runs out. You’ll earn XP and seasonal rep each time a Killstreak is achieved.

Berdasarkan laporan, the other butcher-themed addition is bloodied items, which is a new item quality available throughout this season. They play into the Killstreak system to grant you even more power. Bloodied Items come with unique affixes that scale off your Killstreak tier. You’ll see many familiar items in that pool, as any item in the game has a chance to drop as Bloodied. Bloodied Items can also be acquired by earning Fresh Meat.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, even if none of that sounds exciting, you’re probably going to redownload the game for the paladin free trial, which kicks off alongside the new season on march 11. The trial is only available until March 18, and it lets you try out the Paladin class.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the trial is available across pc, playstation, and xbox. You’ll be able to take the new class for a spin, but your progress will be capped at level 25. The Paladin can be permanently unlocked by buying the Lord of Hatred expansion, as it’s one of two classes the expansion is introducing.

The good news is that any progress you make in the free trial will carry over to the full game if/when you buy the expansion.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, season of slaughter also kicks off a doom: the dark ages collaboration event. As we’ve come to expect, there’s a very limited free component to the collaboration, in the form of the Doom Reliquary. This is essentially a mini-battle pass that includes the Shield Saw skin, Slayer’s Flair, the head of the Cyberdemon as a back trophy and various other smaller bits.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the more impressive items - such as character skins, will instead be available to purchase for real money. The list includes the Doom Slayer armor, Mecha Dragon Serrat skin for your cat mount, and a Cacodemon pet.

Though the armor skin is cross-class compatible, judging by how much previous collaboration items have cost in Diablo 4, most of us probably won’t be spending that kind of money to get it.

#388. Zelda Ocarina Remake Producers Talk Changing And Maintaining The Game, Easter Eggs, The Bombchu Bowling Alley Operator, And More

📅 05 Nov 2026

Zelda Ocarina Remake Producers Talk Changing And Maintaining The Game, Easter Eggs, The Bombchu Bowling Alley Operator, And More

Tanggal: 05 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://gameinformer.com/interview/2026/11/04/zelda-ocarina-remake-producers-talk-changing-and-maintaining-the-game-easter

Berdasarkan laporan, today marks the release of the remake of the legend of zelda: ocarina of time for switch 2. You can read my full, positive review here. Ahead of the game’s release, but after having played the game to completion (well… 99% as you will learn below), I traveled to New York to speak with Zelda series producer Eiji Aonuma (whose work on the original Ocarina of Time marked his first involvement with the series) and Ocarina of Time remake producer Hidemaro Fujibayashi (director of Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom among other Zelda titles).

Topics include how the team approached remaking Ocarina of Time, what needed changing and what needed to stay the same, their thoughts on the Easter Eggs from the original game, the fate and marital status of the Bombchu Bowling girl, and more.

The discussion covers a fairly faithful remake of Ocarina of Time for Nintendo 64, which launched nearly 30 years ago, but I have spoiler-marked certain questions and answers that might be considered sensitive if you want to maintain surprise when playing the remake yourself.

Diungkapkan bahwa mr. Fujibayashi, what is your relationship to Ocarina of Time?.

Berdasarkan laporan, fujibayashi: regarding the original ocarina of time, at the time i was working for a different company, so it was mainly me as an end user trying to looking forward to the experience of what a 3d zelda is going to look like. So, really, I was just waiting in anticipation for that.

How long has the remake been in development?.

Diungkapkan bahwa aonuma: it's actually kind of hard to say exactly when development began because the earliest thought process was us thinking about the 40th anniversary of the legend of zelda approaching, and so we started to have this conversation, “oh, what should we make to mark this occasion?” and then at that point, we decided on ocarina of time, and so a lot of time elapsed from the beginning of that conversation about the anniversary until we got to ocarina. So it's hard to pinpoint exactly when the development itself began.

Was this a more relaxing game to develop after making Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom back-to-back?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, aonuma: was it relaxing? that's kind of a hard question to ask. I would say it's more a different style of development. So, if we looked at Tears of the Kingdom, Breath of the Wild, these were created as new games with a very different kind of development cycle. Whereas for a remake like this one, we decided to take an interesting approach, which is to bring in this new younger staff and find out what they would bring to this project in terms of their own experience, their own interpretation as newer staff.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and so my role here was really advising them on this, and it's not always like the development cycle of a new game. But in one sense, the producer has to be careful not to advise too much, to say that you must do it like this. You don't want to prescribe the approach that anyone is going to take. You want to make sure that there's enough space for these younger staff members to have their own interpretation, their own approach to it.

Do you have remake philosophies or rules, like what needs to stay the same and what should change?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, fujibayashi: so, in fact, there were pretty clear kind of rules or guidelines, as you said. And when we first started discussing what kind of game and what kind of approach you wanted to take. Aonuma had mentioned, where he wanted to, the development team was centered around the young directors that took part in this development. First, is because you know, as Mr. One thing that really came through and we clarified was, as you mentioned, what are we going to change and what are we going to keep the same.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and i'll start with what we wanted to change, and that was really to make sure that – because we have the ability to use the latest technology through the nintendo switch 2 – there's a lot we can change and improve upon, such as you know obviously things like controls, graphics. We also have a new controller, so that allows for the new camera controls. And we’re really able to fine tune and polish the feel of the game and there was excitement for all the ways of expression we can provide the player.

Berdasarkan laporan, but on the other hand, thinking about what we didn't want to change, we were thinking about the creators of the original ocarina of time, and what they wanted to convey, the experience that they wanted to provide for users and players through this title. That's something that we wanted to keep intact and that spirit to carry across. And we wanted to make sure that this new game is able to deliver that in the way that we wanted them to.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, aonuma: so speaking as someone who worked on the original ocarina of time for nintendo 64, you always have those moments looking back of, “oh, you know, i really wanted to do more of this,” or, “i wanted to be able to express this in a different way,” but you're faced with certainly the tech limitations of the time. And I went on from Ocarina of Time to work on other Zelda franchise titles, as well. And with each new title, you're always looking for a new way to express something that may not have been available to you previously. But you always have to keep in mind is what makes a Zelda game special, and how do we protect that? How do we keep that in store for the players, as well. So, on this project in particular, I had to think of that through the lens of how do we protect the things that make it the Zelda Ocarina experience, but also how do I give the freedom to the staff to find their own expression of these ideas? And I think between those two things, we found a really good balance. So I'm very happy about that.

Berdasarkan laporan, when we interviewed you, mr. Aonuma, for Game Informer’s Breath of the Wild cover story, Shigeru Miyamoto was present, and he made a joke about the challenge of the water temple. Are you happy with where the Water Temple is now in the remake?.

Berdasarkan laporan, aonuma: certainly, looking back on the challenge level of the water temple, i think it was hard, but some of that came from the system that we were presenting to players. But now that we're able to give players a shortcut, single button on the gameplay screen, I think they can get to that more quickly. So, for example, if you look at the way that players used to have to switch to the heavy iron boots so that they could sink in the water, you had to go to a different screen and press the button. It's a better experience because they can focus on solving the puzzle rather than having to navigate menus and thinking about that and interrupting the flow of their thought each time.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, another consideration compared to the original is that you couldn't move the camera angle in the original game, and so if you were looking for a certain room in this 3d space relative to where you are now, it was much more difficult to orient yourself and think about the space where that room might exist. So I think those two together, you know, also with the heavy boots being one button press, I think this, for me, is the best version of the Water Temple.

Is the canon of the Zelda timeline considered at all during development? Did you think about adding in Easter eggs that made references to things that would have happened later in the Zelda story? Like Wind Waker taking place after Ocarina of Time, for example.

Berdasarkan laporan, aonuma: it's funny because the staff would sometimes ask me about the possibility of including nods to the timeline or references to the other game, and i actually, at the time, would say, "no, let's focus on this game. Let's make this the best version of Ocarina of Time that we can. " So, the timeline was in the back of our mind, but we didn't consider taking an approach to this game where we actually, explicitly included references like that.

When testing the game, was it challenging to find people who had never played Ocarina of Time?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, aonuma: as it turns out, both on our staff and in the testing teams, there's a lot of young people, and many of them had never played the original. So it wasn't a challenge to find them.

Diungkapkan bahwa who do you primarily consider this remake to be for? new people who have never played ocarina? or fans like myself who consider it to be, frankly, their favorite game. Who is the important audience?.

Berdasarkan laporan, fujibayashi: the answer is both. Our response to those fans who have fond memories of this title is really what I mentioned earlier: being able to provide the experience of what it was like to play Ocarina of Time back to them, and that was our response to them. And when it comes to the players that are experiencing this for the first time, whether it's the graphics, or the controls, or the ability to shift and move the camera; those are all changes and fine-tuning that we've made to make sure that people who are used to modern gaming are able to enter this experience with as little friction as possible. So again, to answer your question? It's really both.

Berdasarkan laporan, aonuma: certainly, when you look at the original the legend of zelda: ocarina of time, there is so much hidden in the world that people spend a lot of time looking for things. And your first time playing through, you may not find all of it in one go. People in that kind of situation would refer to strategy books and information that they can find.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for example, when you're looking for the like last skulltala and you already have 99, our job is to think about how to give the player an approach to that sort of a problem. What kind of information can we give them to help out. To make it a fun, but still challenging experience, because we want even new players to come in and to be able to fully experience this world that we've created for them, even though old fans are going to come in with a little bit of an advantage in the form of a lot of prior game knowledge.

Diungkapkan bahwa i'm not kidding about needing some help with that final skulltala. I'm going to hand you my Switch 2 after this so you can show me where it is because it's been driving me crazy. I've been having dreams about where the final Skulltala might be.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the end of the game in the remake made me emotional in a way i wasn't expecting. It made me cry, just the whole ending of the experience overall. Were you expecting that kind of reaction from players?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, fujibayashi: so first, i want to say i'm very, very happy and excited to hear you say that because, as you mentioned, that cutscene – cutscenes in general – but that cutscene specifically is something that we, as a dev team, heavily discussed. Because of the limitations of the technology back in the day, there might have been things that we weren't able to convey fully, whether it's because of the tempo of the game… whatever it is. And so, when we approached this remake, we wanted to make sure that we captured that moment in the way that we wanted to express it. So that the right kinds of emotions are evoked, and that we can convey the emotion and the story that we wanted to at that moment. And now that hearing you say that and kind of having that reaction really struck a chord? I'm really relieved to hear that because that's exactly what we wanted to do.

Diungkapkan bahwa the redeads, the shadow temple, the dead hand miniboss, wall masters – these enemies traumatized a whole generation of kids. I'm curious if that was always the intention and how did you approach making sure that those elements still remained scary? Was there a line that was too scary?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, aonuma: certainly, at the time, we had this intent to make sure that we allow the players to find the enemies a little bit scary. But more than anything, they are part of this Fantasy world, which has both light and dark portions, and so we're trying to bring that feeling across. They have to be, right? We want to express that sort of thing. It’s not that we're trying to scare people outright as the entire intent, but rather show that you know Link is part of a brighter part of the world where people are friendly, and Ganon is a part of the darker part of the world where there's a lot of scary things. And we kept that in mind in the remake as well.

Berdasarkan laporan, we wanted to make sure we were bringing that out, but the tools that we have available to us now for expression are so capable that if we really tried, of course, we could make something that was very, very scary. But this is supposed to be for all kinds of players. We didn't want to hit the scary notes so strongly that we were putting off new players or younger players, and so we want to have that tuning very carefully in mind as we're making those adjustments in terms of presenting that final expression in the game.

I shudder to visualize what the scarier versions of the ReDeads might look like.

Aonuma: What was your experience of them this time?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, oh, terrifying! that noise. The noise they make. That scream. I feel it in my chest. It just recalls that scariness of my childhood in a way that I admit is very entertaining, and I like. Do you remember recording that sound effect? How did you do that? Did you have someone scream?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for the remake, a lot has been rewritten. The meaning hasn't been changed dramatically, but pretty much everything has been rewritten. What was the goal with the rewriting overall?.

Diungkapkan bahwa fujibayashi: yes, it's as you said. We did a lot of rewriting of the text. When it comes to the original Ocarina of Time, there's the idea that because it was 28 years ago – it's a long time ago – there's the turn of phrase, or the way it's been written, is sometimes not clear or doesn't work in the modern day, given the context of the modern day. And so that's why we wanted to make sure that it makes sense and it's easier to understand for people who are familiar with playing modern games, and also that it works better here.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and when you think about… obviously the graphics have been improved significantly. So with the new graphics, if you go through the wordy explanation of what it is, the player is going to be like, "Yeah, I can see it. Before we had to do things like… “That blue ocarina that is the size that you could fit on a hand,” something like that, to make sure that the idea gets across to the player. But now, because the graphics are improved, it's very clear what the size it is. It's very clear that it's a blue ocarina. " So in order to make sure that we remove those kind of slight hurdles and really make sure that we can present the game and improve not only the expression but also the pacing of the game? That's something that we really took into consideration as we were rewriting the game.

Diungkapkan bahwa i wanted to ask about some specific changes for the remake. You get five bottles now. Why?.

Berdasarkan laporan, aonuma: because bottles are so important to the way the player plays the game, like looking for strategies to deal with different kinds of situations, even at the time of development of the original title, i thought, “oh, you know, i could do with even just one more bottle. ” I think certainly when you collect all four in the original, you feel great about that at time. But I was still thinking like one more would be okay, right?.

Diungkapkan bahwa so, all this time that was in the back of my mind. But yeah, certainly, once you have a certain number of bottles, you're going to feel a little bit more confident and more comfortable. It strengthens that whole sequence through the game by changing the order just a little bit there. But when the new younger staff were familiarizing themselves with the old game and thinking about what they might want to change in this version, one thing that I suggested was that the player could get their first bottle earlier, and this would actually be really useful in terms of reinforcing for the player how helpful bottles were and motivating them on their quest to find the next bottle. But reinforcing that feeling early on, I think, was important for us in the development of this one.

Berdasarkan laporan, in the original, there were nintendo character portraits in zelda's courtyard of mario, yoshi, and more, but those have been removed. I was curious as to why.

Berdasarkan laporan, aonuma: certainly, at the time, when we put those there, i don't think anybody thought it was too big a deal. Maybe there was a more carefree or comfortable approach to that sort of thing. But looking at it now, like if a player is coming through that area, and given the overall way that we're, you know, creating this world and giving the player that form of expression, if they look up and they think, "Why is Yoshi there?” We don't want that moment to interrupt their experience of the world in that way. So we're feeling a little bit differently about it this time.

Diungkapkan bahwa however, you will remember that there is one design element on talon with bowser on it, and that's part of the original design of the character. So we didn't change that. That stays as is.

Diungkapkan bahwa i have some short-answer questions. What happened to her after seven years. The woman who runs the Bombchu Bowling game. And is she single?.

Aonuma: That's something we're not going to touch, and I'll leave it to your imagination.

Diungkapkan bahwa one of the skulltala rewards is bombchus, which i found disappointing when i was young, and i found disappointing as an adult. Why does he give you Bombchus?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, aonuma: so that feeling you had when you got, as a reward for a certain number of skulltalas, the bombchus, and you thought, “wait, that's it?” that's also part of the original experience of the 64 version. So there, there's an approach that we take where we try to keep all of the different notes that people felt in the original game in place. You know, sometimes it's really remarkable, fun things, and other times it's slight moments of disappointment. Even that could be memorable in that way. It's important to maintain that.

Berdasarkan laporan, the great fairies. What do they need rupees for?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, fujibayashi: you know, it's really about a feeling. It's like in Japan sometimes, like donations to a temple or something similar like that. It's to express your reverence for the great fairies.

Berdasarkan laporan, the 3ds remake had skyward sword art hidden in a couple of places, but you removed it for this remake. You didn't want to keep the Skyward Sword art?.

Diungkapkan bahwa aonuma: [laughs] i do remember at the time the designers on the 3ds version were really interested in placing easter eggs like that throughout the game, and the timing of the release of skyward sword was such that it was perfect to go ahead and include that. ” But like earlier when we were talking about in the courtyard sequence with the Yoshi portrait. So I said, “Okay, sure. You know, you don't want to interrupt the player's experience by seeing something that's unrelated to what they're currently doing in the game. So for that reason, we decided not to go that way.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, mr. Fujibayashi, you directed Skyward Sword. Were you sad to see that reference removed?.

Diungkapkan bahwa fujibayashi: [laughs] no, it’s really as mr. Aonuma said. There was an underlying concept in what we were going for, so no hard feelings there.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i think the biggest cutscene change in the game is when link transitions from child to adult. It is now a much more involved sequence. Why did that scene need such a drastic change?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, aonuma: so i think that's really connected to the way we were thinking about expressing things in the original. We couldn't do everything. We couldn't express everything that we'd like to, and I think in that moment where you have Ganondorf having this reaction to Link becoming older, that cutscene in the original, it was very low on explanation.

Berdasarkan laporan, so, you have these thoughts in the player's mind like, “oh wait, why is he there? what's the relation to this process?” so, you want something that explains his presence, that explains his reaction to make a bigger impression on the player overall, and that's something that you can use to connect the motivation to want to face ganondorf in the final fight. Something that I think comes across better now.

[I pulled out my Switch 2 and showed them how I was missing one Skulltala in Hyrule Field].

Berdasarkan laporan, you can see here i have 99 out of 100 and am have two out of three in hyrule field. Can you point to a general location to give me an idea of where to look?.

#389. Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United Will Launch Earlier Than Expected On Switch 2
