Diungkapkan bahwa but now, someone new will be steering the ship. Colette Kress, the company's executive vice president and chief financial officer will serve as interim CEO, while the search begins for Huang's permanent replacement.

Diungkapkan bahwa whoever they are, they'll be taking over an absolute titan of tech, the behemoth standing behind the us position in the great ai race, and a company that will need to convince its investors that the ai good times are far from over. Sebagaimana diketahui, personally, i reckon they're going to be pretty far down the list of priorities. Because this is big business, money talks, and AI data centers are where most of the cash still lies. I wish that wasn't true, but the figures speak for themselves.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i'm not saying consumer gaming hardware, or nvidia graphics cards, are going to disappear entirely in the face of the ai onslaught. Diungkapkan bahwa he who became one of the primary movers of the ai market now threatening our hobby, was also an integral part of pc gaming's success. But now, Nvidia is likely to be making some big changes, sans Huang—and I find it hard to believe that many of them will be in our favour.

#487. Mass Effect petition has enough signatures for the Canadian Government to potentially save BioWare

Mass Effect petition has enough signatures for the Canadian Government to potentially save BioWare

Tanggal: 05 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/bioware-canada-house-of-commons-petition-save-mass-effect

Following news of EA's decision to shut down iconic RPG studio BioWare, Canadian fans of the studio have escalated their grievances to the governmental level, calling on the Canadian Government to step in and save the Canadian studio from closure, seemingly after Canada's New Democratic Party leader Avi Lewis called on the government to do so.

Fans have submitted a petition to the Canadian House of Commons arguing for the government to find a way for BioWare to continue, such as through funding that allows the studio to buy the Mass Effect and other IPs and go independent.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the petition, number e-7898, argues that "bioware is one of canada's most important cultural exports" and that the studio's closure by its american parent company "represents an immense loss to and possibly a targeted attack on canada's cultural legacy. ".

"BioWare's productions champion the values of inclusivity, tolerance, democracy, justice, and civil rights that are at the centre of Canada's national identity," it continued.

Berdasarkan laporan, the petition opened for signatures on 4th of november, and has already amassed 1,700 signatures. By law, petitions that surpass 500 valid signatures from Canadian citizens or residents are entered into the House of Commons' agenda, meaning they will be presented in front of the parliament.

Diungkapkan bahwa as encouraging as that may be, it's worth keeping in mind that it may not result in meaningful change. Even if the Canadian Government agrees with the petition's goals, it cannot force EA to sell BioWare or its various IPs.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ea notably didn't shop the studio around before closing it down, and the publisher has a history of closing down owned studios rather than selling them off. EA has also kept the IPs of its various shuttered studios.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the community's reaction to bioware's closure has taken different forms. Hundreds of thousands signed a different petition to save Mass Effect. The people behind the movement have purchased billboards in Times Square in New York City to advertise it, with plans for more outside The Game Awards ceremony in December.

Meanwhile, former BioWare developers have spoken about the last days of BioWare, and the work they've poured into Mass Effect Universe, the studio's final project before it was shuttered.

Honkai: Star Rail's next major update introduces a whole new planet to the RPG, and way more besides.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the upcoming major release is dubbed no aha at full moon for a very good reason. Aha's Planarcadia is the big new world headlining Version 4. 0.

Sebagaimana diketahui, planarcadia is a place whose description sounds a bit like a warhammer 40,000 eldar homeworld, and is quite open about its cyberpunk inspirations. In-universe, however, it was born out of the pages of an art canvas, and it’s a world where pleasure is king.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the phantasmoon games is another highlight of planarcadia, a competitive spectacle where you’ll have a chance to compete to become aeon for a minute. If you make it to the final stages, you may earn an audience with The Laughter.

Sebagaimana diketahui, version 4. General Yao Guang (Madam Yao) is one, a Seer Strategist from the Xianzhou Alliance's Yuque. Diungkapkan bahwa general yao guang is a physical character on the path of elation whose specialty is using weal and woe lots in battle, which she uses to increase elation for allies, and grant everyone punchline any time she uses a skill. Diungkapkan bahwa her aptly named certified banger buff adds one extra instance of elation to teammates’ attacks. And her Ultimate grants the team Punchline, and triggers an extra Aha Instant.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the other new arrival is likewise a path of elation devotee. Sparxie is a suspiciously familiar streamer who uses her influencer skills in combat. When she fights, she turns the fight into a battle for attention, as she forces enemies to engage in a race for upvotes.

Berdasarkan laporan, when you consume skill points, sparxie will get gifts, which in turn cause her to regenerate skill points and punchlines for the team. You can continue doing this to increase your damage. When Aha Instant is triggered, Sparxie unleashes a lucky draw that deals damage to enemies with each bounce.

Berdasarkan laporan, she also benefits from the certified banger state, which causes the gifs she receives to deal more elation damage to a random enemy target. Her Ultimate also deals more Elation damage.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, version 4. 0 will see a few re-runs, too. Black Swan, Evernight, and Hysilens will be part of the first half's Warp events. The second half will see the return of Sparkle, Cerydra, and Rappa — that's right, HoYoverse have finally remembered Rappa exists, after one of the longest rerun waits in the game's history! Both Black Swan and Sparkle are getting a few tweaks to their kit with this version, too, so the timing works.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you log in after launch, you’ll get 20 free pulls and a new free outfit for ruan mei. Starting February 26, Kafka and Blade will join Epic’s battle royale shooter. You can also expect other customisation bits like Back Bling, Pickaxe, and more to be part of the package.

#491. Nvidia ensure unboxing a ludicrously expensive new graphics card isn't limited to real life in these RAM crisis times by releasing a GeForce 8800 GTX unpacking sim

Nvidia ensure unboxing a ludicrously expensive new graphics card isn't limited to real life in these RAM crisis times by releasing a GeForce 8800 GTX unpacking sim

Tanggal: 05 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/nvidia-ensure-unboxing-a-ludicrously-expensive-new-graphics-card-isnt-limited-to-real-life-in-these-ram-crisis-times-by-releasing-a-geforce-8800-gtx-unpacking-sim

Hey at least the card in this bit of 2006 nostalgia bait has only cost you a virtual arm and leg.

In what feels a fairly cheeky move during a time when memory shortages have infamously made it pretty much impossible to buy a decently powerful new graphics card without spending approximately a gazillion pounds/dollars/dollarpounds, Nvidia have decided to put out a Steam demo that allows folks to re-live the feeling of unboxing a ludicrously expensive graphics card in 2006.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the demo, dubbed geforce 8800 gtx - 20 years of a legend, has been developed by dylan browne. He previously made Through The Ages, a "real-time high end graphical cinematic that takes us on a nostalgic journey through three of NVIDIA's iconic GPUs" which is also on Steam for reasons.

Berdasarkan laporan, the geforce 8800 gtx demo, as you might've guessed, is a tribute to that specific card in the form of a tech demo simulating what it was like to unbox one in a mid-2000s bedroom. Seriously, there's a copy of Crysis on the desk so you know this is the domain of a true devotee to the best graphics available in around 2007.

Diungkapkan bahwa "step into a 2006-era pc gaming room, unbox the geforce 8800 gtx, inspect it up close, and install it in an era-accurate pc tower," the demo's description declares. 5 with Dynamic Multi Frame Generation, Ray Reconstruction, path tracing, and Mega Geometry bring the nostalgic setting to life. "Explore nods to GeForce history and hidden easter eggs as DLSS 4. From holding the card to the glow of the monitor, rediscover a moment in PC gaming history - or experience it for the first time!".

Berdasarkan laporan, as the geforce 8800 gtx was a top-line card that cost $599 on release in 2006 - about $1,000 in today's money if the online inflation calculator i've just used is on the money - this isn't really a 'we know cards are ludicrously expensive right now, but here's a reminder of when you used to be able to actually afford to unbox one' sort of demo. It is at least a free way to virtually experience having blown a chunk of your savings on something that can render really sexy textures without the existential dread of doing so in real life.

Diungkapkan bahwa well, i say that, i've just noticed the minimum requirements for the demo note that you'll need an rtx 4070 card. So, depending on your current setup, this might well be a case of Nvidia offering the chance to render unboxing a card you couldn't afford in 2006 via a card you can't afford in 2026.

Is that about the best we can all hope for in 2026? Probably.

#494. 10 Ocarina of Time Remake Changes That Break the Hearts of Nostalgic Fans

📅 12 Nov 2026

10 Ocarina of Time Remake Changes That Break the Hearts of Nostalgic Fans

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/ocarina-of-time-remake-changes-that-break-the-hearts-of-nostalgic-fans/

Diungkapkan bahwa covering the video games industry since 2017, with experience in news, articles, and reviews. Currently a writer at DualShockers and gaming magazines.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the remake of the legend of zelda: ocarina of time has brought one of the most beloved and iconic adventures in gaming history back to life with a revamped visual presentation, plenty of gameplay improvements, and a surprising number of small changes that make exploring hyrule feel fresh all over again. From quality-of-life improvements to the inventory and equipment systems to subtle environmental tweaks, there's literally a lot to appreciate about Nintendo's new take on this timeless classic.

However, as someone who grew up playing the original (and has an admittedly unhealthy amount of nostalgia running through my veins), I couldn't help but notice that some of the little things I loved are no longer around – or they are, but in a very different way.

Thomas Mahler believes Nintendo missed an opportunity to improve the level design in the Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake.

Don't get me wrong, I absolutely adore this remake and described it as a lovely modern remake with an old soul, but that doesn't mean I'm not allowed to miss a few things from my childhood, right? So, please allow me to put my nostalgic glasses on for a moment and revisit ten changes that have left a tiny hole in my heart.

Diungkapkan bahwa one of my favorite things about the original ocarina of time was starting a new save file and giving link the most ridiculous name i could think of. It was such a simple feature, but it opened the door to some quite hilarious moments, especially when characters started addressing the legendary hero using whatever silly name I'd come up with.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one of my personal favorites was naming him “bro. ” Suddenly, every conversation in Hyrule sounded like everyone was part of the most laid-back adventure imaginable.

Berdasarkan laporan, unfortunately, the remake has decided to put an end to our creative freedom by locking the protagonist's name to link. I can understand the reasoning, especially considering Nintendo's efforts to make the franchise more accessible to new generations and expand its presence across other media (since the live-action movie is coming hot). Still, I'll always miss my little adventures with Bro. You will be missed, buddy.

Berdasarkan laporan, one of the coolest easter eggs in the original ocarina of time was hidden in the courtyard where you first meet princess zelda. As Child Link, you must sneak past the castle guards to reach the princess without getting caught. Once you've had your little chat with her, however, there's nothing stopping you from exploring the area and discovering a few fun secrets.

Berdasarkan laporan, among them is a window you can shoot with your slingshot, prompting a particularly grumpy guard to throw a bomb in your direction (how rude!). But that's not all. If you look through the other windows, you'll find three familiar faces from the Super Mario universe: Mario, Luigi, and Bowser, all sporting their Super Mario 64 appearances.

Berdasarkan laporan, i was honestly expecting nintendo to bring this little crossover back using the characters' more modern designs, perhaps even their super mario odyssey models. It's a shame, considering how charming these little Nintendo Easter eggs can be. Instead, the entire reference has been removed from the remake. At least the guard is still there to throw a bomb at your face. Some traditions must be preserved, I suppose.

Berdasarkan laporan, if there's one thing every ocarina of time veteran knows, it's that rupees are important, and there's no shame in taking advantage of a good farming opportunity. One of the earliest places where you could stock up on some extra cash was a room inside Hyrule Castle's Market, conveniently filled with breakable pots.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as child link, you could simply walk inside, smash everything in sight, collect the rupees, leave, and come back to find the pots replenished. Rinse and repeat until your pockets were sufficiently full.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, unfortunately, the remake has decided that we shouldn't be allowed to get rich quite so easily. While you can still find some pots containing Rupees in the room, they no longer respawn simply by leaving the castle and coming back inside. Instead, you'll have to wait quite a while and spend some time doing other activities before they return. I guess we'll just have to go back to cutting grass like the rest of Hyrule's hardworking citizens.

I know what you're thinking – why on earth would anyone miss Kaepora Gaebora being annoying? But hear me out, I promise there's a reason behind my questionable opinion!.

Diungkapkan bahwa i also ain't a fan of the original owl. And if you've played the original, you know exactly how frustrating that could be. However, there was something strangely entertaining about collectively hating this overly talkative bird. In fact, I probably spent more time than I'd like to admit accidentally answering “No” when he asked whether I wanted to hear his explanation again. Kaepora became one of those characters that practically every Ocarina of Time player had a story about, and that shared frustration was part of the experience.

Sebagaimana diketahui, now, the remake has given him a much cuter appearance, and he's also significantly less annoying, behaving much more like the wise and mysterious owl he's supposed to be. I mean, where’s the fun in that? I can't help missing the days when simply seeing him fly toward me filled me with dread.

Ocarina of Time has plenty of memorable exploit tricks, but one of my personal favorites involved getting a Heart Piece much earlier than Nintendo originally intended.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in the original game, you could perform a particularly well-timed backflip from the top of death mountain, near the entrance to goron city, and land on the roof of dodongo's cavern. This allowed you to grab a Heart Piece that was normally intended for Adult Link, long before you were supposed to have access to it. It was just one of those silly little tricks that made exploring Hyrule feel even more rewarding.

Diungkapkan bahwa well, those days are over. The remake has adjusted the backflip's height, making it considerably less effective, and even tweaked the position of Dodongo's Cavern entrance to prevent players from pulling off the same trick (not that I tried to do it or anything).

From suspicious house designs to familiar songs, fans think they've found clues.

Diungkapkan bahwa there's an unwritten rule among players: the moment you unlock the hookshot, you must immediately equip it and start shooting at everything in sight. And one of your first destinations will probably be the rooftops of Kakariko Village.

Berdasarkan laporan, this was really fun because it offered more freedom than simply using it to reach the obvious targets. Apparently, however, that wasn't quite what Nintendo had in mind. You could experiment with different surfaces, discover unexpected ways to navigate the environment, and generally mess around with an incredibly useful piece of equipment. The remake has restricted the Hookshot's functionality, meaning it can now only latch onto specific designated targets, such as stone markers and certain treasure chests.

Berdasarkan laporan, i understand that this might have been done to prevent unintended shortcuts or make progression more controlled, but i can't help feeling that something has been lost in the process. One of the most enjoyable aspects of Ocarina of Time was experimenting with your equipment and discovering creative ways to use it. So, please, Nintendo, give us our old Hookshot back!.

One of my most vivid childhood memories of Ocarina of Time involves something that probably sounds completely ridiculous to anyone who didn't grow up playing the original: stepping into Hyrule Field for the very first time and desperately running toward Hyrule Castle like a lunatic.

That happened because, if night fell before we reached the castle gates, they would close, leaving Link stranded outside until morning – and Hyrule Field at night was not exactly the safest place to be.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and you’ve guessed: the remake has removed this particular inconvenience, meaning you no longer have to worry about being locked out of hyrule castle after sunset. My adult self appreciates not having to deal with that little problem, but the child in me misses those frantic nighttime sprints.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there's something wonderfully weird about the little laboratory at lake hylia. Inside, you'll find a rather eccentric scientist who spends most of his time complaining about his back pain while standing next to a water tank.

Diungkapkan bahwa he'll even offer you a reward if you manage to dive deep enough to touch the bottom of the pool. Naturally, being the helpful hero that you are, you'll want to give it a try. But once you reach the bottom, you'll discover something rather unexpected: a shark inside a cage.

Sebagaimana diketahui, what made this little discovery even funnier in the original game was the shark itself! rather than featuring a detailed 3d model, it was represented by a hilariously low-resolution, static image. While the remake has kept the shark in the aquarium, unfortunately, it has also given it a proper visual upgrade. It looked so out of place that it became one of those bizarre little details you simply couldn't forget. Sure, it looks considerably better now, but I miss the ridiculous charm of that pixelated little creature.

If there's one thing Ocarina of Time does exceptionally well, it's turning a seemingly innocent adventure into a horror game without any warning! One moment you're exploring a dungeon and collecting treasures, and the next you're desperately running for your life from something that looks like it escaped from your worst nightmare.

Few enemies capture that feeling better than the Wallmaster, a giant disembodied hand that suddenly drops from the ceiling, grabs Link, and sends him all the way back to the beginning of the area or dungeon.

Diungkapkan bahwa and what made this enemy so terrifying in the original was the anticipation. The remake preserves most of these elements, but introduces one rather important difference: a spotlight that illuminates the area whenever it’s about to appear. You couldn't simply look up to check whether it was coming, so you had to rely on an increasingly unsettling sound effect and the shadow that gradually appeared above Link. Combined with its shadow, this makes the enemy practically announce its arrival in the most dramatic way possible.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i appreciate the warning, but i honestly miss the uncertainty that made these encounters so frightening in the original. Thankfully, the Dead Hand is absolutely nightmare-inducing in the remake, so I'll let this one slide.

Remember the Water Temple? If you played the original Ocarina of Time back in the day, there's a good chance that simply reading those two words made you feel a little uncomfortable.

Berdasarkan laporan, for years, this dungeon had a reputation for being one of the most frustrating experiences in the entire game. Between constantly changing the water level and switching between the Iron Boots and other equipment, it was enough to test even the most patient players.

Diungkapkan bahwa there was also a particularly nasty small key hidden underneath the floor of the central pillar, which could only be accessed after raising the water level. It was incredibly easy to overlook, and if you ever found yourself seemingly stuck with no idea how to progress, there's a good chance this little key was the culprit!.

Diungkapkan bahwa despite keeping most of the original dungeon's layout intact, the remake has made things considerably easier by removing this easily missed small key altogether. This means players no longer have to spend ages retracing their steps and wondering whether they've somehow managed to softlock their game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, of course, the water temple is still a memorable dungeon, and i'm certainly not complaining about a more streamlined experience. But I do find it funny that an entire generation of players had to suffer through those confusing corridors just so newcomers could have a slightly more pleasant time! You're welcome, younger Zelda fans. We fought in the trenches so you wouldn't have to.

Eiji Aonuma and the development team for the Ocarina of Time remake discussed how one of the original's infamous dungeons is being improved.

The MMA fighter and failed Irish presidential candidate had a small role in the 2016 shooter.

Diungkapkan bahwa when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, call of duty doesn't have much luck with its stunt casting. Two years after Infinity Ward put Kevin Spacey in Advanced Warfare—before he was accused of sexual assault—it turned MMA fighter Conor McGregor into a future soldier, Captain Bradley Fillion, in Infinite Warfare.

McGregor's role was quite small, despite being one of the game's antagonists, and ended in his character's demise, but co-directors Jordan Hirsh and Taylor Kurosaki didn't want to cut any corners when it came to the mo-cap.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i got to work with conor mcgregor, and the story about conor mcgregor… we shot that in either 2015 or early 2016, but this is the height of him as a ufc fighter. And so of course I wanted him to do something really physical, to demonstrate how capable he is. He's shorter than me, but I was trying to explain to him the choreography that I wanted him to do at the beginning there, where he smashes the guy, and he grabbed me and flipped me onto the ground—very gently. And then did this punch [right in front of my face] that I could feel the wind from.

Sebagaimana diketahui, at the time, co-directors hirsh and kurosaki were trying to shake things up in regards to mo-cap. "I think for every game they had done before that, you would maybe do some mocap or a cool takedown or a finisher, and then you'd have actors that would come into a VO booth and you'd have them come in one at a time and they'd read their lines and it’d be stitched together and then you're done. "I think that the folks at Infinity Ward probably thought I was a little crazy when I came in," Kurosaki tells us. And they built a performance capture stage specifically for this project. ".

With Infinite Warfare, the team was doing full performance capture, so it needed its actors to get more physical.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, kurosaki remembers, after mcgregor flipped him, that he "did this punch [right in front of my face] that i could feel the wind from. My body was just doing something that I couldn't control. Everyone on the stage was, ‘Whoa, that was crazy! It was so fast!’ And of course, I had a different perspective than everyone else. We're just rehearsing and figuring out the blocking. And then all of a sudden, this giant bead of sweat starts running down my face. I had this adrenaline, even though I knew I was perfectly safe. Then everyone was laughing, and he helped me up, and I'm laughing. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa a few years later, mcgregor started racking up criminal charges for assault. In 2019, he attacked a man for not accepting a drink in a Dublin pub. He pleaded guilty. He was not prosecuted, but a civil claim was made against him by Nikita Hand. In the same year, police in Ireland started investigating McGregor over allegations of multiple sexual assaults. In 2024, an Irish jury found that McGregor raped Hand.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, also in 2024, mcgregor starred in hitman, as one of its celebrity elusive targets—his second videogame role outside of the ufc games. IO Interactive stopped working with him after the ruling and removed him from the game as an Elusive Target.

Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team.

Diungkapkan bahwa activision, unlike io, left mcgregor in the infinite warfare campaign. Prior to the ruling, he was a playable fighter in EA's UFC games, starting in 2014. The fighter has not made any other videogame appearances since then. He was the co-cover athlete in 2016's UFC 2 and the solo cover athlete in 2018's UFC 3. His last appearance in the series was in UFC 5 in 2023.

Sebagaimana diketahui, mcgregor has had no scripted television cameos since 2024, appearing strictly as himself for promotional spots and interviews—including a guest appearance on the tonight show starring jimmy fallon in june 2026. Fallon and NBC were heavily criticised for inviting McGregor onto the show. He is also attached to host and executive-produce a Fox Nation competition series titled World's Baddest Man, slated for 2027.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this is a cute collect things and make creatures game. But they lost me at the hard-to-get fish. Goddess of Victory: Nikke's PC launcher suffers potential malware infection, with its publishers suggesting folks who've booted since late September do a security check

Tanggal: 05 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/goddess-of-victory-nikkes-pc-launcher-suffers-potential-malware-infection-with-its-publishers-suggesting-folks-whove-booted-since-late-september-do-a-security-check

A cruel twist for the Shift Up-developed epic shooter RPG of cruel humanity destiny.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, goddess of victory: nikke, a gacha shooter/rpg developed by stellar blade makers shift up, has suffered a "security incident" which has seen its pc launcher potentially be infected with third-party malware. Thankfully, it seems a patch to make the launcher safe again has been quickly dished out, but publishers Level Infinite are still advising players who've booted the game up since September 27th to do some security checks.

Diungkapkan bahwa "we have identified that some files in the nikke windows pc launcher were recently tampered with by a third party, potentially allowing malicious programs to run when the launcher was launched," the developers of the game with anime girls who - judging by the promo art - breast boobily announced yesterday. "As a result, your PCs and account information may have been exposed to security risks.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "we are continuing to investigate the extent of the potential damage and review appropriate response measures. We are also conducting a thorough review of our network security environment, including our CDN, to determine how the PC launcher files were compromised. We will take all necessary precautions to prevent further damage and ensure that this issue does not happen again. We deeply regret that this security incident has caused Commanders significant concern and distress, when our responsibility should have been to provide a safe gaming environment. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa in order to try and help players "scan for and remove the malicious programs distributed in this incident", publishers level infinite have added a feature to nikke's official pc client that does just that. They're advising that anyone who's booted up the game at least once after September 27th at 15:41 (UTC+9) use that or perform a manual security check.

Berdasarkan laporan, once that's done, affected players are advised to change the passwords for any accounts they've used on the pc they used to boot the launcher, as well as generate new api keys and access tokens. "If you believe you may have been affected by this issue or suffered from any loss, please contact our customer support team. "We take very seriously the possibility that this incident may have affected not only your gaming experience but also your PC, accounts with external services, and personal assets," Level Infinite added. We will review each inquiry carefully and respond as promptly as possible. ".

Going forwards, they plan to improve their monitoring "so that any unauthorized file modifications or security threats can be detected early and addressed promptly", as well as "establish an integrity verification system for external resources accessed by the PC launcher" and ensure the launcher only requires "the minimum permissions necessary".

Here's hoping the studio are able to keep things more secure in the future and that affected players are able to get rid of any malware with minimal suffering or inconvenience.

Berdasarkan laporan, so i've been utterly consumed by wow: forever, which is a relief, because it's my job to write about it—and i've been powering ahead to 40, where a deeply oldschool grind to get my first mount awaits me. Before that, though, I had an absolutely lovely time futzing around The Riverglades, one of WoW: Forever's properly bespoke zones. As in, this thing wasn't in vanilla. This was cooked up and released in November.

Having quested through most of it in a blissful fugue state with some friends, we each came to the conclusion that it all feels very 2007, rather than 2006.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the riverglades, which you can head to at about level 38, is saturated with quests. Even more so than the revamped and revisited zones from vanilla World of Warcraft. And while it absolutely has the classic zone's sense of scale, and none of these quests have the retail aura of on-rails cutscenes about them, I wasn't actually tasting vanilla.

One of the hallmarks of older, classic-style quest design is a bunch of disparate quests that have you scattering out towards the map—Riverglades, then, feels a lot more modern, in that it uses that scattershot point-of-interest guide as a baseline, then cleverly tucks away even more quests at your destination.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in one case, fighting through a ruined village flooded with twilight's blade, me and my compatriot saw a quest marker underground. It took ages for us to find a basement, which then yawned out into an open cavern with shadow-infused ogres and a cunning woman trapped in a cage with her own quest chain.

Diungkapkan bahwa at which point it clicked: oh, i'm playing the burning crusade again. The template was classic, sure, but the density and the branching paths and the clever redirects—that's all Outland, baby. There's even a set of swampy flats in the middle of The Riverglades pock-marked by orcish poachers that made me say, out loud: Oh, I'm in Nagrand again. Just without the floating islands.

And you know what, having had this unexpectedly adjacent nostalgic experience, I didn't hate it.

Zenelss Zone Zero's Encore for an Old Dream has a good excuse for introducing some new mechanics to the action game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, zenless zone zero’s latest special program has delivered a tonne of information about the game’s big upcoming update, version 2. 6. This latest addition kicks off celebrations in New Eridu, and it’s dubbed Encore for an Old Dream.

Sebagaimana diketahui, version 2. 6 is not far off, either, arriving in ZZZ on February 6 - exactly one week from today. Encore for an Old Dream is something of an in-between story that takes place after the end of Season 2.

Berdasarkan laporan, the narrative of 2. 6 sees the Proxies’ return to Sixth Street for New Eridu's annual Gilded Carrot Day. At the centre of the celebrations is the debut of idol group Angels of Delusion at the 404 Error music venue, but not all is as it seems.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the story follows the proxies getting invited backstage to support the group, which also includes helping them set up practice schedules, organise events and manage social media activities. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, angels of delusion is also the group that the two new agents being introduced in this update belong to. Members of the same group are capable of performing coordinated attacks. The new arrivals are Sunna and Aria.

Sunna and Aria also benefit from the support of the amusingly named Bangboo Biggest Fan, a fan club president who can heal them over time, and boost the squad’s Attack any time two or more Angels of Delusion members are present.

Sebagaimana diketahui, version 2. 6’s S-Rank re-runs are Yixuan (Auric Ink - Rupture), and Yuzuha (Physical - Support), who you can look forward to as part of the banners.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, version 2. 6 will also expand Hollow Zero with a new game mode, Operation Matrix. The mode offers themed stages that rotate weekly, each offering new mechanics. You can now also Sweep in Hollow Zero.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, beyond all the celebrations, this update also brings combat kit overhauls to a couple of older s-rank characters, lycaon and harumasa. You can look forward to multiple limited-time events, too, including one where you can earn a new outfit for Pan Yinhu.

Berdasarkan laporan, the big event is naturally going to be themed around gilded carrot day, and it actually starts today. #509. The Video Games And More You Should Play This Weekend – October 30, 2026

📅 30 Oct 2026

The Video Games And More You Should Play This Weekend – October 30, 2026

Tanggal: 30 Oct 2026 | Sumber: https://gameinformer.com/opinion/2026/10/30/the-video-games-and-more-you-should-play-this-weekend-october-30-2026

Sebagaimana diketahui, welcome to devil's night, the night before halloween, where video games are best served scary. At least not until mid-September, 2027. After tomorrow night – Halloween proper – no more scary video games allowed. I'm sorry, I don't make the rules. Below you will find our weekend gaming recommendations (which is actually surprisingly light on scary games – apologies), but before that, here are some of the biggest stories of the week.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, phantom blade zero is one of the best action games i’ve ever played, and it’s certainly one of the most impressive to watch. It will constantly leave you in awe that action combat can look this good. Fortunately, Phantom Blade Zero delivers on all fronts, with weapon mechanics so detailed that picking up a new blade can feel like unlocking a new character in a fighting game. Beijing-based developer S-Game uses China’s Wuxia brand of action (which was actually banned for some time during the 20th Century by the country’s government) to create a stylish, fluid, and hyper-engaging combat system. The story won’t blow your socks off, but it’s certainly engaging and enticing enough to bring you through Phantom Blade Zero’s 40 or so hours of content. But looks aren’t everything. If you’re not interested in the “perfect ending,” which is the only satisfactory one in my opinion, you can complete the game in less than 30 hours. S-Game mixes high-octane combat with sprawling and rewarding exploration to create a must-play during this already busy season of games. You can read more of my thoughts in the Game Informer Phantom Blade Zero review, and if you are hopping in this weekend, be sure to check out my list of Phantom Blade Zero tips and tricks I wish I knew before starting it.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you have any fond memories of illfonic’s ill-fated friday the 13th: the game as i do, you simply must play the studio’s latest, halloween: the game. It is essentially Friday the 13th with Michael Myers instead of Jason, but with a decade of lessons learned from the team’s teeth carving in other horror properties and games. You’re either Michael or a citizen; the former wants to kill you and all the NPCs in various suburban maps, while the latter must rescue as many NPCs as possible while staying alive themselves. It’s that classic cat-and-mouse formula IllFonic is the master of, but with all the style, substance, and synths of John Carpenter’s Halloween masterpiece. Plus, Halloween: The Game features IllFonic’s first crack at a single-player campaign, and while it’s largely a tutorial for playing as Michael, if you’re a Halloween mega-fan like me, it’s worth checking out if only to take part in some of the film’s most iconic kills. You can read more of my thoughts in the Game Informer Halloween: The Game review here, and if you’re hopping in this weekend, there’s a new map, additional Halloween-themed cosmetics to unlock, and more waiting for you.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, overwatch is in the midst of its halloween event, which have always historically been pretty interesting. It can get really chaotic where by round three characters like Orisa might be three times her normal size or Torbjorn might have placed a giant turret on Mercy's making her a flying death machine. In it, you begin by picking one of three characters in a random role. This year it's Mystery Madness: Graveyard Games. And then, as the game progresses, you choose perks that upgrade, alter, or completely change what your character can do. There are also Halloween skins, as well.

Diungkapkan bahwa tom the postgirl is an odd little adventure that i'd recommend to fans of untitled goose game. You never know what each window might reveal, and I quickly sympathized with (and enabled) Tom's compulsion. You also have the capacity to cause quite a bit of trouble by stomping on flowers, haphazardly snipping strings and cords, or even stealing packages and using them for your own mischievous purposes. On the surface, you're delivering packages, but the game's real story is based on Tom's tendency to peep where she shouldn't, peering into townsfolks' windows to watch their odd lives. On house is full of kids who live like dogs; another has a couple with a bizarre obsession with tickling. You play as Tom, a creepy girl who's tasked with delivering packages to the people of her wacky town, which is depicted with storybook-style illustrations and a color palette limited to black, white, and red. It's a pretty short experience, completable in just a few hours, making it a nice palate cleanser between the massive releases at the end of the year.

Berdasarkan laporan, this devolver digital-published game has a simple but head-turning premise. You’re a profoundly angry woman who returns to her small hometown armed with nothing but a sledgehammer, which she uses to smash everything in sight. The town is also inhabited by robots possessing human consciousnesses. Swinging the hammer can either punch holes through walls or, with enough force, reduce entire buildings to rubble. But why is she doing this? Why is she so mad? A big part of Virtue and a Sledgehammer’s allure is its fascinating and well-written tale about the protagonist’s strained relationships with her sister and mother. Learning more about their lives requires you to keep smashing, but the more you learn, the more you begin to question whether smashing everything is actually a good idea.

Berdasarkan laporan, this bizarre indie blends fun match-3 puzzle-solving with tower defense gameplay wrapped around a funny but surreal story. The match-3 gameplay involves sliding tiles to match geographic elements like castles, trees, and rivers to collect resources that feed into the tower defense portion. Depending on how the board looks when the puzzle portion ends, you send troops (sustained by the resources you collected) to attack/defend against rival castles and gather more items; board positioning determines how well this can go. The two mechanics feed into each other to create a fun loop that grows in complexity as new mechanics are introduced. Did I mention the game is also very weird? The silly tale centers on a medieval court designating you the chosen savior to rescue their lost queen (and many other tasks), and the dumb tone adds personality to a sometimes dry genre. Titanium Court charmed and impressed us when it launched on PC earlier this year, and now console and mobile players get their chance to hold court.

Berdasarkan laporan, sword of the sea is a beautiful, 2025 game about surfing through the sand atop a floating sword. Giant Squid also made 2016's Abzû and 2020's The Pathless. And now you can play it on Switch 2. It recalls Journey, the emotional 2012 PlayStation game, which makes sense as it comes from the artists and developers that worked on that game, developer Giant Squid. It's a talented team and Sword of the Sea maintains that reputation. You can read my full review of the game (though this review pertains to the PlayStation 5 version) right here.

Berdasarkan laporan, cities: skylines arrived on pc more than a decade ago, but is still revered as one of the greatest modern city-builders. Even now, three years after the sequel's release, Paradox continues supporting and porting the original game. As of this week, Switch 2 owners can play a less compromised version, expanding the Switch's 9-tile limit to a much larger 25-tile limit, as well as better performance and textures, better control panels, and a ton of DLC and added content. A couple years after its initial release, Cities: Skylines received a strong console port, which did an admirable job of adapting the controls to gamepads, but the Switch version was always the weakest of the bunch. And on top of that, if you own the Switch 1 version, you get a deep discount on the Switch 2 version.

While not specifically about this new Switch 2 version, you can read our original reviews of the base PC version here, and the base console version here.

Berdasarkan laporan, minecraft has held its dominant spot in pop culture for so long that it's easy to forget a simple fact about it: the game is awesome. The opening gameplay loop is so satisfying that for many of my peers, whether they regularly play video games or not, it's only a matter of time before they boot up a new world again. You've certainly heard of it, and you've probably played it, but I still feel it often doesn't get the flowers it deserves in high-level critical discussions about games, despite its regular cadence of major updates. While you can never play the game for the first time again, if you haven't checked it out in a couple years, you might be surprised by the amount of new blocks, materials, and mobs they've added in recent updates. This week, it's coming to Switch 2, giving potential miners another platform to explore procedurally-generated caves in. And if you've never played before, the Switch 2 launch is as good a time as any to see what all the fuss is about.

Diungkapkan bahwa the card game incarnation of arkham horror remains one of the best narrative-driven and horror-themed tabletop games around, and it's an easy recommendation if you're looking for something engaging to dive into on halloween night. Rooted in the monsters and mysteries of the Cthulhu Mythos, this living card game is built on major core sets and expansions. But unlike a TCG, each new installment has the same cards included, fueling the cooperative adventures you'll undertake together with your fellow players. Last year Arkham Horror: The Card Game did something of a soft relaunch for a chapter 2 of its narrative, and that new core set is an ideal place to jump on  play. Players each control an individual investigator as they explore arcane and weird mysteries, confront monsters, and unfold plots of cultists, ancient entities, and forbidden lore. For fans of cosmic horror storytelling, it's an easy pick.

#510. Jensen Huang’s Departure from NVIDIA Sparks Hope of a Gaming Pivot

📅 12 Nov 2026

Jensen Huang’s Departure from NVIDIA Sparks Hope of a Gaming Pivot

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/jensen-huang-s-departure-from-nvidia-sparks-hope-of-a-gaming-pivot/

Contributor at DualShockers, former Esports Insider DACH content lead, former Escapist Magazine Germany content lead, software engineering background.

Sebagaimana diketahui, nvidia has announced that co-founder jensen huang has resigned as president, ceo and board member, effective immediately. The announcement didn’t give a reason, although it obviously arrived after very public reports of extramarital affairs, one of them reportedly with a woman US intelligence officials suspect of being a Chinese spy. CFO Colette Kress has been named interim CEO whilst continuing as CFO, with Harvey Jones becoming the board’s first-ever chair. Neither NVIDIA nor Huang has confirmed the reporting, but investors reacted regardless, with shares falling as much as 14% at the open.

Masato Kumzawa addresses fan reactions to Grace Ashcroft's design and the impact of NVIDIA's DLSS 5 AI technology.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ultimately, i’m not that interested in the gossip. What interests me far more is what happens to a company that has spent the last few years being defined by one man’s bet on AI, and whether that opens the door for the side of the business that first made NVIDIA a household name. For anyone who has tried to buy a graphics card recently, that is a rather important question.

Berdasarkan laporan, huang co-founded nvidia in 1993 and ran it for more than 33 years, with the move into ai being very much his decision. It has paid off enormously, because data centres now make up roughly 91. 5% of the company’s revenue. The flip side is that nobody else has been quite as closely tied to that strategy, which makes for some interesting possibilities for NVIDIA’s future.

Berdasarkan laporan, kress has been cfo since 2013 and is a well-respected voice with the market, and etoro’s josh gilbert described her as a familiar and trusted presence, whilst adding that a company known for its technical edge might want an engineer in the chair. Analyst Dan Ives expects her stint as interim CEO to last around a year before NVIDIA looks outside. NVIDIA’s company structure is interesting in that it doesn’t make finding a solution any easier: Huang had more than 60 people reporting to him directly.

Sebagaimana diketahui, nvidia has no coo, and reports suggest there was no succession plan in place. The internal names analysts have put forward, such as Ian Buck, Bill Dally, Michael Kagan and Bryan Catanzaro, are largely AI and data centre figures, but none of them has been the face of the strategy in the way Huang was. Constellation Research’s Ray Wang pointed out that many of NVIDIA’s partnerships and investments came about because people trusted Jensen.

Diungkapkan bahwa which brings me to the hopium. NVIDIA started out making graphics cards for gamers, and CNBC has pointed out that those gamers helped keep the company afloat back in 1999 by buying the GeForce 256. These days they account for under 10% of revenue, and it shows: RTX 50-series production was reportedly cut by up to 40% earlier this year, the Super refresh was reportedly shelved, and the next generation has reportedly drifted towards 2028. Meanwhile, the RTX 5090 launched at $1,999 and third-party sellers have been asking far more than that ever since.

Nvidia DLSS 5 is officially supported in 2K27, but eager fans have found their own way to enable the software in a myriad of titles.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, so it isn’t hard to see why some gamers are hoping the board promotes someone with roots on that side of the business. Jeff Fisher, SVP of GeForce, has been at NVIDIA since 1994, but it is obvious that Kress is probably the safer bet for investors. Jonah Alben, who has led GPU engineering since 2008, and co-founder Chris Malachowsky might also throw a hat into this race. It is however important to note that all of this is still very much speculation: nobody at NVIDIA has hinted at a gaming pivot, and whether that will happen with any likeliness will be heavily dependent on other factors.

Berdasarkan laporan, truth be told, i wouldn’t expect a new ceo to change much straight away, even one with a soft spot for gaming. The memory shortage squeezing GeForce is affecting the entire industry, with Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron reportedly prioritising AI customers for their high-bandwidth memory, and that won’t disappear because of who is sitting in the corner office.

Sebagaimana diketahui, whoever takes over will also inherit a company that has just lost its founder and a fair amount of investor confidence, which tends to make boards cautious rather than adventurous. Even so, I’d quite like to see someone in charge who remembers where GeForce came from, and who has some sympathy for the people still trying to buy one. For now, Kress is running both the company and its finances whilst the search for a permanent CEO gets under way.

New York Times report on Jensen Huang's unclear relationship with an alleged Chinese spy, Alice Huang.

Diungkapkan bahwa rizzo said: “jensen’s interactions with ms. Huang are not unusual or unexpected. Meetings with customers are part of a CEO’s job; Jensen talks with thousands of customer executives every year. ”.

Jensen is called to a meeting with the various national security and foreign affairs committee leaders in US Congress on November 18.

Berdasarkan laporan, on the meeting for this agenda is alice huang: jensen's relationship with her and whether she could have collected sensitive information about us technology. It's also about Nvidia's security protocols.

This presumably puts some pressure on Huang and Nvidia to be seen to take action.

Jensen Huang and Nvidia's board put out statements at the same time on Nvidia's newsroom.

Berdasarkan laporan, jensen's statement admits he was having an affair with an unnamed person. He apologises to wife and family, his staff, and says he has fallen short of his responsibility to them.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "nvidia’s board of directors has initiated an independent investigation. I support the investigation and will cooperate fully. The board of Nvidia focuses on the reports of a "foreign intelligence effort" against the company's CEO and launches an independent investigation to check.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "while the board has no reason to believe that either national security or nvidia secrets were compromised, the board's inquiry will examine all available information. Jensen fully supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it. ".

The share price for Nvidia drops: around 21% since October 28, the day prior to the initial New York Times report.

Diungkapkan bahwa donald trump speaks to press about his pal, jensen huang. He's generally very positive and seems to back the Nvidia CEO.

Nvidia hires law firm Wachtell Lipton to lead Jensen Huang affair probe.

Sebagaimana diketahui, report by the information suggests alice huang facilitated some 240k ai gpus, largely at-the-time banned h100 and h200 chips, roughly costing around $7. 5B.

Jensen Huang has resigned from his position as CEO of Nvidia, effective immediately.

Sebagaimana diketahui, export rules between the us and china go back to biden and that administration's trade war. The US had previously blocked China from accessing the latest in lithographic chipmaking machines, but started to go further into exports of high-end chips.

Diungkapkan bahwa in 2022, the us decided to halt exports of the very best datacentre chips to china, followed by limitations to the export of other certain gpus from october, 2023. This bans the RTX 4090 and other capable cards based on performance density and total processing power.

Sebagaimana diketahui, nvidia and amd circumvent the ban with chips with limits to slide in under the new regulations, ie. the H20 and MI308. The secretary of commerce at the time, Gina Raimondo, didn't like that much.

Sebagaimana diketahui, once donald trump is back in the white house, he proclaims a new policy that will "identify and eliminate loopholes in existing export controls. " Later that same year, the president allows sale of some GPUs to China in return for 15% of AMD and Nvidia's China revenue.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this seems to clear up, though, as recent nyt report suggests the us is approving sales of nvidia ai chips to companies in china. Sebagaimana diketahui, china wants homegrown tech. It wants to make its own chips, own chipmaking machines, and lessen dependence on the US—which makes sense, as for the past half-decade, it couldn't reliably get hold of advanced US chips; longer still, advanced lithographic machines.

So, for the better part of five years, and the AI boom, Chinese companies can't officially get their hands on many top AI chips.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, some chose to bypass export controls put in place by successive us administrations. This has led to counts and convictions for chip smuggling over the years.

#520. Valve explains why it's running behind on Steam game approvals, asks developers to perform basic release checks to prevent re-reviews

📅 05 Nov 2026

Valve explains why it's running behind on Steam game approvals, asks developers to perform basic release checks to prevent re-reviews

Tanggal: 05 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/steam-games-approvals-delayed-valve-response

In the wake of witnessing an unprecedented number of game submissions to Steam over the last few months, Valve has been forced to delay approvals in order to deal with the existing backlog.

Diungkapkan bahwa following complaints by game developers on social media and elsewhere, valve has now responded to explain why it's taking longer to get games approved. The short version: re-reviews are clogging up the system.

Diungkapkan bahwa "we aim to test every game build in a timely manner, typically within three-five business days," valve wrote in a steam post. "However, we're running a little behind right now and taking up to 12 business days. Much of that delay is due to having to re-review games, which isn't great for you or for us. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa as valve explained in the post, games need to be re-reviewed when they're rejected for missing key quality assurance checks. In an effort to make it easier for developers to get it right the first time, Valve updated the Steam release checklist to include new, tighter requirements.

Sebagaimana diketahui, these include a requirement to run the game through steam for at least five minutes. According to Valve, some of the games submitted have not been played through Steam.

"This means that even if a game runs smoothly when a dev launches their executable directly, they might have missed basic steps that would impact a user installing and playing via Steam," Valve explained.

Sebagaimana diketahui, valve is also making it a rule to mention whether the game requires common redistributables such as directx, visual c++,. While Steam can automatically install many common redistributables, it needs to know which ones are needed (if any). NET, XNA. There are also new rules about achievement readiness, cloud save detection, and some updates to Steam store page requirements.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "we now surface some of the most common issues we see missed, along with asking for some information to help our reviewers from the start," valve added. "For example, if your game offers multiple languages and you've indicated that on your store page, we'll ask you to ensure you've included them in your build".

While Valve did not directly name gen-AI as a potential reason for this rise in the number of poor submissions, it's clear the Steam company needs to find a way to deal with the massive number of AI-assisted games.

Sebagaimana diketahui, valve recently addressed steam's ai game cloning problem by suggesting developers make their games less copyable. Incidentally, some of the developers whose game approvals are delayed now fear their games will be cloned by others using gen-AI and land a Steam page before the original article has made it out of submission.

Unionised workers reiterate call for a "solid offer" for Arkane Lyon's future.

Diungkapkan bahwa unionised workers at dishonored developers arkane lyon have published a fresh statement about the progress of negotiations with microsoft over the studio's potential closure. Aside from calling on Xbox management to make a redundancy offer proportionate to Microsoft's colossal market value, they accuse the parent company of creating the very economic conditions cited as a reason for closing Arkane, and thereby "sabotaging" development of the forthcoming Marvel's Blade.

Sebagaimana diketahui, published by french union le syndicat des travailleureuses du jeu vidéo - one of two unions who represent workers at arkane, the other being printemps écologique, who didn't issue a similar message - the official english translation of the statement begins by insisting that "work on blade is going fine". It maintains that the game will measure up to previous Arkane Lyon releases, despite the stress of trying to pin down a new owner for the company, after Microsoft announced plans to part ways with Arkane and several other studios back in July. The writers then take Microsoft to task for making an "outrageously low" redundancy offer to Arkane's workers, and further accuse the Xbox company of essentially setting Arkane up to fail by imposing a hiring freeze and depriving the studio of resources.

Berdasarkan laporan, "microsoft chose to justify the closure on economic reasons," the workers write. " It asserts that Microsoft froze hiring "for 19 months, which artificially caused delay and additional cost", only to then use those delays and extra costs "as a reason to close down the studio". "But Microsoft is actually why those economic reasons even exist. It also claims that Microsoft have "systematically" deprived Arkane of cash, by means of corporate mechanisms the statement doesn't make wholly clear. "Even this closure itself is done against any financial logic, as closing Arkane today would probably be more expensive than finishing the game," the statement adds, without going into detail.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "the truth is that microsoft based its decision only on stone cold and inhuman logic, in which our lives, projects and dreams are voided, so we can better serve microsoft’s short term financial goals," the workers continue. "Arkane is profitable," they add. They accuse Microsoft of "the brutal application of a never-ending search for maximum profit optimization", citing years of mass layoffs across the Xbox company together with the recent voluntary buyout offering. "Just not profitable enough for Microsoft. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the workers want a "solid offer" from microsoft regarding the studio's post-xbox future, declaring that "when the company who decided that arkane has to shut down is, according to many sources the most profitable in the world, with a net profit of more than 133 billions of dollars in the past years, it would be the bare minimum to ensure that the redundancy plan offered by microsoft is on [par] with their means. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if arkane have to close, the unionised workers call on microsoft "to release funds commensurate with microsoft’s status as a corporation, to make sure that the workers are compensated in line with the loss suffered". They'd like a redundancy payment of €200,000, two years of "redeployment support", a package of "shared resources for training and studio creation", including a residual bonus, and "compensation up to the redundancy payment for independent workers’ contract breach", to safeguard the livelihoods of freelancers and contractors.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the warring parties at xbox and arkane have until 11th december this year to figure out a deal. Reportedly, Ubisoft are among those looking to buy Arkane - a source of some concern, given that Ubisoft have also recently closed a number of studios and laid many people off. "Nvidia Board of Directors announced today that Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately," a statement on Nvidia's newsroom says.

Jensen Huang has been embroiled in a scandal, or rather a couple of scandals, over the past few weeks.

The share price for the company had already plummeted to its lowest levels since June 2025 following a report that the company's board was considering ousting Huang.

Berdasarkan laporan, "colette kress, current executive vice president and chief financial officer of nvidia, has agreed to serve as interim chief executive officer. The Board is initiating a search for a permanent Chief Executive Officer and will consider internal and external candidates. Huang has also resigned from his position as president and from his board seat, which may ease some concerns in recent days that his significant stake and power in the company would be tough to expunge should the company board try to push him out.

Diungkapkan bahwa 2026 has been home to a swath of large-scale layoffs throughout the gaming industry, mostly in the western sector. Diungkapkan bahwa while these industry vets have lost the ample funding that comes with a major backer like microsoft, they have, in turn, gained substantial freedom in how they pursue their projects. This is one of the stated benefits of the studio’s formation, as outlined on the “How We Work” section of the Hidden Horses website.

Berdasarkan laporan, “the company was created as a developer run and owned studio,” the page reads. “This allows us to pursue fun and creativity in our games, unencumbered by short-term thinking or chasing market trends. ”.

They have gained substantial freedom in how they pursue their projects.

Diungkapkan bahwa the team considers this structure optimal because helps them make games right, rather than make them quickly, creating new and interesting gameplay concepts rather than trying to flip half-baked products for a quick buck. The team is firmly of the belief that, despite changes in the industry and players, there is still very much a demand for the kinds of carefully-designed games that they’re accustomed to creating.

After being cut off by its previous publisher, Romero Games has secured a fresh bout of funding and refocused with a smaller dev team.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the page also notes that the studio will be run democratically, with input from every member of the team on all important business decisions, all to ensure nobody gets left out in the cold. “We do this not only because we think it is fair, but because we think it is a better way to run a business. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa despite having just formed, hidden horses already has irons in the fire. On the “Our First Project” page of the website, the studio outlines its plans for its very first game development project. This game, titled Danger Pay, will be a “high-octane single-player FPS” set in a malevolent, futuristic game show in a manner reminiscent of Smash TV and The Running Man.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “our game will focus on classic fps gameplay, awesome weapons, crazy enemies, and will be highly optimized. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, of course, financial backing for an entirely new game project doesn’t come out of nowhere, which is why the plan for this first project is to fund it via kickstarter. A page for Danger Pay has already been created, though there’s no word yet on when the campaign will actually begin.

Berdasarkan laporan, “we believe that the community around the type of games we have helped develop is robust, and we invite all supporters to join us in trying to create something special,” the kickstarter description reads. “This will include the typical things needed to start a business and finance a game's development - licenses, hardware, healthcare, etc. Our goal will be based around the timeline of our first project and associated costs. ”.

#528. The Top 10 Best Horror Games To Play This Halloween

📅 30 Oct 2026

The Top 10 Best Horror Games To Play This Halloween

Tanggal: 30 Oct 2026 | Sumber: https://gameinformer.com/feature/2026/10/30/the-top-10-best-horror-games-to-play-this-halloween

Berdasarkan laporan, humans are drawn to horror in all forms, real life and fiction. Perhaps it’s the desire to get as close to death as possible without actually dying; perhaps it’s the morality of life and knowing death comes for all of us; perhaps all our heads are just a little miswired. Whatever the reason, we flock to movies where supernatural entities and puppets on tricycles upend otherwise lovely lives, TV shows where murderous cults kill and stump local detectives, and books where the words on the page seem to follow you to bed. Games, however, go a step further, letting you enter the horror and control it (or become its victim), and you could argue that, as a result, they’re the most immersive form of fiction.

Berdasarkan laporan, we at game informer love a healthy dose of horror from time to time, and we often review games like this. This isn’t an all-time list, so don’t fret if your personal favorite isn’t here. Others… don’t. Below is a list of 10 of the best horror games we’ve played recently. Some terrify us. And the best ones stick with us for years and years after the credits. Instead, this is a collection of 10 horror games ordered by release date that we think are great for spooky season and beyond. Let us know in the comments what you would add to the list!.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the cozy corner of the horror genre seems to have exploded overnight, and now tons of new slice-of-life horror games are in various stages of development. Just follow the important rules: don't go out at night, don't share secrets, and don't leave the village among others. The Village in the Shade takes things back to the homestead, giving you (a child who emerged from a hole in the ground and was immediately given the responsibility of running an entire farm by yourself) the freedom to plant, sow, reap, ranch, and more. You wouldn't want to break the rules, right? You could, theoretically, go about your idyllic rural living. That said, the team behind newcomer The Village in the Shade is no stranger to the form; they made the Yomawari series, a cute-and-terrifying collection of creepy virtual tales. But as you unravel the threads of what this village is, who you are, and why you're here, it's hard not to get drawn into the strange, mysterious, delightfully disturbing truths hiding in its shadows. Just don't forget to water your turnips before you go sneaking out again.

Berdasarkan laporan, fans of survival horror and old-school fmv adventure games will find plenty to love (and fear) in tenebris somnia. Tenebris Somnia may not look like much due to its classic pixelated presentation, but its scares and story captivate. High-production, live-action cutscenes help tell the story of a deteriorating relationship and the toll an indie horror film took on its creators, and they play an important role in gameplay. When a young woman visits her ex-boyfriend’s apartment and discovers he's trapped in a hellish dream world, it kicks off a well-executed survival-horror trek of inventive puzzles and resource management to overcome dangerous monsters. – Our Review.

Sebagaimana diketahui, resident evil requiem is not just one of the best resident evil games, but it’s also one of the best horror games ever made. Requiem splits its runtime between the two characters, letting you experience both sides of Capcom’s marquee survival-horror style. Kennedy, however, is a veteran of all that and more. It’s perfect for someone who wants to feel scared and then soon after receive the catharsis of being the one in control, like being the tragic victim who dies in Act One of the horror movie and the last one standing who lives to tell the tale. Leon’s sections leave your hands shaking with adrenaline and your blood pumping with excitement as he mows down zombies (sometimes literally, courtesy of those pesky chainsaws). The result is a Resident Evil game that blends two typical RE experiences – terrifying and tough or exhilarating over-the-top action – into one cohesive package. Leon S. Grace Ashcroft is timid, new to the whole “shooting zombies in the head while dealing with Umbrella viruses” thing, and is generally just trying to do her job. Grace’s sections leave your hands clammy and your blood pressure high as you desperately try to survive. It features a unique dual-protagonist structure. – Our Review.

Sebagaimana diketahui, little nightmares developer tarsier studios has a knack for delivering creepy side-scrolling adventures, but reanimal eschews any whimsy to become its scariest game yet. Escaping the game’s island setting is thrilling and chilling whether you’re playing alone or with a friend in co-op. While mechanically it is similar to Little Nightmares and still puts small children in unimaginable peril, Reanimal is capital-H horror thanks largely to its terrifying threats and disturbing animal-themed imagery (this probably isn’t the game for animal lovers; some messed-up stuff happens to these critters). Months after release, we’re still thinking about Reanimal’s memorable final sequence, which is worth the price of admission on its own. – Our Review.

Berdasarkan laporan, 2001’s silent hill 2 is considered one of the best horror video games of all time for good reason. The story of James Sunderland and his troubling relationship with his departed wife is complex, emotional, and – important for the purposes of this list – unsettling and scary. At release, it was a graphical powerhouse, using the PlayStation 2's horsepower to create a setting that begged to be explored, even though every bone in your body said you shouldn’t. The remake from developer Bloober Team took on a big task in modernizing the game without losing the original’s soul, and it did a great job. Among all the recent Silent Hill releases (Silent Hill f, Silent Hill: Townfall), the remake is our favorite. – Our Review.

Diungkapkan bahwa alan wake 2 is an excellent pick for some spooky madness, in the vein of david lynch’s seminal twin peaks mystery-surrealist series. Don’t worry too much about the “2” part of the game’s title. He’s only one half of the Alan Wake 2 equation, with his segments set in a dream-like version of New York City. Playing as him feels the most Twin Peaks-y. But this is still a Remedy Entertainment game, and without spoiling anything, it goes places. The other half is Saga, a police officer who arrives in the Pacific Northwest town of Bright Falls to investigate a murder that might be linked to a cult. And along the way, you can expect plenty of scares. Turn the lights down low (or off), light a candle, and sit back and enjoy one of Remedy’s best games. You can expect more traditional survival-horror gameplay from her. You just need to know that the titular Alan Wake character is a not-great writer who acts like he’s really great, his wife is missing, and he got trapped in the ambiguous Dark Place. – Our Review.

Sebagaimana diketahui, square enix has gone two-for-two with its paranormasight series, an anthology of stories about the strange and occult. And while the more recent Mermaid's Curse is a brilliant tale all its own, the first entry – The Seven Mysteries of Honjo – brings significantly more scares. A group of people in the city of Honjo find themselves caught in a spectral battle royale, using powerful objects and conditions to curse one another, with the allure of a prize at the end. Its magic isn't just in the flowchart timeline, where you can hop between different perspectives and protagonists to see how events play out from every angle, but also in the gorgeous stereoscopic environments and narrative puzzles. Adventure games are a classic genre, and Paranormasight will remind you of what the genre is capable of the moment you slowly spin your camera around, your eyes peeking out from behind your fingers.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, survival horror can contain multitudes, and as the years have worn on, the genre has grown to encompass a wide range of action-combat mechanics. As the Replika unit Elster, you delve deep into a remote complex filled with horrors and monsters, searching for something, or someone, waiting down below. It's an isometric survival-horror indie project from developer rose-engine, filled with clever puzzles, scarce resources, limited inventory slots, and looming, oppressive dread. Signalis feels like a re-centering in that respect. While love for classic horror games and other hallmarks of genre fiction will certainly draw you in, the stylish presentation and devastatingly human core will keep you forging ahead to the finale. Once you've breached the surface of Signalis' retro-future super-structures, you won't be able to turn back.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in horror movies, audiences often groan at a protagonist for putting themselves in seemingly grave danger just to learn more about a cursed amulet or bloodthirsty killer. By scrubbing through footage, you can select people or items in each scene and jump to random footage from any other movie that includes the same person or item. It's a game about Marisa Marcel, an actress who almost starred in three movies in the late 20th century, but has since disappeared. None of the movies were ever released due to mysterious circumstances, but you have access to the archived, unedited live-action footage, including behind-the-scenes conversations. The approach to puzzle-solving is unique and keeps you appropriately disoriented. The mystery at the center is an unsettling treat to unravel, and scary in new and unexpected ways. But in Immortality, you are the protagonist, and despite a lingering sense that you shouldn't be digging into the archives of these abandoned films, each eerie new scene makes you want to dive deeper. Immortality is one of a kind and an easy recommendation for horror fans who want to try something a little different.

Berdasarkan laporan, in the decade since launch, dead by daylight has continued to succeed, thanks to a dedicated (and newcomer-friendly) fanbase and its towering roster of original and licensed personas from across pop culture horror. The asymmetrical multiplayer title has become an anthology of horror’s biggest faces, including Freddy Krueger, Ghostface, Pyramid Head, and even the Xenomorph. Whether you play as a Survivor, trying to escape all manner of nightmare locations through stealth and cunning, or as a Killer, whose experience feels more like a hunting club, you’ll understand why Dead by Daylight has become a recurring destination for fans of the gruesome and bizarre.

Berdasarkan laporan, read about the making of dead by daylight and how it sunk its teeth into millions of players in our six-page exclusive feature in issue 368 (p. 42), available in our magazine archive to anyone with a free Game Informer account.
