#567. Nexus Mods introduces new AI disclosure rules, but won't ban AI mods outright

📅 04 Nov 2026

Nexus Mods introduces new AI disclosure rules, but won't ban AI mods outright

Tanggal: 04 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/nexus-mods-gen-ai-disclosure-rules

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "we hope what we have planned for now is a good first step. ".

Nexus Mods, the largest website for finding and downloading PC mods, has revealed new guidelines aimed at properly identifying mods created entirely using gen-AI or those created with AI assistance.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in a new blog post, nexus clarified its stance on a number of topics, but said it won't ban ai-generated mods altogether. Going forward, mod authors are required to disclose whether or not their mods used AI, and clarify how it was used. A toggle has also been added, giving visitors of the site the ability to filter out any mods that use AI.

Aware of how controversial the decision not to have a blanket AI ban would be, site co-owner Foledinho explained that although "we are pro-human creativity", it would be "difficult to draw a clear boundary between what is acceptable and unacceptable".

Berdasarkan laporan, "an outright ban will not eliminate ai from the modding process but will prevent people from mentioning its use," foledinho explained. "We'd prefer the opposite; it should be out in the open, clearly labelled, and regulated according to the rules that we can implement on our platform. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, that same courtesy extends to mods created entirely using ai, so long as that fact is disclosed. "This doesn't mean that any work done using AI will get removed; AI-generated mods are welcome on our platform provided that they meet certain criteria regarding permissions, transparency, presentation, and conduct," the post continues.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the new, mandatory disclosures cover existing mods, too, whose authors have 60 days to review whether their mods meet the new requirements. The new rules come alongside updates to the site's UI, which should make AI tags on mod pages more prominent. Not all backend changes will arrive at once, however.

Berdasarkan laporan, "while we hope these changes will encourage everyone to disclose their ai usage, to be honest, that's not going to happen," foledinho added. "Additionally, we are putting clear moderation standards in place, enforced with consequences for breaking the rules. ".

A different (albeit related) problem the deluge of AI-assisted mods introduced is the idea of remixing and modifying other authors' mods, often without their permission.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nexus mods doesn't have a solution for that problem at the moment, but the site is "working on introducing new permission options covering ai usage and training, as well as forks and derivative mods. " By the same token, the post clarified the site won't itself use mods to train AI, or sell or license the mods to "anyone doing so".

This could prove to be a more complex problem to solve, given how often one mod relies on another mod to function, and that's saying nothing of contributions from other authors or users themselves.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, then there's the issue of ai-generated and ai-assisted thumbnails, which run the gamut from those entirely created by gen-ai to original shots upscaled or enhanced using ai tools. The post said no new rules governing those cases are being introduced, calling them "grey zones", but that "this discussion is not over yet. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, "i'll be honest with you all, there are some details we still need to figure out and work through, especially when it comes to existing licences, forks, and how permissions apply to different versions of a mod," the post goes on. "But we want to get this right, and not rush through changes that could cause more problems further down the line. This does mean that these improvements will take longer to deliver, but we hope what we have planned for now is a good first step, and you'll bear with us whilst we continue to move in the right direction. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa just yesterday, indie game website itch. io was forced to expand its AI disclosure filter as 'AI slop' threatened to overwhelm the site. Previously, Valve came under pressure due to a perceived lack of curation around AI-developed titles during the most recent Steam Next Fest, prompting public outcry and a demand for more action from the company.

#568. After 15 years, The Sims' best spin-off finally gets its due follow-up in The Sims 4: Royalty & Legacy

📅 16 Jan 2026

After 15 years, The Sims' best spin-off finally gets its due follow-up in The Sims 4: Royalty & Legacy

Tanggal: 16 Jan 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/the-sims-4-royalty-and-legacy-expansion-release-date-all-details

The Sims Medieval had a short but powerful run back in 2011, and now many of its best features are finally coming to the main franchise.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the sims 4 developers recently promised an exciting year for the game, and the franchise as a whole, and we just got an early look at one of those first events. After some light teasing, the developer unveiled Royalty & Legacy, the game’s next expansion.

Royalty & Legacy’s first trailer debuted on Thursday, revealing a February 12 release date, and showing off the expansion for the first time.

Diungkapkan bahwa there’s a lot going on in royalty & legacy, which is priced $40. For one, it introduces a new world, Ondarion, which is going to be the setting for your kingdom, as you join a race for the throne. The expansion introduces Dynasty and Nobility - two new systems you can use to create your own world of royal shenanigans.

Berdasarkan laporan, ondarion is made up of three neighborhoods (regions). Verdemar is a chaotic world of outlaws and nobles. Each region has a unique theme and culture, and they’re each ruled by a Dynasty. Dambele is a place that prioritises art and community. Finally, Bellacorde is an extravagant region known for opulence and romance.

Diungkapkan bahwa speaking of building places, royalty & legacy also adds a new lot type, the backroom lot. For instance, it can be a library or gym in the morning, and shift into a night club at night. It serves two functions that change with the time of day. Dambele has its own library-turned-rave, for instance.

Sebagaimana diketahui, at the heart of ondarion are all the possible fantasy lives and stories you can live. The Sims calls them Powershifts, and they include some well-known Arthurian fantasies and other, more silly ones.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, swordsmanship is the new 10-level skill arriving with the expansion, which further plays into those fantasies by letting your sims duel. There are even Swordsmanship Tournaments you can watch take place across every neighborhood in Ondarion.

Diungkapkan bahwa then there are secret passageways, which let you speed up moving across the new regions. They essentially let your Sims teleport between designated passageways, either on their own lots, or other lots in the world. Some of these are hidden for you to find, while others you can create.

In terms of new careers, there’s the Noble Career, where your Sim can rise through several Noble Rankings by doing basically what nobles had to do in the middle ages to earn favour.

Diungkapkan bahwa the aforementioned dynasty system is how you can join any of ondarion’s existing families, or start your own. You actually have a lot of say in what goes on, including the usual business of appointing heirs.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, of course, no royal roleplay would be complete without scandals, which is where the scandals system comes in. Through it, you can create stories to discredit others, or even topple an entire dynasty.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in november, you may recall the sims 4 introducing new free items inspired by west african culture. In creating that content, EA worked with a group of Simmers who have direct ties to West African countries.

The group’s guidance was once again utilised to build the Dambele neighborhood in this expansion, and some of the lots around the world of Ondarion were even created by members of the group.

Sebagaimana diketahui, while you wait for royalty & legacy to actually arrive, there’s more in the sims 4 you can jump in right now. The game recently kicked off a collaboration with fashion brand Coach that brought several free items to Create a Sim, and Build Buy. That arrived alongside a free update, which already makes for a busy start of the year for The Sims 4.

Mac, PC, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S.

#569. Pokémon Night Out underlines why Location Backgrounds are fantastic for Pokémon Go fans

📅 11 Nov 2026

Pokémon Night Out underlines why Location Backgrounds are fantastic for Pokémon Go fans

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.pocketgamer.com/features/pokemon-night-out/

Diungkapkan bahwa pokémon go has a lot of specific, in-person events. Beyond these location-heavy events, where there are lots of smaller set up, specific installations of Pokémon branding around: We've seen a bunch of lower-key events like the National Trust and Space Centre collaborations. Things like Into the Wild which is coming up this weekend (which had previous locations in Lisbon) or Go Fest that happens each year. None of these were quite the same as Pokémon Night Out, though.

Diungkapkan bahwa in a go fest or into the wild-type event, everything is targeted towards in-game usage; getting players in person, together, for a set amount of time. On the other hand, the National Trust and Space Centre collaborations are long-running,with minimal in-person activities, and real dependence on the app. Pokémon Night Out was something different altogether; there were tons of in-game things to do for people in the area interested in Pokémon Go, but there was also a huge concert for Pokémon fans in general.

Diungkapkan bahwa i have never considered going to an edm concert and really didn't know who alison wonderland or marshmello were, but i was pumped to go along to this! when we entered the o2 in london, we could see loads of people walking around, staying out of the rain, wearing pokémon clothing. They were raiding, chatting and hanging out! You see, this event space had a really cool postcard that appeared in-game, some research questlines, and tons of raids. These raids included Pikachu and Gengar with a nighttime London background.

Diungkapkan bahwa they are specifically in-person raids, so many people came to the area to both raid and pick up these questlines. There were some people playing Pokémon Go, but also some Pokémon fans and cosplayers there, excited for this sort of event. Going into the actual area beyond ticket scanning had a different vibe. There was also a merch stand outside the O2, with a less busy one beyond where the tickets were scanned. Pokémon had set up some photo areas and handed out a tote bag, with a poster and bracelets in it. A lot was going on!.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, we found our seats quite quickly and were happy with our spot, quickly getting to know our neighbours. Backgrounds had always been cool, but as Pokémon has added the ability to show off that background around your player's profile, there is even more of a drive to have these less common location backgrounds. One of the most interesting things, however, was that there were so many people playing Pokémon Go - below us on the stairs, next to us, around us. Although there were plenty of Raids, this event was less than a day long. These people were all after a Shiny with the London background. Equally interesting was the fact that this was never really listed as a Pokemon Go event, so it was unlikely many of these (hundreds) of players actually booked tickets for this extra layer of gaming.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this really goes hand in hand with what ed wu, president, games at scopely said to me earlier in the year, "we are trying to inspire people to explore the world together through the magic of making pokemon real in the real world. " Memories are one of the core pillars of Pokemon Go, so knowing that all of the people catching would see that background on their Pikachu and Gengar's in future, surely means that Scopely Explore are already starting to deliver on that pillar.

Berdasarkan laporan, the show itself was fantastic - such a unique and interesting experience with a rave pikachu and mimikyu coming on stage, with tons of visual effects and nods to retro pokémon games. I find it really fun when Pokémon Go is used alongside Pokémon events in this way, feeling like it's part of the drive of what brings people together, without the event being specifically Pokémon Go-themed. This just felt like a big, maybe slightly strange to me, celebration of all things Pokémon. I look forward to seeing who on my friends list has backgrounds around their avatar showcasing some of the other EDM locations and who has backgrounds from other events that I have attended, as it helps this already social-friendly game give an extra something to share and discuss.

Jordan Esports Federation signs MoU with King Hussein Business Park to host more events

Tanggal: 03 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://esportsinsider.com/2026/11/jordan-esports-federation-khbp-mou

Sebagaimana diketahui, priya venkatesh has been following the money in esports since before brand deals were considered legitimate marketing. She got pulled into the scene through competitive fighting games and eventually found herself more interested in the contracts and partnerships behind the tournaments than the matches themselves. These days she focuses on how brands navigate esports sponsorships, where the smart money is going, and which deals are actually built to last versus the ones that look good in a press release.

The Jordan Esports Federation (JEF) has signed a memorandum of understanding with King Hussein Business Park (KHBP) in Amman, giving the national body a formal framework to stage more tournaments and events at the site it already calls home.

Sebagaimana diketahui, khbp announced the deal on sunday in a statement published on its website. Prince Omar bin Faisal, who is President of the JEF, attended the signing.

Sebagaimana diketahui, under the mou, the federation and the business park will jointly host and organise specialised competitions on the khbp campus. They will also receive the international delegations and official guests that travel to those events. Beyond the competitive side, the two organisations plan to cooperate on media and marketing, look at shared education, training and community projects, and swap knowledge and expertise.

Neither party has disclosed financial terms or the length of the agreement.

Berdasarkan laporan, khbp ceo eng. Ammar Ezzeddin presented the MoU as part of the park’s wider ambitions. “This partnership builds on our ongoing efforts to create an enabling environment for institutions, initiatives and high-potential sectors, and to establish KHBP as a hub for innovation and technology,” he said.

Berdasarkan laporan, he added: “we look forward to helping the sector thrive and to hosting more tournaments and events that put jordanian talent in the spotlight and raise the kingdom’s profile in this field. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, jef vice president hazem bawab focused on the competitive and grassroots goals. “This partnership is a significant step in our drive to develop the esports industry in Jordan and elevate the standard of local, regional and international competitions and activities,” he said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, bawab continued: “we look forward to drawing on the setup and capabilities that khbp offers to scale our work, nurture young talent and launch joint programmes that help the industry grow and encourage greater participation. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, the deal formalises a relationship that already exists on the ground. According to The Esports Radar, the JEF, which is the government recognised regulator for esports in the country, is based at the park in West Amman.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a lot of that work happens at the arc, the arena and gaming dome inside the park. The same report lists past events there including the fourth Arab Esports League, a Women’s Esports Championship and Red Bull Login, which doubled as Jordan’s national final stage in Dota 2 and Counter-Strike 2. The venue is also an incubation centre supported by the federation and the Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship, and runs training camps for players hoping to turn professional.

Diungkapkan bahwa khbp has been a destination for esports investment for some time. In 2024, lounge operator True Gamers announced plans for an esports venue in Jordan at the business park, a project in which its CPO publicly thanked the JEF and Prince Omar.

Diungkapkan bahwa the timing also puts amman in the industry spotlight. PocketGamer. biz points out that Pocket Gamer Connects Jordan takes place on 7 and 8 November, bringing many of the region’s games industry stakeholders to the city later this week.

Ubisoft are reportedly tapped as one potential company that could acquire Arkane, though the Dishonored studio's own management may be in the running too

Tanggal: 03 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/ubisoft-are-reportedly-tapped-as-one-potential-company-that-could-acquire-arkane-though-the-dishonored-studios-own-management-may-be-in-the-running-too

I'd really like it if it weren't Ubisoft though.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, things are potentially looking up for arkane, depending on how you feel about ubisoft (and depending on who actually ends up acquiring them). I mention the Assassin's Creed developer because, reportedly, they're interested in buying the studio from Microsoft, having even made a bid for it. I'll go out on a limb here and say it's the whole being French thing, but uh, I'd really rather someone else bought Arkane.

Berdasarkan laporan, this comes from, you guessed it, bloomberg, who say that sources they've spoken with claim two other gaming companies have also made a bit. But overall, it doesn't yet sound like anything is leaning any particular way, as Xbox haven't formalised a deal with any of the potential buyers. There is even the potential that Arkane would be sold to their own management, as Xbox are considering such a move. Bloomberg also note that if a deal is made, this should then allow Arkane to finish their work on their Blade game, which is expected to release within the next couple of years.

Berdasarkan laporan, apparently an xbox spokesperson told bloomberg that the gaming company is exploring their options ahead of their december deadline, but didn't comment any further. Ubisoft reportedly did not have a comment to make on the matter. For some context on that December deadline, because of French labour laws, companies that have over 1000 staff members are required to search for a buyer for three months before they can just completely shut down. That makes December 13th the final date that such a deal has to be made by, meaning there's about a month and a half left to go.

Berdasarkan laporan, arkane's sale comes as part of a sweeping range of cuts, sales and closures being made by microsoft at the moment. Thousands of Xbox staff were also laid off at this time, with more laid off in September, and even more coming this month and January reportedly. I recommend removing your saved payment details, at least for now.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Users of Humble Bundle—the pay-what-you-want game-bundle storefront that will also sell you books and software—have been alarmed by a new redesign that seems to have axed a foundational piece of login security tech.

Berdasarkan laporan, the just-released new humble bundle website has no support for two-factor authentication whatsoever: users are unable to add it to their accounts, while those who had previously set it up on the old site design (including yours truly) are able to log in with just an email and password. At no point in the login process does the site ask you to input a 2FA code.

Sebagaimana diketahui, humble bundle does not address the removal of 2fa anywhere on its new site. In fact, the site's FAQs still feature articles encouraging users to make use of it to keep their accounts secure, which is currently impossible. I have reached out to Humble Bundle to ask if the change was intentional and if it will be reversed, and will update this piece if I hear back.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this is, to put it mildly, concerning. Even in the event your account password became compromised, your attacker would be unable to get into your account without also having access to your 2FA codes, which are constantly regenerated and only valid for short periods of time. The point of two-factor (or multi-factor) authentication is to make user accounts—which, on Humble Bundle, may well have credit card info saved to them—more secure. In a world where too many people have bad password hygiene, it's a vital bit of security tech.

Sebagaimana diketahui, unsurprisingly, humble bundle users are aghast at the uncommunicated weakening of their account security. "I can't even see a way to remove saved payment details anymore, this is seriously dangerous and the site should be taken offline until fixed ASAP", wrote another. They all, uh, they all pretty much go like that. "This is insanely bad, they need to take down password changes entirely until this is fixed", wrote one user in the Humble Bundle subreddit. No one is happy about this.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i have to imagine this was not an intentional change. Indeed, I can't fathom the circumstances under which it would be intentional. Either way, while 2FA's absence endures, you might want to play it safe and remove any saved payment details you have tied to your account, though some users report having trouble doing that, too.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, you might have seen that for today's grub, edwin decided to in part feed the maw with food devils, an incredibly salacious, foodie take on fire emblem, as it was meant to release today. That might prompt you to call Edwin a rotten liar and march up to his castle at the top of the hill on a dark and stormy night with pitchforks and torches, but I beseech you to wait, because it's actually Steam's fault. The only problem is, it's not actually out yet. And potentially, it's the fault of all those awful AI games that have been flooding Steam recently.

Diungkapkan bahwa in a steam blog post shared earlier today, developer studio daimon explained why the game isn't able to be released today, first offering a bit of context: if you want to put your game on steam, you have to submit for approval so that it matches what you've described and doesn't harbour malware, amongst other reasons. As the post explains, "before submitting a build, devs see a disclaimer that says 'This review typically takes 3-5 business days, but please allow up to 7 business days in case feedback needs to be addressed'. " Except the team submitted their build on October 12th, more than 20 days ago, with no approval in sight.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the reason? "we can only assume it's because steam's review queue is clogged up by ai slop, but the whole process is now taking several weeks for some developers. Valve have required that games disclose AI use since January 2024, and a year on from then in January 2025 only just over 14% of games featured such a disclosure. " For some context, Game Discovery Tool did some statistics magic and found that more than 50% of games released in October on Steam featured an AI disclosure. In January 2026, that jumped up to a little over 25%, and now here we are at more than 50%.

Berdasarkan laporan, and to be clear, steam releases have gone up too. Correlation is obviously not causation, so take that with a pinch of salt. Still, it paints a concerning image over AI usage, and potentially sounds like it's affecting how Valve operates. But in October 2026, that has jumped up to almost 4000. According to SteamDB data, a little over 2000 games were released on the platform in October 2025. Almost as if allowing free reign over AI is bad, or something!.

Diungkapkan bahwa unfortunately for studio daimon, there's no estimate on when food devils might launch. "We sent another ticket last week saying that the situation was urgent and that we might miss our release date because of this, but it also got ignored. including us. I'm sure that their staff is just too overwhelmed at the moment, but these sudden and massive delays have affected many developers throughout October, with some even being forced to postpone their releases. "Even now, we don't know when Steam will give us the final OK to finally release our game," they wrote. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, they're hoping to still be able to release it by the end of the week, but "can't make any plans or promises because it's out of our control. " Perhaps in the meantime, for those who like what's cooking in the devs' kitchen, we could throw the game a wishlist to be ready for whenever it does launch.

#580. Here's The Best Graphics And Performance Mode For Phantom Blade Zero On PlayStation 5

📅 29 Oct 2026

Here's The Best Graphics And Performance Mode For Phantom Blade Zero On PlayStation 5

Tanggal: 29 Oct 2026 | Sumber: https://gameinformer.com/tips-tricks/2026/10/28/heres-the-best-graphics-and-performance-mode-for-phantom-blade-zero-on

Diungkapkan bahwa phantom blade zero is out now for everyone as a console exclusive on playstation 5 and on pc via steam and the epic games store as well. If you missed it, it's my favorite action game of the year so far, and you can read why in Game Informer's Phantom Blade Zero review. That explains why I think you should check the game out; Game Informer's list of Phantom Blade Zero tips and tricks will get you some key information I wish I had when I started the game; and this guide I wrote up about the requirements you need to get the best ending in Phantom Blade Zero will help you find all story-critical content in the game.

Berdasarkan laporan, however, you're looking for advice on which of the three visual modes phantom blade zero offers you should use on your ps5. This here piece is for you.

Berdasarkan laporan, phantom blade zero has three visual modes on ps5 pro: quality, balanced, and performance. The best part is that this mode offers 40 FPS gameplay, which, contrary to how math works, is halfway between 30 FPS and 60 FPS; I'm not kidding, look it up. I tested all three. My personal favorite was Balanced, which gives you an upscaled (checkerboarded) 4K resolution at 40 FPS, as long as you have a 120Hz TV with VRR. It's a win-win for me and my go-to mode when a game offers it. I like this mode because the upscaled 4K looks beautiful, just a hair less than native 4K, and if you aren't someone super trained on those details, I'd wager you won't notice the difference. If you have a 120Hz TV, it likely has VRR because most major manufacturers include it with 120Hz. As such, 40 FPS feels much smoother than 30 FPS, and you're still getting crisp 4K resolution. That said, if you don’t have a PS5 Pro, you won’t see this Balanced mode.

Berdasarkan laporan, the performance mode offers an upscaled 2k resolution with a pretty locked 60 fps. Phantom Blade Zero is an extremely fast, fluid action game, so I think many people will want the buttery smoothness of 60 FPS gameplay. If that's you, pick the Performance mode. Sure, its resolution is lower, and it will look blurrier and less crisp than the other two modes, but if you aren't switching back and forth often or looking at side-by-side images, you likely won't notice.

Sebagaimana diketahui, quality mode is native 4k resolution (absolutely beautiful, the best visual image you can get playing phantom blade zero), but at 30 fps. I tested all three graphics modes with it on and off and noticed zero performance changes or issues. Note: There is an option for ray tracing on PS5 Pro. and for a game like this, I don't think 30 FPS does it justice. I don't really recommend this mode for combat, but if you're just waltzing around Wulin, grabbing screenshots and such, turn it on and bask in the wonders of developer S-Game's art team. So, use ray tracing – it’s nice!.

Diungkapkan bahwa michael manning (he/him) has been enamored with video games since he first played the sonic classic collection as a child. With decades of experience in gaming and a full tour as a Gaming Journalist, Michael is ready to step up to the plate. From AAA to the smallest passion projects, his motto is that every piece of ar.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the battle of online chat platforms used to be very close, with a wide range of selections that friends all had to choose between before getting started. Nowadays, the vast majority of gamers are centralized on one platform, allowing that platform to keep them engaged with constant small iterations and improvements.

Deadlock is starting to suffer from the same fate as other free-to-play games, with bot farmers crawling from the woodwork.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, of course, that platform is discord, an online group chat and voice call app that seems like it's always adding new bells and whistles. Recently leaked, Discord is apparently working on a new function that will allow viewers of a friend’s stream to ask them to “pass the controller”, handing over direct control of the game being played to whoever has requested it.

Berdasarkan laporan, as magical as this system may sound, it actually isn’t all that far-fetched, serving as a major selling point for the app parsec, which specializes in allowing players to connect to each other's pcs, allowing online play of typically local-only titles. Steam’s Steamplay system functions similarly, though it requires players to provide their own feed of the game.

Diungkapkan bahwa discord’s offering of the function could be a major game changer, consolidating multiple functions into an already centralized app. The issue of latency and ping will always exist, but the company is doing a lot to earn back the users who were shaken by their recent collaboration with Google to open up channel messages directly to searches.

Diungkapkan bahwa aimed at opening up servers that exist to share info and house massive communities, no real hiccups have occurred yet, even as users stay vigilant. Discord has utilized all kinds of different minigames and in-app connections to keep users centralized on the app itself, to a fairly mixed effect.

Berdasarkan laporan, the inclusion of the token shop and various quests to allow users to obtain cosmetics and even nitro time for free was a massive success, allowing discord to basically incentivize users to sit through various ads and sponsored quests. Discord has made it clear they aim to turn the app into more than just a chat venue.

Nowadays, the vast majority of gamers are centralized on one platform, allowing that platform to keep them engaged with constant small iterations and improvements.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this function has yet to be formally announced, and hasn’t had any kind of estimated release date presented, but could seriously enable a lot of older co-op games that don’t have modern releases or online multiplayer. Alongside the huge amount of game preservation work that takes place inside of Discord servers, this is potentially one of Discord’s most impactful updates, for better or for worse.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the only issue that may creep up on discord is the eternal hex of feature creep, the mixtape where developers focus on implementing more things instead of fixing and finalizing the things they have now. Discord has really focused on adding more, with some real dust appearing on basic functions like voice calls. Latency has been increasing, and it takes longer to join on average.

Diungkapkan bahwa these issues are annoying, but nothing overly serious, at least for now. The worry is always that functions like this, that allow players to control input on other users' machines, could be maliciously abused one way or another, either through modifications or exploitable bugs.

Berdasarkan laporan, this is the same type of worry that users had about the google initiative, and while nothing has come of it yet, users find it safer to err on the side of caution. Discord’s history of data breaches is far from spotless, and this kind of direct access could lead to real abuse if not properly put together. The function is likely to roll out slowly through some form of beta, but until official word is out, all we can do is speculate.

Berdasarkan laporan, it was bad enough for nvidia ceo jensen huang that he admitted to having an affair with someone, who people believe to be someone suspected of being a chinese spy. But it's now come to light he has reportedly had a second affair with a member of Nvidia staff—Kimberly Powell, VP of healthcare. After this latest story it's looking more likely that Huang could be forced to resign.

Berdasarkan laporan, the question is what's next for nvidia if the board today decides his tenure as the longest-serving silicon valley ceo should come to an end. Huang has been the image of the company in the eyes of the public for a long time, so whoever steps in to replace him will have a big leather jacket to fill. And whoever it is, it will be a major change for the company regardless.

Diungkapkan bahwa the doors are wide open for nvidia in the long-term, so it's difficult to pin down with any certainty who any eventual replacement ceo would be, but in the interim the options are more limited. Here's who we could consider seeing as the new CEO of Nvidia.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the first thing to note is that if huang does get the boot, nvidia will need to appoint someone to the position quickly as an interim ceo. As one of the biggest companies in the world and a major player in the AI industry which is keeping large parts of the US economy afloat, trying to quickly mitigate economic concerns will be key. This would likely mean picking someone internal to Nvidia.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, top of the list here is nvidia cfo colette kress. If you've listened to Nvidia earnings calls, you'll have heard Kress talking to investors about how the company's doing. Kress could be a likely pick for interim CEO because she's known to investors and heads up company finances. In the short term, to investors she'd seem a safe bet to keep the company in good financial standing amidst any damage Huang's controversies may have done to Nvidia's long-term future.

Diungkapkan bahwa other options internal to nvidia aren't out of the question, either. Jeff Fisher is especially noteworthy because he's very public-facing, but he is very much couched in the world of gaming as SVP of the GeForce department. Kress would still likely be a safer bet for investors.

Diungkapkan bahwa chief technology officer, michael kagan, is another option, and would potentially be a good fit as co-interim ceo alongside kress. Kagan joined Nvidia as part of the Mellanox acquisition, a company which he co-founded. He is also a former Intel engineer having managed the design of the Pentium MMX chips.

Berdasarkan laporan, the other nvidia staff i listed are an option, too. Malachowsky perhaps not so much—he's a co-founder but is very hands-off and maybe doesn't have much real involvement with the company from a leadership position.

Sebagaimana diketahui, any interim ceo that's picked could be there for a while. When Intel CEO Brian Krzanich resigned in 2018—under vaguely similar circumstances to those Huang finds himself under now—both he and Pat Gelsinger were followed by interim CEOs for months before final decisions were made on their successors. Though in Krzanich's case, the interim successor, Robert Swan, went on to become full CEO for another two years.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in the long-term, the net for huang's replacement could be cast far and wide. People like Tim Cook and Elon Musk would be pretty outside bets, but with the monopolistic and 'in-bed-together' state of Big Tech in the US, it wouldn't be out of the question. Remember that Nvidia is the biggest profiteer of the AI boom by far, so an offer would be enticing.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, amd's lisa su would be an interesting choice, too, and has been touted by a number of people. She certainly has a combination of GPU and AI engineering prowess alongside general public trust and goodwill. In fact, I can't think of many tech CEOs that the public hate less (an increasingly relevant metric, these days).

Diungkapkan bahwa then there is also the consideration of who would want to take the job. Sure, it would guarantee a big pay check, but it's a big role to fill with Nvidia's current very flat hierarchy, and any CEO is going to have to be across everything the company does. It's also a role under intense political and economic scrutiny and with the potential for an AI pop still on the horizon, the company might be sitting on a precipice.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, of course, the board of directors could throw us a wild card, and on that front your guess is as good as mine. Though one thing is very likely, whoever comes in is probably not going to have PC gaming much in their thoughts.

Diungkapkan bahwa 3. Best mid-range: Nvidia RTX 5060 Ti 8 GB.

Berdasarkan laporan, jacob got his hands on a gaming pc for the first time when he was about 12 years old. He swiftly realised the local PC repair store had ripped him off with his build and vowed never to let another soul build his rig again. Eventually, he gave up the ruthless mercenary life to join the world's #1 PC Gaming site full-time. Since then, Jacob's led a double-life as part-hardware geek, part-philosophy nerd, first working as a Hardware Writer for PCGamesN in 2020, then working towards a PhD in Philosophy for a few years while freelancing on the side for sites such as TechRadar, Pocket-lint, and yours truly, PC Gamer. With this vow, Jacob the hardware junkie was born. It's definitely not an ego thing, he assures us.

Diungkapkan bahwa cco states: "we are not in the industry of replacing actors. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, developers at embark studios, the company behind arc raiders, have spoken on the use of generative ai voice acting in the extraction shooter. It's argued that the initial use of generative AI line reads was a benefit to the voice actors, as they: "would just go crazy if they had to read all of that".

Sebagaimana diketahui, this comes from a recently released video by embark, focused on arc raider's sound and music. In it, several key members of staff speak on the game's use of generative AI, be it the initial use of it for voice lines, and the gradual replacement of it with human line reads.

Diungkapkan bahwa audio director bence pajor first spoke about the struggles he ran into at previous studios; how gameplay decisions couldn't be changed because voice lines were already locked in. He describes this as a "true pain", and that it places stress on the writing team, dialogue team, and voice actors who may have scheduling clashes. He said that using reachable voice actors in Stockholm, and using the tools available, made life easier for everyone.

Sebagaimana diketahui, later in the video, pajor explained that training data was made with the voice actor's performances. Due to the voice lines being required for each new feature, item, or weapon added into the game, he argues it would be too impractical to record every possible version of a line read. "The actors would just go crazy if they had to read all of that," Pajor said.

Berdasarkan laporan, pajor continues by pointing to arc raider's many updates and changes since its release in october 2025, it would be impractical to call in voice actors to record lines every time an altered line read needed to happen. Two voice actors present in the video - Jo Rideout (Shani) and Diana Gardner (Celeste) - also shared their feelings on it. Gardner said it was "freeing" that she could take a job somewhere else, without worrying about cancelling other shoots or projects.

Sebagaimana diketahui, however, gardner would later speak on the topic of her ownership of celeste's many lines in the game: "the contract seemed so fair [. ] This is hours of work that I've put in, but can I take ownership for the final product? No. But I didn't know what to expect once I heard the voice come out. ] so it was a no-brainer in that sense. I was like, 'Can I take ownership for the performance?' [. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa even with these proposed benefits to using ai-powered performances, these voice lines are being replaced. Embark CCO Stefan Strandberg said: "we are not in the industry of replacing voice actors", and acknowledges that immersion-breaking experiences many players had when playing Arc Raiders and hearing these performances. Strandberg and Pajor both admit to understanding the AI critique, and point to the work being done to replace what they can.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "we are not in the industry of replacing actors," said strandberg. "Actually I think quite the opposite. We should celebrate the performance and give them more space. That's something I'm hoping to give to players over the coming years. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, part of this critique over generative ai's use in arc raiders came from reviews, including our own. Embark Studios faced similar pushback for gen-AI voice acting in The Finals, however Arc Raider's popularity while using the technology led Nexon to describe it as a "trojan horse" for gen AI's use in small team game development.

As Arc Raiders celebrates its first birthday, publisher Nexon reveals the extraction shooter has topped 17 million sales, but revenue is set to decline.

#594. Play as water and rain on wildfires in Atuel, a short, free game about the power and vulnerability of nature

📅 03 Nov 2026

Play as water and rain on wildfires in Atuel, a short, free game about the power and vulnerability of nature

Tanggal: 03 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/have-you-played-atuel

Diungkapkan bahwa well, have you played atuel? if not, you can do so within the next hour - it's a tiny, free, 25-minute walking sim, albeit one with little actual walking on account of you playing most of it as a river. More of a running sim, really.

Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, technically, atuel calls itself a "documentary game", and not without justification. As you drift downhill, taking control of water, clouds, and the local wildlife, you'll hear real-life scientists and historians monologuing on the Atuel and its relationship with the human cultures it's nourished. While its sweeping Patagonian landscapes are rendered with a dreamy otherworldliness, and certain moments are downright mystic, the whole watery journey is based directly on the Atuel River that runs through western Argentina. Mercifully, these are delivered with thoughtfulness as well as earnestness, maintaining the game's contemplative atmosphere without making it sound like the audio guide to a museum of Birmingham canals.

Berdasarkan laporan, a few bends in, atuel also takes on the climate crisis, directing you away from the soothing freshwater and into wildfires and parched riverbeds. I'd say this was preaching to the choir, at least for anyone who a) desires a functioning planet and b) learned about the water cycle in primary school, but then it isn't really preaching. Rather, developers Matajuegos weave between the beauty of the Earth and the need to protect it quite gracefully, and end their river tour on a more hopeful note than its darker moments may have intimated.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there's plenty else to leave an outsized impression in your memory matter: the understated, naturally-textured soundtrack, for instance, or the patiently gradual zoom-outs that slowly unveil the andes' wild splendour. For me, and without wanting to undermine the importance or the accuracy of Atuel's environmental point, it was mainly just nice – therapeutic, even – to float through its gorgeous, surreal scenery like a cloud. And sometimes, as one. You can download it for free from Steam and Itch, with a pay-what-you-want option on the latter.

#597. The Witcher 3 Is Using AI for Geralt’s Voice, But There’s a Very Good Reason

📅 12 Nov 2026

The Witcher 3 Is Using AI for Geralt’s Voice, But There’s a Very Good Reason

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/the-witcher-3-is-using-ai-for-geralt-s-voice-but-there-s-a-very-good-reason/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, covering the video games industry since 2017, with experience in news, articles, and reviews. Currently a writer at DualShockers and gaming magazines.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, artificial intelligence has become one of the most controversial topics in the gaming industry, and it's not hard to understand why. From studios experimenting with AI-generated assets to developers finding new ways to automate creative work, players have plenty of reasons to be skeptical.

However, CD Projekt Red has found a rather unusual way to use the technology in The Witcher 3, and this time, there's a surprisingly touching story behind it.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the studio has recently confirmed that it is working with an ai company to adjust geralt's polish voice in the upcoming songs of the past expansion, which raised some players’ eyebrows. But don't worry, Jacek Rozenek, the actor who has portrayed the White Wolf in Polish since the original The Witcher, isn't being replaced.

Diungkapkan bahwa in fact, he's still performing all of geralt's new lines himself. This time, AI is actually being used as a supportive tool and is simply helping his voice sound closer to the one players remember from the 2015 RPG.

Amanita Design, the Czech studio behind Machinarium, recently called out an AI-generated project made using assets from the game.

Diungkapkan bahwa as reported by game file, rozenek suffered a stroke in 2019 that left him unable to speak for months. His recovery was an incredibly difficult process, requiring him to train his voice for six or seven hours every day before he could return to acting.

Berdasarkan laporan, he eventually returned to the role of geralt, recording additional lines for the witcher 3's next-gen update in 2022. However, the process took a significant toll on him. Rozenek told Game File that he was exhausted after those recording sessions, despite having worked hard to regain his ability to perform.

Jacek Rozenek, the actor who has portrayed the White Wolf in Polish since the original The Witcher, isn't being replaced.

Diungkapkan bahwa when cd projekt invited him back to record dialogue for songs of the past, the studio noticed that his voice had changed considerably. It was now lower and rougher than it had been when he recorded the thousands of lines featured in the original game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, since the new expansion takes place around the same period as the base game, hearing geralt suddenly sound different between old and new dialogue could not make sense to the player’s experience. So, rather than replacing Rozenek, however, CD Projekt decided to find another solution. A quite smart one, actually.

Diungkapkan bahwa the studio partnered with respeecher, an ai company specializing in voice technology that it had previously worked with on phantom liberty, the dlc of cyberpunk 2077. With their help, Rozenek recorded all of Geralt's new dialogue as usual, and the recordings were then processed using an algorithm trained on his previous performances.

Berdasarkan laporan, cd projekt red has just released patch 5. 01 for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered.

Diungkapkan bahwa in other words, the technology isn't generating geralt's lines from scratch or replacing the actor's performance. Rozenek still delivers the dialogue, including its emotions and acting, while AI helps bring his voice closer to the version players heard over a decade ago.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, most importantly, the actor gave his full consent to the process and expressed his trust in the developers. "The point is that this voice should be as close as possible to my voice from 12 years ago," Rozenek explained.

Diungkapkan bahwa cd projekt's localization producer, mikołaj szwed, also acknowledged the concerns surrounding ai in the industry, but believes this is an example of how the technology can be used ethically. He described the situation as a special case, emphasizing that the decision was made because of Rozenek's health circumstances.

Diungkapkan bahwa and honestly, it's difficult to argue with the sentiment behind it. Rather than using AI to cut costs or avoid hiring a performer, the Polish studio is using it to help an actor continue playing a character he's portrayed for decades. Songs of the Past is currently scheduled to launch in 2027, and Geralt's Polish voice will once again be in the hands of the person who helped make him so iconic!.

#602. COD: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ patch has nerfed UAV Towers so you're not immediately visible everywhere you go

📅 03 Nov 2026

COD: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ patch has nerfed UAV Towers so you're not immediately visible everywhere you go

Tanggal: 03 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-dmz-uav-tower-nerf

Sebagaimana diketahui, the call of duty: modern warfare 4 patches continue, with the latest delivering some big changes to the game's extraction mode dmz. The latest hotfix introduced a key balance change to one of DMZ's most controversial mechanics: UAV Towers.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, uav towers, previously guaranteed to spawn in every point of interest (poi) in the map, have now had their spawn logic randomised. Infinity Ward also reduced their spawn rate by 40 percent, meaning you're less likely to find them across the various regions of the map. As noted in the patch notes, that change also prevents multiple towers from spawning the same area. The only exception is the Deadtown area, which factors into DMZ Order progression and requires multiple towers.

Diungkapkan bahwa by taking away the guarantee that each poi will have at least one uav tower, the patch removes one of the core tactics pvp-inclined and aggressive players have been relying on since dmz's launch. It's common for players to spawn in, and immediately run around activating as many UAV Towers as possible to reveal the movement of enemy players, even if they're not interested in directly engaging them.

Diungkapkan bahwa indeed, some of the uav towers cover extraction areas, so it's easy for players intending to ruin the day of others as they're extracting to set up elaborate traps. Making matters worse, a particular character trait prevents UAV Towers from expiring, allowing the scans to stay up for the entire match.

Infinity Ward has not commented directly on that trait, but the developer confirmed it's being changed so the Sedative Inhaler - which hides you from UAVs - also works with those trait-upgraded towers, though that change won't arrive until sometime in Season 1.

Finally, today's update further makes it easier to stay undetected by boosting the Sedative Inhaler's duration to 120 seconds, double that of the previous 60, which should help while we wait for larger changes to be implemented.

Diungkapkan bahwa dmz has been one of modern warfare 4's most discussed modes online. Recently, players discovered what appears to be a separate matchmaking pool for Story Missions that prevents solo sessions from featuring other players, though with some caveats.

#604. Genshin Impact Version Luna 4 introduces three new playable characters, including the long-awaited Moon Maiden Columbina

Tanggal: 02 Jan 2026 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/genshin-impact-version-luna-iv-date-details

The first major Genshin Impact update in 2026 is almost here, bringing characters we've been waiting a while to play, and more besides.

Sebagaimana diketahui, genshin impact’s latest special program has spilled all the beans on the game’s next major update, luna 4. The update, which arrives on January 14, kicks off 2026 with several bits of new content, including some previously-teased characters.

Dubbed Traveler on a Winter's Night, Luna 4 introduces three new playable characters, and brings back The Lantern Rite event to celebrate the beginning of the new year.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the first new arrival in version luna 4 is columbina hyposelenia, the moon maiden. Her kit revolves around supporting the squad via Lunar Reactions. Columbina is a 5-Star Hydro Catalyst wielder. She can trigger coordinated Lunar Reaction DMG, even when she’s off the field.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the moon maiden’s special ability, lunar domain, further boosts all lunar reactions by applying a dmg bonus, including summoning more thundercloud strikes for lunar-charged reactions. Columbina is also capable of converting Electro-Charged, Bloom, and Hydro Crystallize reactions into Lunar Reactions, as well as revive fallen squad members.

Diungkapkan bahwa speaking of elemental reactions, new in this version is lunar-crystallize, a new reaction that’s triggered when geo meets hydro (under certain conditions). When triggered, Lunar-Crystallize summons three Moondrifts near enemies. When triggered three times, Moondrift Harmony gets activated, dealing Geo DMG to enemies caught in its radius.

Berdasarkan laporan, then there’s zibai, an adeptus from liyue. Zibai is another 5-Star character, a Geo Sword wielder. Zibai can, through entering a special state where they can build up energy, unleash an Elemental Skill that deals Lunar-Crystallize DMG.

The longer the fight goes on, the more Lunar-Crystallize reactions are triggered, the higher (and more often) the damage of Zibai’s Elemental Skill becomes.

Sebagaimana diketahui, luna 4 continues the nod-krai story arc, with a big confrontation with il dottore. This is the focus of the new Archon Quest, completing which will earn you a new outfit. There’s a gameplay element to that new chapter, too, with the reveal of Piramida, a new area north of the region. Piramida is the headquarters of the Lightkeepers.

Diungkapkan bahwa the first phase of luna 4’s event wishes will, unsurprisingly, feature columbina. The second phase is when Zibai becomes available, alongside another newcomer: Illuga, a 4-Star, polearm-wielding Geo Lightkeeper. It’ll also include reruns of Ineffa. The second phase’s rerun will be Neuvillette, who’s also going to have a new outfit in the shop at a discount.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, version luna 4 brings back the annual lantern rite event, taking place in the mainland of liyue. The event features its own set of minigames with unique rewards, alongside new stories of the Adepti.

Berdasarkan laporan, all around liyue harbor, you’ll be able to place xiao lanterns and inscribe them with messages for others to read. You’ll also earn some Fortune Coins from Auspicious Treasure Trees, which you can later exchange for gifts.

Berdasarkan laporan, all players will receive 1,600 primogems through the in-game mail. If you log in regularly, you can earn up to ten Intertwined Fates. Lantern Rite has a new outfit for Yaoyao, which is also where you have a chance to earn one 4-Star Liyue character for free.

Finally, you can look forward to the new Classic Mode in Miliastra Wonderland, which lets you invite select Teyvat characters to join you.

#611. An Elder Scrolls Classic Is Finally Getting the Remaster It Deserves After 22 Years

📅 11 Nov 2026

An Elder Scrolls Classic Is Finally Getting the Remaster It Deserves After 22 Years

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/an-elder-scrolls-classic-is-finally-getting-remaster-after-22-years/

Berdasarkan laporan, covering the video games industry since 2017, with experience in news, articles, and reviews. Currently a writer at DualShockers and gaming magazines.

As a nostalgic gamer, I have a soft spot for forgotten games that were left behind by time, especially when they're part of a franchise as beloved as The Elder Scrolls.

Diungkapkan bahwa while most players have spent the past two decades exploring morrowind, oblivion, and skyrim, one rather unusual entry in the series has been sitting on a much less familiar platform: the nokia n-gage. Thankfully, that's about to change!.

The Elder Scrolls Travels: Shadowkey, a first-person RPG originally released in 2004, is getting a second chance thanks to an independent project called Shadowkey Reforged.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, developed by dan whelan, the project brings the forgotten spin-off to windows, mac, and android with a new engine, widescreen support, controller compatibility, and plenty of visual and gameplay improvements. Even better, it's launching today, November 11.

Morrowind is rightfully regarded as one of the greatest open-world RPGs of all time, but it's aged badly and would benefit from a full remake.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for anyone unfamiliar with it, shadowkey was the third entry in the elder scrolls travels, a series of portable spin-offs released between morrowind and oblivion. Unlike the mainline games, however, it was exclusive to Nokia's N-Gage, a rather ambitious handheld-phone hybrid that didn't exactly have the longest life on the market.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that exclusivity made shadowkey one of the more inaccessible chapters in the franchise's history. And while you could technically track down the original hardware and a copy of the game, that's hardly the most convenient way to revisit a 22-year-old RPG.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that's where shadowkey reforged comes in! rather than simply emulating the n-gage, whelan built a new engine capable of running the original game's data and scripts on modern devices. Players can choose between a Classic mode that preserves the original presentation and a Modern mode featuring upgraded artwork, improved lighting, and several gameplay additions. So yes, it is literally the best of both worlds.

For anyone unfamiliar with it, Shadowkey was the third entry in The Elder Scrolls Travels, a series of portable spin-offs released between Morrowind and Oblivion.

Berdasarkan laporan, the latter isn't just a fresh coat of paint, by the way. You can also toggle individual features to customize the experience instead of committing to one preset. Modern mode introduces features inspired by newer Elder Scrolls games, including stamina-based sprinting, stealth, and ragdoll physics. And if you happen to have The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind installed, there's another neat little bonus: Shadowkey Reforged can use its soundtrack and sound effects, preserving a connection between two games released during the same era, in case you want an extra touch!.

Skyblivion team says a former volunteer is threatening legal action, even after the devs removed their code and rebuilt the affected systems.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, interestingly, whelan has also been transparent about using ai during development. According to the developer, AI tools helped with coding, building the engine, and debugging, while the updated artwork combines AI-generated images with Photoshop and manual sprite editing.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, shadowkey reforged is available as a free, unofficial project, with versions for windows, mac, and android. However, there's one important detail players should know before getting too excited: the download doesn't include the original game's files. This means you'll need to provide your own copy of Shadowkey to play it – you can check more info about that on the port’s website.

Berdasarkan laporan, still, it's great to see such an obscure piece of the elder scrolls history getting another shot at life. Bethesda hasn't announced an official remaster, but Whelan's project might be the closest many players will get to experiencing this forgotten adventure without digging up a Nokia N-Gage.

#613. Legendary game creator Vince Zampella has passed away

📅 23 Dec 2025

Legendary game creator Vince Zampella has passed away

Tanggal: 23 Dec 2025 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/vince-zampella-call-of-duty-co-creator-passes-away-55

Vince Zampella, co-creator of Call of Duty, and a veteran studio head responsible for some of the biggest franchises in the world, is gone.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, vince zampella, known for co-creating the call of duty series, among many other roles, has died. Zampella, 55, died in a car crash in Los Angeles on Sunday. The fatal crash killed him, along with the occupant of his car.

Sebagaimana diketahui, according to nbc, zampella’s ferrari hit a concrete barrier after leaving a tunnel in the san gabriel mountains, north of los angeles. Zampella was unfortunately trapped in an ensuing car fire, and the passenger was ejected.

Sebagaimana diketahui, vince zampella is one of the industry’s most prolific creators. His storied career is long, and is responsible for some of the biggest shooter franchises in history. It started with Medal of Honor in the 90s, a game that changed WW2 shooters forever.

Berdasarkan laporan, zampella later co-founded the legendary infinity ward in 2002, the team that would go on to redefine multiplayer shooters forever. Infinity Ward is the studio responsible for the Call of Duty series, which remains one of the biggest games for publisher Activision, and the entire industry.

Berdasarkan laporan, zampella then left the studio he founded in 2010 following a major fallout with activision. He, along with longtime collaborator, Jason West, went to rival publisher EA to form Respawn Entertainment.

Diungkapkan bahwa respawn went on to create the titanfall series, and later apex legends. The studio is responsible for non-shooters, of course, like the third-person action game series Star Wars Jedi. Zampella was instrumental in making the game possible, having hired God of War 3 director Stig Asmussen to helm a team within Respawn out of a desire to diversify the studio’s output and prove he can do more than make shooters.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, zampella had only recently met with journalists and peers at the game awards, where battlefield 6 was nominated for multiple awards. Battlefield 6 is the most successful game in series history, in part as a result of Zampella’s leadership. The legendary leader was given the reigns of the struggling multiplayer shooter franchise in 2021, with a goal of finding a viable future.

Zampella’s sudden death has shaken the industry, and many mourn his loss as the news started spreading.

“We are heartbroken by the loss of Vince Zampella, a creative leader whose work shaped generations of players and helped define what modern shooters and action games could be,” EA said in a statement.

Berdasarkan laporan, “while his impact reached far beyond any one game or studio, we will remember vince for how he showed up every day, trusting his teams, encouraging bold ideas, and believing in battlefield and the people building it. We are deeply grateful for his leadership, his generosity, and the care he brought to everything he touched, and we will carry that forward with us. ”.

Jacek Rozenek was the voice of Geralt in all previous Polish-language Witcher releases, and CD Projekt wanted to work with him again—but his voice is no longer a match.

Berdasarkan laporan, when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Game File reports that CD Projekt worked with AI company Respeecher to modify the voice of Geralt's Polish voice actor in the upcoming Songs of the Past expansion for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt.

Berdasarkan laporan, the actor, jacek rozenek, voiced geralt in the polish editions of all the witcher games, including the witcher 3 and its two expansions, and the game file report says his performances are highly regarded. But in 2019, he had a stroke that left him temporarily unable to speak; by 2021 he had rehabilitated enough to be able to provide some new lines for The Witcher 3's next-gen update, but the process left him "exhausted. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa still, he continued to train and was eventually able to return to work, and when cd projekt decided to make a new witcher 3 expansion it wanted him back for the role. But the stroke, and the passage of time, had left Rozenek's voice noticeably changed. Given that Songs of the Past will occur in the midst of The Witcher 3, that shift in tone—"lower [and] gruffer," according to Game File's Stephen Totilo—presented a problem.

Diungkapkan bahwa so with rozenek's permission, cd projekt approached ai voice company respeecher to rework his voice for the game. Rozenek is still providing the voice of Geralt in the Polish version of the expansion, but Respeecher is adjusting it to make him sound like he did a decade ago.

"The brief was simple: make Jacek’s voice sound alive, rich and young, like in the original game," synthetic speech artist Dmytro Vasylets said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "getting there took dozens of hours, training models, going through the details with the cdpr team, and dealing with ai artifacts that never fully disappear. The hardest part was Jacek’s emotional range: the half-tones, shouts, groans, anger, fear and laughter. I’d like to think we pulled it off. Capturing all of that at the highest audio quality was the real challenge. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa rozenek said he feels "very good" about returning to the role of geralt because he's so familiar with the character; the issue was merely that his voice was different. "I have great trust…for the creators of this game. Because of that, he's all in favor of the AI treatment: "The point is that this voice should be as close as possible to my voice from 12 years ago," he said. ".

Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team.

Diungkapkan bahwa this isn't cd projekt's first time working with respeecher: it previously used the company to reproduce the voice of miłogost reczek, who portrayed viktor vektor and vesemir in the polish releases of cyberpunk 2077 and the witcher 3. Reczek died in 2021; in that case, CD Projekt had the family's blessing to use an AI recreation of the actor's voice.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the use of generative ai in voice acting is an incredibly thorny issue, one that voice actors have gone to great lengths to maintain some control over. The studio is not planning to do anything similar with the voice of Doug Cockle, who portrays Geralt in the English releases of The Witcher games, Szwed said; Rozenek's voice would also not be altered in any hypothetical future Witcher games set later in the timeline, because the vocal change would be explainable: "It's more about this specific situation here, where we have both the voice from 12 years ago and from now next to each other. CD Projekt itself has been ambivalent about AI; localization producer Mikołaj Szwed told Game File that "as a person working with voice actors over all the regions in the world, this is a big concern," although he added that "this was a special case" caused by Rozenek's health problems. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, interestingly, the news of rozenek's ai-powered vocal overhaul comes just one day after veteran voice actor stephen russell appeared in a nightdive podcast and discussed returning to the role of garrett in the upcoming thief: the dark project remaster. It's been more than 20 years since Russell last portrayed the character, in 2004's Thief: Deadly Shadows, which meant he had to be more conscious of his pitch and delivery while working on content for the new Tarnished Mirror expansion.

But while "the equipment changes," as Russell said, Rozenek's stroke created a more substantial change: Totilo said his untouched voice in the expansion "sounds deep and gravelly, noticeably rougher than his recordings for the original game," while the AI-edited voice is much closer to Rozenek's voice as it was a decade ago.

#616. It looks like Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 had fewer active players at launch in the US compared to last year's Black Ops 7

📅 03 Nov 2026

It looks like Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 had fewer active players at launch in the US compared to last year's Black Ops 7

Tanggal: 03 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-player-engagement-black-ops-7

Diungkapkan bahwa it's been speculated for a while that call of duty may be losing its lustre. Although we don't have concrete data with detailed statistics for each game released in the last several years, there's an observable trend in player numbers that's hard to ignore.

US market analysis firm Circana published some data showing player engagement with Modern Warfare 4 following its launch, and compared them to those by Black Ops 7.

Berdasarkan laporan, the data is based on circana's proprietary player engagement tracker, which tracks player activity in the us across steam and playstation, and worldwide on xbox. According to Circana analyst Mat Piscatella, 19 percent of players on PlayStation played Modern Warfare 4 in the week ending 24th October, compared to 17 percent on Xbox, and 4. 2 percent on Steam.

Diungkapkan bahwa with the exception of steam, those numbers are down compared to last year's black ops 7, which saw 23 percent engagement on playstation, 29 percent on xbox, and a meagre 1. 5 percent on Steam during its launch week.

Diungkapkan bahwa call of duty managed to land in the top 10 across all three platforms during the same week ending 24th october, per circana. In fact, it sat just below Fortnite on PlayStation, which is a decent result.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the large drop in activity on xbox could be explained by modern warfare 4's lack of a day-one release on game pass. Black Ops 7 was the second (and last) Call of Duty to launch on Game Pass day-and-date with its premium release. Game Pass availability typically boosts player numbers, though not always sales.

The drop on PlayStation is a little harder to explain, but could be a side effect of the incredibly successful Black Ops 1 & 2 ports released in the summer on PS4 and PS5, which captured lapsed players who may have simply lost interest in modern Call of Duty, regardless of the perceived quality of Modern Warfare 4.

Judging by the data we have access to, such as SteamDB numbers showing Modern Warfare 4's launch compared to Black Ops 7's and other recent releases, there's evidence this year's game perhaps isn't as popular as it could've been.

Diungkapkan bahwa indeed, even activision's tenor when talking about call of duty first weekend sales has changed. The publisher issued a single statement following Modern Warfare 4's launch, through Xbox CEO Asha Sharma, which does not even mention the game by name.

Berdasarkan laporan, "one of the most celebrated call of duty games in its 24-year history, and now $40bn in lifetime franchise revenue," sharma wrote on x. Congrats to the Activision team. "An incredible milestone. And to the players, thank you for being with us. ".

Last year's Black Ops 7 post-launch statement sidestepped talk of sales and revenue entirely, insteading praising the "great response to the quality and depth of gameplay in Black Ops 7".
