#618. 10 Most Creative Traversal Abilities in Metroidvanias

📅 11 Nov 2026

10 Most Creative Traversal Abilities in Metroidvanias

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/most-creative-traversal-abilities-in-metroidvanias/

Ronald is a video game journalist with more than 10 years of experience in the industry, working on several of the most important Spanish websites.

Movement abilities in Metroidvanias are a fundamental part of their appeal, determining both the pace of exploration and our ability to interact with the surrounding world.

The genre is built on understanding spaces, their composition, and how to traverse them, making movement a crucial variable regardless of the game's perspective, mechanics, or philosophy.

As a result, the possibilities a game enables for movement along the Cartesian plane largely determine how satisfying, tense, or rewarding a campaign will be, depending on its intended purpose.

Therefore, in order to pay homage to those video games that make the best possible use of the philosophy of moving from one place to another, here are the ten most creative traversal abilities in Metroidvanias.

One of the main problems games in this genre face when creating spectacular movement abilities lies in their limitations, as they have to be balanced so that they aren't too powerful.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for this reason, silk soar from hollow knight: silksong is a masterpiece of design. Among all the powers in Metroidvanias that let you fly upwards, it's part of the few that properly contextualize the limits of its capabilities.

Not only do you acquire it in the game's last third, unexpectedly opening paths out of nowhere, but its use is also tied to your needle, requiring the presence of a ceiling to be used, so you can't just break the map's traversal in its entirety.

In terms of creativity, it's on the spectrum's simpler side, yet it solves a major verticality imbalance by granting you a great deal of ease in exploration without making you overpowered, which is a tremendous feat.

Going in the opposite direction from the previous entry, Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo is a constant display of reinterpreting Metroidvanias' most common forms of movement, with Walk the Dog being the crown jewel.

The game plays with yo-yo tricks to establish its mechanics, adapting them with thematic coherence to make you feel that, more than just having powers within a video game, you're learning new maneuvers to show off.

In this particular instance, it's as simple as being able to move orthogonally across the map at a greater speed, but this is maximized thanks to the bounce pads distributed throughout all areas that change your direction and make the ability the key to numerous puzzles.

Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo is brimming with ideas magnificently adapted to its setting, making it by far one of the most inventive Metroidvanias to come out this decade.

Well Dweller breaks one of the genre's cardinal rules by not including a double jump at any point in its story, though it compensates with a Slingshot mechanic that is simply mesmerizing.

The title allows you to throw your weapon and embed it in any surface to use it as a springboard and jump higher than usual, encouraging inquisitive and creative exploration in a truly compelling way.

Most of the game's movement is based on the biomes you find yourself in, whether in the form of bubbles, air currents, or elevators, and it works precisely because this direct yet versatile ability adapts to any situation.

Of course, it leaves you without any means of defense, but, like Kratos's Leviathan Axe, Well Dweller's matchstick flies back to you when you need it, which also leads to spectacular and almost cinematic moments when transitioning from platforming to combat.

If you're looking for games that subvert your expectations, try these eight Metroidvanias that totally reinvent themselves halfway through.

In terms of inventiveness, Animal Well is a couple of notches above the rest of the genre, with all its progression tools being as unique as they're rewarding.

Since the title is more puzzle-based than platforming-focused, most of its abilities are proportional to said distribution, but the Disc is a versatile component that you can use both to solve environmental puzzles and to traverse in seemingly impossible ways.

Throwing the frisbee and timing its trajectory to hop on and soar through the air never gets old, both because of how mechanically satisfying it is and because of all the paths mastering this skill opens up.

Animal Well is a sandbox where most of its castles are built through iteration and experimentation, but fortunately, you have the Disc on your side to make the journey faster, smoother, and more enjoyable.

Despite my reservations about Constance due to its short length and limited side content, its movement mechanics are some of the smoothest I've ever seen in the genre, with Paint Dive being the standout.

It functions as both a dash and a dematerialization of the character, allowing her to blend into the environment and pass through obstacles and hazards as a graceful mass of purple paint that seamlessly integrates with the surroundings.

In its abstract form, it's simply a directional boost, yet its execution is elevated by the environments, which force you to use the ability in increasingly diverse ways, ensuring it's more than just a regular push.

Given that platforming is Constance's forte, Paint Dive plays a prominent role throughout the entire campaign, making it a proportionally more important element of the game than many of the other abilities on this list.

From classic Resident Evil to Dark Souls, these are eight Non-Metroidvanias that heavily influenced the genre.

Returning to what I mentioned about Silk Soar and the problems of having very powerful abilities, the Crystal Arrows in Aeterna Noctis take the conversation to another level by granting you the power to teleport to wherever you aim them.

Certainly, they're used in many of the most excruciatingly difficult platforming sections the genre has ever seen, but also in one of the deepest movement systems.

Being able to chain together consecutive teleportations while fighting and traversing Aeterna's world quickly becomes a delight, especially once you get used to them and feel you've mastered their immeasurable offensive and defensive potential.

While Aeterna Noctis' structure doesn't fully capitalize on the Crystal Arrows, they remain magnificent and satisfying, surprisingly without ever breaking the game's sequence.

Castlevania: Symphony of the Night dares to take its most unusual ability and only make it necessary for a limited number of sections, yet the Mist Form remains an unforgettable memory for anyone who plays the game.

Becoming an incorporeal entity to pass through bars is the kind of power fantasy that only a character like Alucard can materialize, with the added significance of having achieved something so astonishing thirty years ago.

Although there aren't many mandatory instances where you must use it, the ability is a major surprise when you unlock it, primarily when it becomes an incredibly powerful toxic weapon that allows you to both move freely and eliminate all enemies in your path.

Years have passed, and I don't think I've ever been so impacted by unlocking a new ability, which only speaks to Castlevania: Symphony of the Night's timeless greatness.

Of all the innovations that Ori and the Blind Forest brought to the genre during the formative years when its heirs were still establishing themselves, Bash is undoubtedly the most prominent.

The ability to bounce off both enemies and projectiles to move omnidirectionally and reach new heights and locations is absurdly incredible from the very first minute to the last.

The mechanic was significantly improved in the sequel, yet its stellar and unprecedented appearance in the franchise's first title is a core memory of the genre, particularly due to its use in combat to stylize every fight sequence.

I must admit Ori and the Blind Forest isn't among my favorite Metroidvanias, though that doesn't stop me from acknowledging that, in terms of uniqueness, there's no other ability that truly compares to Bash.

If you're already tired of 2D side-scrolling games, I recommend you read about these ten best first-person Metroidvanias, ranked.

By 1994 standards, the existence of a video game of Super Metroid's caliber seems absolutely insane, as years have passed and the game remains so fresh and enjoyable that it's astonishing how ahead of its time it was.

People usually praise the Shinespark or the Morph Ball, which are masterful abilities by any measure, but I have to admit that what truly amazed me was the Grapple Beam and how wonderfully it utilizes Zebes' layout.

You spend much of the journey wondering what those strange cross-shaped blocks are for, and when you discover that they allow you to aim a beam that lets you swing freely, spin, and propel yourself at top speed, you can't help but be blown away.

Whether you played it back then or today, Super Metroid surprises you with its mastery at every turn, and there are so many ways I could have included it on this list that all I can do is stand up and applaud.

I'm going to lean towards modernity to define the top spot on this list and praise the work of MIO: Memories in Orbit, a contemporary masterpiece of the genre whose scale is truly breathtaking.

There are many reasons to say this, but unlocking the Striders, tendrils into legs and arms that can grab any surface to walk on walls, was the moment in its campaign when I realized I wasn't just playing a good Metroidvania.

Even though their use is limited by a stamina bar, thinking about the titanic effort it must have taken to craft each room of its vast map based on the eventual access to this omnipotent movement tool makes me dizzy.

Not only does it have fluid and pristine animation with perfect sound design, but it also blends seamlessly with exploration and platforming mechanics to make everything related to movement a true gift for players.

I've had many surprising moments with movement mechanics in the genre, yet the Striders in MIO: Memories in Orbit are unique while also being functional, powerful, and visually appealing, which is an elevated balance that's extremely difficult to achieve.

From the best bosses to essential lore explanations, these are eight Metroidvanias that hide their best content behind the most unexpected paths.

#620. I'm sad that the Like A Dragon creator's new studio is closing, but I wish their now-cancelled debut Gang of Dragon wasn't just LAD again

📅 03 Nov 2026

I'm sad that the Like A Dragon creator's new studio is closing, but I wish their now-cancelled debut Gang of Dragon wasn't just LAD again

Tanggal: 03 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/im-sad-that-the-like-a-dragon-creators-new-studio-is-closing-but-i-wish-their-now-cancelled-debut-gang-of-dragon-wasnt-just-lad-again

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, less than a year after the announcement of their first game, and only four years after the studio's creation, gang of dragon developers nagoshi studio have been dissolved by a shareholders' resolution (thanks, gematsu. Don Lee). ) That also means a premature end for Gang of Dragon, which was announced at last year's Game Awards with a flashy trailer featuring Like a Dragon-esque realistic visuals, combat and exploration through Kabukicho, a couple new elements like actual gunplay and car chases, as well as the star power of actor Ma Dong-seok (a. k. a. Following reports in March that NetEase, the studio's source of funding, would be pulling said funding in May due to ballooning costs reaching around seven billion yen, the time has sadly come for Nagoshi Studio, having not found any alternative funding sources in the time since.

Diungkapkan bahwa gang of dragon looked very much to be 'just like a dragon again', which i find to be something of a depressing fate for a studio headed by the original series' creator. I love Ma Dong-seok as an actor, but his presence was one of the more blatant, 'look, we got that guy!' castings of the LAD archetype, which is saying something considering Infinite Wealth had fucking Danny Trejo in a prominent role. Having left Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio following Judgment and Yakuza: Like a Dragon, two of its most innovative games both with new protagonists and one entirely new turn-based gameplay style, it feels indicative of the industry that Nagoshi was granted funding seemingly on the condition that the studio makes something that just looks like the rest of the Like a Dragon series. The trailer closing with a shot of Dong-seok framed by Kabukicho's torii gate, maybe the most famous image from the Like a Dragon series, put a sour taste in my mouth as being just more of the same brand recognition (yet, for a new IP!) to prioritise safe return on investment.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i'm unfortunately not that surprised to see gang of dragon and nagoshi studio lost to time, though i am sad about it. I have some conflicted feelings on Nagoshi as a person/auteur, but I don't think he, or his studio, deserves to have funding pulled before they could even release anything as a result of NetEase deciding to pull investments out of non-Chinese companies over time. It's unknown what Nagoshi and the team will be attempting next, but I truly hope they can eventually make something. No More Heroes studio Grasshopper Manufacture was able to detach themselves from NetEase very recently and possibly avoid a similar fate, so it might not be impossible.

Helldivers 2, in the running for the most review-bombed game in history, got another Steam beating a few weeks back when Arrowhead announced a change in anti-cheat services that would break or disallow existing mods.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the goal with the switch from gameguard to easy anti-cheat, as the studio explained at the time, was to combat mods that "create unfair advantages or negatively impact others," but it also acknowledged that mods it has no problems with, like cosmetic add-ons, would also be affected. The news went over like a lead balloon, prompting over 10,000 fresh negative Steam reviews and a "mostly negative" recent rating.

Sebagaimana diketahui, skimming the last few weeks of ratings, negative reviewers are either miffed about their broken mods, new and old bugs, or the perception that arrowhead is attacking modders instead of fixing bugs. There was no reality where a community notorious for intensely boycotting everything it finds annoying was going to embrace stricter modding oversight, but Arrowhead did address the outcry in its latest Helldivers 2 developer blog.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "we added easy anti-cheat for one reason: to reduce the number of cheaters joining your missions and ruining the experience. "However, we do see that this change means that some PC players lost the use of fan-made game mods. This has resulted in adjustments that should allow some cosmetic mods to be functional with our next hotfix. On that front, we think we’re taking steps in the right direction," the blog read. While all mods are not officially supported, we have been reviewing how the code changes disabled cosmetic non-gameplay mods. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, mod restriction is a prickly topic for helldivers 2, which is both a perfectly valid candidate for mods as a purely pve game, but also a live service with real-money currency and dlc. A common form of cheating in Helldivers 2 is to use mods to farm (or straight up spawn) premium Super Credits that are supposed to be rare. Another is to alter weapon or enemy behavior in ways that are unfair to vanilla teammates trying to play normally, or in some cases cause client crashes.

Berdasarkan laporan, i'm guessing arrowhead is slightly more concerned about the folks farming free currency at rapid speeds than the ones with infinite ammo cheats, but it won't be budging on outlawing gameplay-altering mods that, "from a technical perspective, are indistinguishable from an attempt to cheat. ".

But that's not the only thing the Reddit crowd is pissed about: The studio also acknowledged that promised improvements to hellpod steering and stratagem bouncing have taken longer than planned because they "require substantial adjustments to both mechanics while taking into account all edge cases," copped to missing patch dates on its current roadmap, and apologized for overselling the arrival of bug caves on more map types as a "new biome" on the same roadmap.

Sebagaimana diketahui, final fantasy is a series absolutely defined by its music, with truly legendary composers and artists stemming from every title. Sadly, Final Fantasy 14’s Twitter announced earlier today that Eikichi Iwai, bassist for the band made for the game THE PRIMALS, has passed away. After recently performing at the most recent Japanese Fan Fest, his passing is a sudden low blow that has staggered fans across the globe.

Berdasarkan laporan, the primals are the standout musicians of final fantasy 14, far from the only incredibly talented maestros making the music happen, but definitely the flashiest. Often brought out to live events for both their own original tracks and covers of some of 14's other greatest hits, THE PRIMALS helped forge some of the greatest tracks to grace Final Fantasy 14, and Iwai-san's absence will be deeply felt in future events.

Sebagaimana diketahui, while the rest of the musicians behind ff 14 and his bandmates on the primals will feel the most potent loss, fans across the globe are aching as well, already holding in-game mourning vigils throughout eorzea. Sitting by fires and playing different pieces of music Iwai worked on, fans are lamenting his passing the best way they know how, by celebrating all he gave to them.

THE PRIMALS are the standout musicians of Final Fantasy 14, far from the only incredibly talented maestros making the music happen, but definitely the flashiest.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the primals have backed some of the most pivotal moments in final fantasy 14’s history, bouncing from raid layers to incredibly crucial story moments to general world traversal. As a band, they’re incredibly flexible and talented, with a good part of that grit coming from Iwai’s incredible bass play. The future of the band is currently uncertain, especially with how sudden Iwai’s loss truly was.

Diungkapkan bahwa eikichi iwai passed at age 57, a titan of his craft and an incredible musician across his pursuits, charming millions who played final fantasy 14 and all who followed his long history with the band chirinuruwowaka, of which he was a founding member. Never one to slow down or stop making music, with his recent showing at the latest Japanese FF14 Fan Fest being cited as one of THE PRIMALS best ever showings.

Diungkapkan bahwa after suffering a loss like iwai’s, it’s important to remember just how lucky we are to enjoy such incredibly skilled artists in their primes. Final Fantasy 14 has its issues, but music has never been one of them, carrying many crucial emotional scenes with next-level tracks again and again.

Sebagaimana diketahui, close in the distance, a long fall, and rise, all written by masayoshi soken, show a mastery of tone and emotion across an incredible range, perfectly putting players in the mindset of the current moment. THE PRIMALS’ own coverage of tracks like Footfalls and Dawntrail gives each song life, fueled by THE PRIMALS’ incredible energy.

Diungkapkan bahwa i genuinely believe you could find someone who cites almost every song in final fantasy 14 as one of their favorites, and that’s amazing. The incredible display of artistry throughout the title is a large reason why it has lasted as long as it has with the massive fanbase it has cultivated.

Diungkapkan bahwa with live service games and mmos like final fantasy 14, it can be all too easy and lucrative to fall into the trappings of consumerism, focusing on the product rather than the art. FF really doesn’t have that issue. FF14 has always felt like a title guided by the artists who create it, and after the loss of such a powerful artist, it’s up to the rest of us to keep on that path. Rest in peace, Eikichi Iwai.

Diungkapkan bahwa rooted in wuxian storytelling and scale, built on an impressively detailed combat system, and wrapped in a bloody chinese martial underground that’s a genuine joy to play in, phantom blade zero is a feat. It joins an echelon of action pedigree that includes Sekiro, Devil May Cry, Bayonetta, and just about any other action game you hold in high regard. It hails from developer S-Game, which has dabbled in mobile and smaller-scale games, and I’m shocked by what it’s pulled off with its triple-A action inauguration. But make no mistake: though Phantom Blade Zero is this team’s first crack at a game like this, it is an incredibly confident, strong debut.

Berdasarkan laporan, protagonist soul is a stoic martial arts master betrayed by the order he’s sworn his life to; he dies and returns to life with only 66 days to live. That’s enough time to settle his debts, repay his betrayers, and end a villainous conspiracy to seize full power of the Wulin realm. This narrative is Phantom Blade Zero's weakest link, but its premise adds enough mystery and tension to keep this Wuxian journey exciting through to its final, realm-shattering moments. Narrative bombshells drop not just through the game’s general fantasy-realism art direction, but also through anime scenes, opera puppet shows, animated brushstroke sequences, and more, highlighting Chinese culture and its integral place in Phantom Blade Zero.

Diungkapkan bahwa the game features a staggering number of unique enemy types, and though the final hours get a bit repetitive, it’s admirable how long s-game maintains such a high level of combat-oriented ecstasy. Because the combat is combo-based, picking up a new weapon feels like unlocking a new character in a fighting game. Each has its own moveset and abilities, with later-game weapons featuring combo lists that look more at home in a Street Fighter menu. Every weapon is wholly unique. Soul’s access to weapons drives that exhilaration. Add in the special, tide-turning weapons known as Phantom Edges, with limited charge-based uses, and there’s no shortage of permutations to delightfully experiment with.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, drawing on chinese cinema, phantom blade zero's setpiece bosses boast a sense of awe and scale only the genre's best typically offer. With virtually no repeat bosses, save for a few in separate trials, it’s impressive how many powerful figures I flayed, and how many delivered a unique fight. I also appreciate the checkpoints between boss phases, as they remove the frustrating repetition of replaying phase one again and again just to take another stab at the second phase I’m struggling with.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, you’d be forgiven for assuming phantom blade zero is a soulslike, given its challenging bosses, interconnected world, and phantom bell checkpoints, this game’s equivalent of bonfires. World progression is materially different, too, as enemies don’t respawn after you kill them. It definitively isn’t, though. Soul is on a mission to remove evil, and mechanically, I’m doing just that. It’s an interesting, perhaps blasphemous, choice for the genre, but it's surprisingly effective, adding a sense of worldbuilding and tangible progression I didn’t know I wanted from my action games. The challenge is much more surmountable; the game isn’t interested in making you die over and over, there are difficulty options, and you can equip accessories to make parries and dodges easier. Enemies don’t respawn incoherently just because I heal and save.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, environmental features weave in and out of each other, and the architectural design and layout of these regions lead to many subsequent “aha” moments. A lot of it is optional, as are some of Phantom Blade Zero's most rewarding elements, including its demanding “perfect” ending. As a result, backtracking and exploration remain fresh. S-Game infuses search-action elements into this exploration through the aforementioned Phantom Edges, some of which double as tools to unlock surprising new areas in both new and previously visited biomes. Sadly, this renders other endings unsatisfying, with clear chunks intentionally missing.

Berdasarkan laporan, despite forays into the uncanny valley, phantom blade zero is visually striking, and the action is brilliantly animated. It’s all set to genre-breaking music, too, with original metalcore songs, operatic choirs, 808s, and traditional Chinese instrumentation, creating a score as illustrious as the action it enhances.

Diungkapkan bahwa phantom blade zero is an astounding action achievement, almost unbelievably so for a game that is essentially a studio’s genre debut. It is one of the best action games I’ve ever played, one that recognizes the genre’s strengths and weaknesses and addresses both with fantastical Wuxian style. Though the action genre is always jam-packed with new releases, few are as special as Phantom Blade Zero.

#629. It’s official: Battlefield 6 is 2025's best-selling game, but Black Ops 7 still managed to be November’s top-seller

📅 18 Dec 2025

It’s official: Battlefield 6 is 2025's best-selling game, but Black Ops 7 still managed to be November’s top-seller

Tanggal: 18 Dec 2025 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/game-hardware-sales-circana-november-2025-battlefield-6-black-ops-7

2025 will be remembered for many things, but in the ultra-competitive games industry, it’s going to be thought of as the year Battlefield 6 did what many thought couldn’t happen.

Berdasarkan laporan, circan’s november 2025 video game sales report has easily been one of the most anticipated. For one, November is always one of the most lucrative for the games industry, but this year in particular has seen several major hits - including new entries in two rival series.

Berdasarkan laporan, we’re talking, of course, about battlefield 6, and black ops 7 the latest releases in their respective multiplayer shooter series. The decades-old fight to claim the top spot has long been won by Call of Duty, but the latest Battlefield has achieved what many thought was impossible.

Sebagaimana diketahui, cricana’s report covers spending on video game software, hardware, and accessories in the u. November 2025 saw spending fall by 4% compared to November 2024, bringing in a total of $5. S. 9 billion.

Berdasarkan laporan, software technically saw growth during the month, but declines in hardware, and accessories were mainly responsible for the drop in overall spending. Black Ops 7 continued Call of Duty’s 18-Year Streak in topping sales in its launch month.

Diungkapkan bahwa however, this year’s game did not also top the year-to-date charts, something the series has done consistently, and more than any other top-selling game each year - with rare exceptions. Battlefield 6 is firmly in the lead there, cementing its claim as 2025’s best-selling title. Black Ops 7, fittingly, occupies in the #7 spot there.

Diungkapkan bahwa separately from the best-selling game title fight, november has actually been one of the worst for the industry in terms of hardware sales. The report notes that the three major platform holders - Sony, Microsoft, and Nintendo have all seen their hardware sales decline.

Diungkapkan bahwa spending on hardware during november amounted to only $695 million, a massive 27% decline compared to november 2024. According to the report, that’s the worst dollar amount total for any November since 2005, when it comes to hardware specifically. All three current-gen consoles totaled 1. 6 million units sold, which Circana also notes is the lowest for any November since 1995.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this all doesn’t bode especially well for the industry. November has always been a key holiday shopping month, but it’s clear the constantly rising console prices - and already high game prices - have had a big impact.

#631. Arc Raiders devs Embark insist that using genAI for voice lines was necessary, as "actors would just go crazy if they had to read all of that"

📅 03 Nov 2026

Arc Raiders devs Embark insist that using genAI for voice lines was necessary, as "actors would just go crazy if they had to read all of that"

Tanggal: 03 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/arc-raiders-devs-embark-insist-that-using-genai-for-voice-lines-was-necessary-as-actors-would-just-go-crazy-if-they-had-to-read-all-of-that

Berdasarkan laporan, despite taking the voice performances of actors and feeding them into machines to spurt out ai-generated mimicry, embark cco stefan strandberg insists that "we are not in the industry of replacing actors. " In a new video posted to the Arc Raiders channel focused on audio design, Strandberg refers back to the infamous use of genAI in Arc Raiders to generate voice lines based on real voice actors' performances, something which the game was heavily (and rightly) criticised for before and since its release.

Diungkapkan bahwa in that linked piece (thanks oisin!), ceo patrick söderlund stated that they have been replacing lines that were originally generated with actual recorded lines, presumably because arc raiders has made quite a bit of money and now they feel that they can continue paying actors to record more lines, rather than just scraping their talents and avoiding the dreaded fee of paying professionals for their work. This choice already came after their previous game, The Finals, was heavily criticised for the exact same thing, which is just a fascinating series of decisions to consider.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in the video, audio director bence pajor explains that the apparent reason for the use of ai was to avoid the "stress" of having to work around actors' availability, as they may be busy working on other projects when embark decides that a new feature needs new voice lines recorded. Pings, quests, and in-level mission briefings were thus generated using training data based on existing actors' recordings, saving the need to actually get anyone back in a studio or pay them for their time. The actors would just go crazy if they had to read all of that", which is a take that falls apart if you consider the simple fact that games of this scope (or bigger) have been managing to work around actors' availability for as long as genAI has not been an accessible technology, which has been almost all of the time that video games have existed. Citing the amount of variables that the ping system creates, Pajor claims it "becomes too impractical to record every possible version of something. Isn't it crazy that games like Disco Elysium and Baldur's Gate 3 had so, so much recorded dialogue, all without genAI? Or fellow live service shooter Apex Legends, which has been adding and adjusting voice lines via updates for years? How could they possibly have managed it?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, voice actresses jo rideout and diana gardner, who play shani and celeste respectively, are also featured speaking on their characters' relationships as well as their experience working within this hybrid model of recording and generating voices. Gardner notes that "if they only need an hour of my time for a couple call-outs that are short, then I don't have to cancel other shoots or some other project that might also be interesting. So in that way, I feel quite good about it. But I didn't know what to expect once I heard the voice come out. I was like, 'Can I take ownership for the performance?' This is hours of work that I've put in, but can I take ownership for the final product? No. " She then explains that "the contract seemed fair…so it was a no-brainer in that sense. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, strandberg goes on to elaborate on his comment on not replacing actors by saying that "we are not in the industry of replacing actors, actually, i think quite the opposite. While I can respect Garner's awareness that it means she can prioritise other projects when necessary, there is that notable tinge of regret in not being able to take ownership for her hours of work. " While Embark's audio team are indeed working on replacing the generated lines with actual performances, that doesn't change the fact that the choice to use AI in the first place was one made simply to save money in not paying actors for their specific work and get the game out the door faster — effectively the 'we'll fix it in post' of games development. We should celebrate the performance, and we should give them more space. Fundamentally, Embark has demonstrated its willingness to cut talent to cut costs, seemingly happy to post PR videos implying they had no choice due to the game's scope, and that isn't something a company just goes back on once they realise how 'efficient' it can be.

#634. Arc Raiders' latest patch adds two of the most requested features, but kills Cred hoarding

📅 16 Dec 2025

Arc Raiders' latest patch adds two of the most requested features, but kills Cred hoarding

Tanggal: 16 Dec 2025 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/arc-raiders-patch-1-7-0-skill-tree-reset-toggle-ads-all-changes

The last major Arc Raiders update of the year has arrived, bringing several big new features to the game, but not without some bad news.

Diungkapkan bahwa embark has just rolled out patch 1. 0 for Arc Raiders players everywhere. 7. This is a significant patch for the extraction shooter for a number of reasons, not least of which because it kicks off a series of events under the Cold Snap banner, which introduces a new conditions to the game’s maps.

Dig deeper into the patch notes, however, and you’ll find even more to get excited about, including features players have been asking for since the game’s first public test.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, to start with, today’s update finally adds an option toggle aiming down sights. This is especially relevant for PC players, most of whom play shooters with an ADS toggle, rather than hold. Another often requested feature has been the ability to reset the game’s skill tree.

Diungkapkan bahwa this is now available for the cost of 2,000 coins per skill point. It goes without saying that you’re going to need a whole lot of money to reset the entire thing, but it’s a useful option to have when you want to alter your path.

Berdasarkan laporan, the next change is one that’s going to ruffle a lot of feathers. Arc Raiders now has a soft Cred cap of 800. This is now clearly shown on your Wallet screen, and the developer said the cap is necessary to prevent players from using their accumulated Cred to unlock new Raider Decks immediately after release.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the good news is that this won’t affect the cred you may already have, but going forward, 800 is the most you can hold at any point. You’ll also notice that Shani has more stuff for you to buy with Cred, in case you want another way to spend what you have.

Diungkapkan bahwa patch 1. 7. 0 also brings a few other additions - and makes some changes - that are worth highlighting. You can now customise your Raider Tool, which likely means we’re going to see Raider Tool cosmetics going forward.

Berdasarkan laporan, speaking of items, the aphelion weapon blueprint has been moved to stella montis, so you won’t be able to get it from taking down the matriarch. The Bettina, and Rattler have both seen some balance changes.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the bettina’s durability will now degrade a lot slower per shot, making it take 26 magazines to fully deplete durability. The base magazine size has been increased to 22, and the reload time has been cut to 4. 5 seconds. Embark says this should make the weapon more viable in PvP, while also allowing it to stand on its own without the need for players bring a secondary weapon.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as for the rattler, the only change it gets is an increase to its magazine size from 10 to 12. The idea is to make it about as effective as a Stitcher or Kettle at close ranges when it comes to PvP encounters.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and, of course, it wouldn’t be a big arc raiders patch without some tweaks to the game’s arc enemies. This time, the Shredder gets all the love. The menacing unit now moves faster, turns more sharply and doesn’t get knocked back as much when shot.

Berdasarkan laporan, the shredder’s head now has more health, too, meaning you won’t be able to shoot it off early and confuse it. In general, the Arc unit should be smarter, especially when navigating narrow spaces. Finally, the Shredder now activates faster upon detecting (and being attacked by) players.

Diungkapkan bahwa beyond that, the main menu has seen a few changes to highlight ongoing events, make certain announcements quieter, make it easier to track raider quests and more. There’s a lot more in this update, too, such as changes to footstep loudness, several tweaks to loot and the value of certain items, and more besides. You’ll find the full change log on the official website.

#635. "There’s always a night when Rome burns": South Of Midnight director says that Xbox funding it was "unsustainable", at least in hindsight

📅 03 Nov 2026

"There’s always a night when Rome burns": South Of Midnight director says that Xbox funding it was "unsustainable", at least in hindsight

Tanggal: 03 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/theres-always-a-night-when-rome-burns-south-of-midnight-director-says-that-xbox-funding-it-was-unsustainable-at-least-in-hindsight

"I didn’t know exactly when it would be, but I was always worried about it".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, compulsion games parted ways with former owners xbox, having landed on the long list of things microsoft were determined to ditch as part of multi-round mass cuts this year. Now, South of Midnight creative director David Sears has suggested that an eventual pulling of the rug was something he feared throughout the game's development, to the point where he seemingly doesn't think he'd have funded it if he'd been in the shoes of Xbox execs.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in an interview with minnmax, sears - who left compulsion in march 2025 - outlined that ideally games big publishers put out aim to fall into one of two buckets. They either make lots of money or increase the prestige of the brand by becoming cultural touchstones across multiple generations. The likes of Double Fine's Keeper and Obsidian's Pentiment are other games which off the top of my head could be said to fit that same mold. Obviously doing both is the perfect outcome, but Sears pegged South of Midnight as being more geared towards the latter camp. The issue, of course, is that when push comes to shove, it's the games which can show a strong bottom line at any given moment which make the best case for their studios' short term survival if cash is tight.

Sebagaimana diketahui, so, south of midnight lived in a risky place, with sears recalling: "i literally told people. I was like, yeah, this could be terrible because somebody is going to say, one day, 'The money tap, we're closing those floodgates' and that's going to have really traumatic results downstream". The interviewer then asked Sears if what he was getting at is that, while he's glad Xbox funded South of Midnight, he might not have done so or at least cut the funding earlier if he was in charge of the console maker.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "yeah, probably," sears replied. There's always a night when Rome burns and I didn't know exactly when it would be, but I was always worried about it. It just seems like, in hindsight at least, it was unsustainable. So, of course, it was going to have a 'shocking' outcome. Would I have turned off someone else's money flow before South of Midnight? Yeah, because I'm not completely selfless. No doubt. Obviously, because we made it. I mean, it's easy to dissect it now, right? But at the time, I would talk to other directors and [they] would be like, 'How is this happening? I mean, how did we get so lucky? Is this a golden era?' And I would always be like, 'For now'. "I mean, I wanted to make it. ".

Notably, Sears added that in his view modern Microsoft showed a "more humane" side than the version of the company that existed in the 90s and early 2000s by giving studios like Compulsion a chance to spin out on their own rather than simply shuttering them outright once they were deemed surplus to requirements.

Given the director's no longer at Compulsion, it seems he'll not have a say on what their next game looks like, but as a newly indie studio one would imagine they'll have a keen eye on the bottom line.

Nagoshi Studio has officially shut down and its first game called Gang of Dragon is seemingly no more, months after publisher NetEase pulled funding from the Yakuza-like project.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, toshihiro nagoshi (often cited as the creator of the brilliant yakuza and like a dragon game series) opened his new studio in 2021 and announced his next game with a very familiar title almost one year ago. Now, the Tokyo-based developer has closed its doors, as confirmed in the Japanese government gazette Kanpo.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the news comes months after employees were told that the studio's future was at risk due to netease's funding cuts. Nagoshi Studio reportedly needed another £33. 1 million (about $44. 4m at the time) to get Gang of Dragon past the finish line - a paycheck NetEase purportedly didn't want to cough up.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the china-based marvel rivals and where winds meet publisher has been significantly scaling back on international investments these past few years. Visions of Mana developer Ouka Studios was shut down just after launching its gorgeous action game, Worlds Untold (a studio formed by Mass Effect veteran Mac Walters) had to pause operations to find a new partner, and Halo Infinite lead Jerry Hook's studio also ran into very similar issues last year.

Berdasarkan laporan, some developers have been a little luckier. Suda51's Grasshopper Manufacture saved itself with a management buyout and now operates as an independent developer, for one.

Berdasarkan laporan, not much is known about gang of dragon, but its debut trailer featured the violent crime and high drama you'd expect from nagoshi's previous work. Arc Raiders has delivered a big new update that's very fittingly on theme, and it's not without new mechanics.

Diungkapkan bahwa arc raiders is kicking off its last major event of the year. The Cold Snap update arrives moments from now, and it’s perhaps the game’s biggest since its momentous launch in late October. Diungkapkan bahwa as the name suggests, of course, cold snap introduces the new snowfall map condition. As part of this, maps will be covered in snow, thanks to snowstorms sweeping across them. For one, snowfall makes it harder to see enemies, but it also turns all lakes solid.

Diungkapkan bahwa you’ll earn rewards each time, and each stage completed will reveal a new scene on the banquet table. Likewise, there are cosmetic rewards as part of each stage, and you can use it as a source of Merits, too.

#639. itch.io will soon let you filter games with genAI disclosures out of your search results on the site, after admitting it was previously "critically lacking"

📅 03 Nov 2026

itch.io will soon let you filter games with genAI disclosures out of your search results on the site, after admitting it was previously "critically lacking"

Tanggal: 03 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/itchio-will-soon-let-you-filter-games-with-genai-disclosures-out-of-your-search-results-on-the-site-after-admitting-it-was-previously-critically-lacking

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, itch. io has unfortunately, much like Steam, long had an issue with genAI content being uploaded in droves, drowning out perfectly good games made by human hands. The apparent standard method against this, voluntary genAI disclosure, has been itch's primary tool to combat this wave of low-quality slop, but hasn't worked out too well; itch revealed a few days ago that 'the number of game pages being created per-day has doubled in the past two months'. Now, in attempts to further combat this, beyond just game assets requiring a genAI disclosure to upload as they have for two years, itch will be expanding the mandatory disclosure to tabletop games, books, comics, and soundtracks, as well as adding a 'no AI' filter directly into the search function.

Berdasarkan laporan, itch noted in this announcement that its previous moderation of genai use in projects had been "critically lacking", presumably referring to the unfathomable exponential increase in games being uploaded in the past few months by people who don't give a fuck about creating anything themselves and happily contribute to the death of the planet. itch went on to post "Just deleted a couple terabytes of ai slop" which, I mean, sure, cool! And, look, as many, many people in itch's replies have pointed out, this is not the same as outright banning AI.

Sebagaimana diketahui, unfortunately, my question at that point becomes: how? itch is not steam, not a storefront backed by a gigantic corporation with support staff and quality assurance (which, you know, hasn't helped steam much either). So, then, users just report the offenders, surely? This then requires a manual verification system, which, as is suggested by the sheer amount of games being uploaded every day, is just not feasible, let alone for a team as small as itch. If there is a site-wide ban on genAI, people who use genAI will just start lying and sneaking it into their projects anyway. itch is one full-time employee with several contractors and volunteers. And, frankly, I don't have a better solution here! This is fucked! What itch is doing is, currently, kinda the best it can right now?.

Diungkapkan bahwa itch is a beautiful thing that allows for people who just want to start making games, making art, making music, making books, to have a free space to share it with the world, and gain eyes on their work as well as necessary feedback to improve. It's less of a store and more of a forum for creators and self-published games to interact, guide one another to new, niche, cool shit. Hell, I made a visual novel and posted it on there, becoming another one of those millions of people for whom itch is a valuable platform for first creations. To have this vital space on a path to ruin as a result of the same vile tech that is also on the verge of pushing the global economy over a cliff due to its creators being caught in their multi-year lies is not a future I hope for itch. This is a step in the right direction, and one I genuinely hope pans out well for it in the long run.

Tanggal: 02 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/you-can-make-a-vampire-hunter-whos-afraid-of-the-dark-disease-and-small-spaces-in-hunter-the-reckoning-deathwish-and-thats-surely-the-best-way-to-play

Berdasarkan laporan, a month or two back i penned a 1500 word whine about feeling too powerful in blood of dawnwalker. A vampire hunter who screams when he wakes up with his hair over his face. Well, never let it be said that I'm biased against vampires, for I am equally keen to play an RPG in which I am the least capable vampire hunter in the universe. "Gimme a vampire sim in which I'm a pathetic vein-nibbling goblin," I wrote, using many more adjectives than that. A vampire hunter who has to spray the vampires with antibac before staking them.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, an rpg like hunter: the reckoning – deathwish, perhaps, which presents you with a choice of advantages and flaws when creating a character. You have to balance these out on a gnarly weighing scale, before they'll let you through the game's front door. Here is a video showing all that off, together with a lot of sixpacks.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the advantage/flaw system looks familiar on the surface. Advantages include Warrior, which gives you +15% chance of a critical hit, or Charmer, which gives you a +1 to Persuasion skill checks. Flaws include clumsy, bad reputation, fear of darkness, hypochondriac, and claustrophobia.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i don't know much about the tabletop game on which deathwish is based, and the video skims the detail here, but i suspect the last three flaws will boil down to something like "-1 constitution in unlit closets". Still, I really enjoy the idiocy of going up against crypt-dwelling undead while being unable to tolerate shadows, small spaces, and disease. In general, I'd love it if Hunter: The Reckoning – Deathwish steered well away from any possibility of simply overpowering the vamps, to say nothing of the werewolves and other creatures of the night.

Berdasarkan laporan, this appears to be the idea: devs teyon have stressed their desire to make something more story and investigation-driven, after the stomping gibfest that was robocop: rogue city. As narrative designer Mateusz Działowski put it in a previous dev diary, they've "switched from action with RPG elements into RPG with action elements". Amongst other things, you'll need to put together a team of fellow would-be slayers, each with secrets and traumas, and gather clues about best tactics while roaming the game's condensed and shiny New York City. You can read more about it all on Steam.

#644. Nintendo tried adding fast travel to The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, before devs realised "we were missing out on the moments of discovery"

📅 02 Nov 2026

Nintendo tried adding fast travel to The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, before devs realised "we were missing out on the moments of discovery"

Tanggal: 02 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.eurogamer.net/nintendo-fast-travel-legend-of-zelda-ocarina-of-time-remake

Sebagaimana diketahui, "i thought we needed to address this in this new version. ".

The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is being wrapped up in all kinds of modern touches for its imminent Nintendo Switch 2 remake (that owl seems to be less chatty, for starters), but there's at least one quality-of-life feature borrowed from Breath of the Wild that the developers felt was better left on the cutting room floor: fast travel.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in nintendo's latest ask the developer blog post, long-time series producer eiji aonuma explained that he initially asked the game's remakers to add warp points so players could get around hyrule without having to spam rolls and presumably make link violently ill in the process. But he and the team quickly realised fast travel doesn't work so well in a game that's still, in its bones, almost three decades old.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "in the legend of zelda: breath of the wild, there are many warp points that enable players to move quickly around the game's vast world. In the original The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, you could get around a bit faster by spamming forward roll, so I think a lot of players spent their time doggedly rolling across Hyrule Field whenever they needed to be somewhere in a hurry," Aonuma said.

Berdasarkan laporan, "i thought we needed to address this in this new version. But when we actually tried playing the game with those warp points, we realized that we were missing out on the moments of discovery that came from stopping along the way and wondering, 'Wait, what's this?' Through this development process, we were reminded once again just how important those moments are to the very structure of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. So I asked the team to add warp points that didn't exist in the original game, giving players access to shortcuts. So even though I was the one who proposed adding warp points, they just weren't working for me in the end, so I got the team to take them all back out again. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, there you have it. No fast-travel points in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time's remake, and it sounds like it's for the best. I avoided warping around Breath of the Wild's open world for the same reasons Aonuma laid out - spotting something odd way in the distance, slowly finding a way to reach it, and then discovering a funky little Korok seed was always a thrill that wouldn't have been possible by cutting out the trek in between main objectives.

Diungkapkan bahwa talking about why nintendo chose to revive ocarina of time now, aonuma said some of the younger developers on the team had maybe never played the original game 28 years ago, and remaking it could "trigger new insights that they can carry forward into future development. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, as for the remake's somewhat divisive art style, art director aya shida said the team "used phrases like 'a puppet-show feel' and 'the analog feel of practical effects films'" early on in production. "Neither puppet shows nor practical effects films reproduce reality exactly as it is. Even so, both create a convincing sense that the characters truly exist within their respective fantasy worlds," Shida continued.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the legend of zelda: ocarina of time comes out on the 5th of november. After getting some hands-on time with the revival, Lottie thought it was shaping up to be a brilliant remake.

Lord of Hatred is the second Diablo 4 expansion, and it will be available on PC, PS5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S on April 28.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it’s always a big deal when we get a new diablo expansion, especially for a game as starved of fresh (major) content as diablo 4 has been. But perhaps the biggest piece of news out of the Lord of Hatred reveal is that the expansion is bringing not one, but two new classes to the game.

Berdasarkan laporan, the first of which is the paladin, whereas the second is being kept under wraps. Even more surprising is that The Paladin is playable right now for anyone who pre-purchases the expansion. This is a well-timed shadow drop, especially given that Diablo 4’s latest season has just kicked off.

Berdasarkan laporan, the expansion adds a new region to the world: skovos, which is where the events of the new campaign will be taking place. This is the first time Skovos has been in a Diablo game. The region is of major significance to the world and lore of the series, as it is the birthplace of the firstborn, home of Lilith and Inaruis.

Sebagaimana diketahui, lord of hatred brings a decent number of major systems to diablo 4. The endgame is getting a big overhaul, headlined by the new War Plans feature. Through this, you can effectively design your own endgame grind, creating challenges based on the activities you like and earning rewards along the way.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, endgame activities now also feature their own skill trees, which can be progressed through by creating war plans for your character featuring each activity. The new endgame activity, Echoing Hatred, is something of horde mode where you must defend against unrelenting waves of enemies.

Berdasarkan laporan, none of that matters without loot, of course, and the upcoming expansion is bringing back the horadric cube, and adding set bonuses using the talisman system. The long-awaited and highly-requested Loot Filter is also coming to the game with the release of the expansion.

Berdasarkan laporan, beyond itemisation, each class’ skill tree will grow with new bonus skill variants. In fact, the entire skill system is being reworked for all classes - though details are a little sparse at the moment.

Sebagaimana diketahui, you can also expect the level cap to go up, which is very likely necessary to fit all the new skills and various systems. Blizzard offered a deep dive into the new Paladin class, which you see on the official blog.

#649. Fewer genAI clones of "someone else's specific game" should flood the net going forwards, as Anthropic tell Claude to stop messing with some stuff other people own

📅 02 Nov 2026

Fewer genAI clones of "someone else's specific game" should flood the net going forwards, as Anthropic tell Claude to stop messing with some stuff other people own

Tanggal: 02 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/fewer-genai-clones-of-someone-elses-specific-game-should-flood-the-net-going-forwards-as-anthropic-tell-claude-to-stop-messing-with-some-stuff-other-people-own

It will still let people generate "original" games using the tech.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, anthropic have told their genai tool claude to start ducking requests from users to recreate or clone existing games, following a flood of folks using the tech to generate six-fingered remakes. Instead of risking infringing on the intellectual property of series or titles that companies which aren't Anthropic own, Claude will instead restrict itself to only generating "original" games slopped together based on whatever data it's drawing on.

Diungkapkan bahwa "we added two sentences to claude code's prompt on opus 5. 5 to steer it away from recreating someone else's specific game because using Claude to infringe IP is against our usage policy," Anthropic staffer Addy Osmani wrote on not Twitter in response to a rando with a cat profile picture having spotted the change.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "original games, genre games, and games built from your own designs and assets are meant to keep working," osmani continued. In the meantime, if Claude turns down something that's yours, send it my way. "We'll continue to iterate to ensure we're striking the right balance. " Game Developer reached out to Anthropic for confirmation and were pointed to Osmani's post.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the change should make it harder to add to the horde of genai-powered decomps, recomps, and ports which have hit the net recently. It's hardly a surprising one, given studios like Bethesda have seemingly had to take matters into their own lawyers' hands to get the likes of an AI-generated Fallout game taken offline, with games that've just been ripped wholesale or barely tweaked likely on even more perilous ground. That said, not every corp's responded to the DIY decompilation craze by immediately taking legal action.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there's a serious degree of irony to anthropic slapping claude and telling it stealing is bad. One of the ways the company develop and train their genAI models is by scraping publicly available data from the internet via a web crawler.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, so, some nicking of stuff is bad, little bot people keep asking to regurgitate stuff into slop they can then try to pass off as something they've created. But not all nicking of stuff, lest our whole business be on rather shaky ground.

It's unlikely this move from Anthropic does much to convince actual developers of original games they're safe to put demos of their games out prior to release, without risking dickheads using genAI to clone said demo and potentially release a slop version in rapid fashion, but one can dream of that genie being put back in the bottle someday.

#650. European Union Cracks Down on Predatory Gaming Practices

📅 11 Nov 2026

European Union Cracks Down on Predatory Gaming Practices

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.dualshockers.com/european-union-cracks-down-on-predatory-gaming-practices/

Diungkapkan bahwa modern games have found plenty of ways to make a small purchase more complicated than it should be. You buy in-game currency instead of the item you want, spend that currency on a random reward, and sometimes end up with just enough left over to tempt another top-up.

The studio is giving Kiln, its pottery-themed multiplayer game, another shot.

Sebagaimana diketahui, now, the european commission wants to put limits on some of these practices. On November 11, it unveiled the proposed Digital Fairness Act, a set of consumer-protection rules covering loot boxes, premium currencies, subscription traps, and manipulative design, and although games aren't its only target, they're very much part of it.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, under the proposal, games could no longer sell paid loot boxes to minors. Adults would still be allowed to buy them, but publishers would have to show the possible rewards and their odds, and give players an accessible way to turn the system off.

Sebagaimana diketahui, pay-to-win and pay-to-progress mechanics would also be prohibited for minors. That second term is important because it could cover purchases that let players skip a grind, not just items that give them an advantage over someone else. Where the law draws that line will matter to publishers whose games rely on paid progression boosts.

Diungkapkan bahwa premium currencies are another target. Games would have to show what an in-game purchase costs in real money. Players shouldn't have to do the math just to find out what an item costs. Paid virtual currencies would also be switched off by default for minors unless a parent or guardian approves them.

Sebagaimana diketahui, brazil passed a law against loot boxes for children last year, but the eu proposal covers more ground. It also doesn't mean adults are about to lose access to every microtransaction.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, outside gaming, the proposal targets "dark patterns" – misleading prompts and interfaces designed to push people into choices they didn't intend to make. That includes fake urgency, confusing options, and other tricks meant to keep people spending.

Berdasarkan laporan, subscriptions would get stricter rules, too. A free trial could only become a paid subscription with explicit consent, and canceling online should be straightforward. The Commission also wants renewal reminders instead of leaving customers to discover another charge after it's happened.

Players shouldn't have to do the math just to find out what an item costs.

Diungkapkan bahwa another part deals with addictive design. The proposal also calls for clearer influencer advertising and tighter limits on personalized ads and prices aimed at minors. The Commission also highlights the difficulty of reaching a human customer-service representative. Businesses would have to let users disable certain features that encourage excessive use, such as unwanted notifications, autoplay, and streak rewards. Earlier this month, a Battlefield 6 player won a court case against EA after an unexplained ban and unsuccessful attempts to appeal. That's a separate dispute, but the frustration of getting nowhere with support will sound familiar to plenty of players.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the gaming industry has already objected. In a joint statement, Video Games Europe and the European Games Developer Federation described the proposal as 'unworkable, unjustified and disproportionate. ' They argue it could hurt European studios, particularly smaller ones, and leave players with fewer games to choose from.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the groups say the rules around in-game currencies are too broad and don't account for existing safeguards. They point to PEGI ratings, parental controls, and spending restrictions, and warn that the proposal could create more legal uncertainty. The industry groups have also suggested smaller currency top-ups and refunds for unused currency as alternatives.

Berdasarkan laporan, the definitions of pay-to-win and pay-to-progress will be worth watching. They sound straightforward until you apply them to a game where almost everything can be earned through play or bought to save time.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for now, the act is only a proposal. It still needs to go through the European Parliament and Council, where parts of it could change. No publisher is being ordered to pull loot boxes from its games today.

Diungkapkan bahwa the commission has separately proposed stronger consumer-protection enforcement, including possible fines of up to 6% of a company's worldwide annual turnover in major cross-border cases. Those powers aren't in effect either.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if the legislation passes, publishers will have to rethink at least some of their usual monetization systems in the eu. What survives the negotiations, particularly the rules for minors, will decide how big that change is.

After years of near radio silence, Fairgames has been canceled and its staff redistributed throughout Sony games.

Diungkapkan bahwa when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Berdasarkan laporan, there was some fun conversation here at pc gamer recently about the anachronistic name of the golden joystick awards, which are put on by pc gamer's publisher. Who even uses a joystick anymore? Flight sim diehards, fighting game enthusiasts, and not many others. So why is it called that? Joysticks, really?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, simply put, the name reflects the age of the awards, which debuted in 1983, making it the longest-running publicly-voted videogame awards show of all time, according to wikipedia. Back in those days, joysticks were it, and trust me, they weren't the sweet pieces of hardware we have access to now. But we loved 'em! And we used them to play games like the Golden Joysticks' first-ever game of the year, Jetpac. It was a banger!.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, here we are, 43 years later, and much has changed: from a tiny ceremony handing out five trophies, the golden joysticks have grown to become one of the biggest videogame awards events of the year, watched by millions of people around the world on just about every streaming platform you can name. Yet that name, the Golden Joystick Awards, remains. Frankly, I'm glad about that. A little bit of reliability in this world is good for everyone.

Which leads me to the point: The 44th annual Golden Joystick Awards has now concluded, and the top gong, as my UK compatriots like to say for some reason—the Ultimate Game of the Year award, for the rest of us—has gone to Resident Evil Requiem, Capcom's latest tale of zombie-fueled bad news.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, can't really argue with that call: pc gamer's elie gould gave resident evil requiem a whopping 92% score in their review, saying it "feels like you're playing a highlight reel of the best moments in the series. " Requiem claimed three other wins on the night: Console Game of the Year, Best Game Trailer, and Best Lead Performer for Angela Sant'Albano's turn as Grace Ashcroft.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, crimson desert won for pc game of the year, which surprises me a bit given that it's also on consoles and pretty much the same experience. We liked that one too: Not quite as enthusiastically, but it still earned an enviable 80% review score. "Vast and obtuse in a way that is going to frustrate some and exhilarate others," as reviewer Mollie Taylor put it: "A fascinating journey, even when the destination isn't all that. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa multiplayer hide-and-seek game meccha chameleon was the night's other big winner, taking home four awards for best multiplayer game, best indie game (self-published), the steamers' choice award, and developer's choice award. Dispatch won twice, for Best Storytelling and Best Soundtrack, and The Witcher also sort of claimed two wins as well: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered took the trophy for Best Remake/Remaster, while The Witcher 4 won for Most Wanted Game.

Berdasarkan laporan, so there you have it, 44 years down and hopefully many more to come—all of them bearing that glorious golden name. Here's your full list of 2026 Golden Joystick Awards winners:.

He covers all aspects of the industry, from new game announcements and patch notes to legal disputes, Twitch beefs, esports, and Henry Cavill. He began writing videogame news in 2007 for The Escapist and somehow managed to avoid getting fired until 2014, when he joined the storied ranks of PC Gamer. From there he graduated to the glory days of Sierra Online adventures and Microprose sims, ran a local BBS, learned how to build PCs, and developed a longstanding love of RPGs, immersive sims, and shooters. Lots of Henry Cavill.

#655. Arc Raiders gets a few map exploit fixes in latest patch as Embark prepares to slow down how often patches are released

Arc Raiders gets a few map exploit fixes in latest patch as Embark prepares to slow down how often patches are released

Tanggal: 11 Dec 2025 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/arc-raiders-1-6-0-patch-exploit-fixes-slower-cadence

There's a new Arc Raiders patch that's fairly small, but one with fixes everyone is going to appreciate.

Berdasarkan laporan, the time has arrived for another arc raiders update, and embark has certainly delivered. 6. Today’s patch, version 1. 0, is among the smallest the game has received so far, focusing almost exclusively on disabling map exploits.

Perhaps more important than the patch itself, however, is the announcement the developer made around it.

Diungkapkan bahwa starting off with patch 1. 0, it takes out a particular zipline on Stella Montis, the game’s most recent addition ot the map roster. 6. Some players used said zipline to get out of bounds, something the game has been battling on several of its maps.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, on blue gate, the patch fixes a collision issue that allowed players to vault through a wall, and fall to their death. The map fixes continue with another on Spaceport Launch Tower, which takes out a gap in collision that players have been able to shoot through.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the last change in this update affects gameplay feel around arc enemies. Certain materials in the game’s world weren’t blocking their vision - or fire - when they should have, and this has now been fixed.

Diungkapkan bahwa alongside today’s patch, embark also announced that going forward, we’re going to see fewer patches for arc raiders. The game has been getting updates almost every Thursday since it launched in late October.

Berdasarkan laporan, now that most of the major problems have been fixed, the studio is shifting to a slower patching cadence. Critical fixes will still be issued as soon as they’re developed, but don’t expect a patch each week going forward.

Diungkapkan bahwa embark also revealed that patch releases and in-game store rotations will now occur on tuesdays. You should also expect the next few weeks to be quiet, as members of the team go on holiday breaks.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but, before everyone goes away, the game is going to get one more big update. The last item on Arc Raiders’ roadmap, revealed in early November, is the Cold Snap event. This is on track for Tuesday, bringing some new content alongside a few other fixes.

#656. Delve into "a deep underground facility full of secrets and horrors" in the latest Fallout 4 quest mod from the Commonwealth Story Expansion Project

📅 02 Nov 2026

Delve into "a deep underground facility full of secrets and horrors" in the latest Fallout 4 quest mod from the Commonwealth Story Expansion Project

Tanggal: 02 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/delve-into-a-deep-underground-facility-full-of-secrets-and-horrors-in-the-latest-fallout-4-quest-mod-from-the-commonwealth-story-expansion-project

A mysterious bunker with out of this world contents.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, after adding a whole new town to fallout 4 last month, a group of modders have released another in their long string of extra quests for the rpg. This latest mission revolves around a dungeon delve in the Glowing Sea, where a mysterious bunker's just been unearthed.

"The harsh radioactive winds of the Glowing Sea have uncovered a deep underground facility full of secrets and horrors," the group behind the Commonwealth Story Expansion Project (CSEP) declared the description of this latest work, Under The Stars.

Berdasarkan laporan, a fresh dungeon with a quest attached, the mod tasks you with donning your hazmat suit for a trip to a sunken bunker in the region of post-apocalyptic boston with the least chill weather. Inside await voiced holotapes and puzzles offering clues as to what went down in this cosy corner of the Commonwealth, plus some new gear to make braving whatever lurks within worth it.

Spoilers: Judging by the screenshots, it looks like the place is an Area 51-esque hidey-hole for evidence of aliens and other cryptic oddities.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you're unfamiliar, the csep lot are responsible for a bunch of popular fallout 4 quest mods based around the likes of deadly cults, underground wars, post-apocalyptic detective work, and brotherhood of steel drama. While Under The Stars doesn't look have been as big an undertaking as those, that previous form points to it being an expertly-crafted addition that'll slot seamlessly into the game.

Berdasarkan laporan, the modders have put under the stars together as part of a community-hosted modding jam called fallout flood, with this latest one based around the theme of being underground. Among the other works to have come out of it thus far are another Fallout 4 quest mod dubbed Stranded - The Oasis, a dungeon full of funky rats called the S'Laven, and a new robot enemy you can wear as a hat. It's also produced a New Vegas quest mod about exploring an abandoned NCR railway, so seems to have been very productive gathering of modding minds.

To give Under The Stars a go, your copy of Fallout 4 will need to have the Automatron and Vault-Tec Workshop DLCs.

#658. Battlefield 6's latest update dubbed the game's simultaneously best and worst patch as it runs into all kinds of issues

📅 10 Dec 2025

Battlefield 6's latest update dubbed the game's simultaneously best and worst patch as it runs into all kinds of issues

Tanggal: 10 Dec 2025 | Sumber: https://www.vg247.com/battlefield-6-1-1-3-0-patch-problems-everywhere

What's likely going to be the last major Battlefield 6 update of the year has launched with a number of unexpected issues.

Diungkapkan bahwa there’s been a lot of anticipation for battlefield 6’s version 1. 1. 0 patch. The patch kicks off the third and final phase of the game’s first season, adding some new holiday-themed content. 3. More the new content itself, the update’s biggest additions are almost entirely gameplay-related.

Sebagaimana diketahui, unfortunately, for as much as the changes in 1. 1. 3. 0 have been well received, the launch has been marred by a series of technical issues, some of which are a little unusual.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, immediately after patch 1. 1. 3. 0 went live, players on PC started reporting massive stutters that would occur every few seconds. The issue is especially pronounced in Redsec Battle Royale, but much deadlier in traditional multiplayer.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, battlefield studios quickly acknowledged it, pointing out a workaround that appears to be working for players on steam. According to those players, going offline on Steam’s friends menu has fixed stuttering for them.

The issue remains for other players on PC, however, and the developer said it’s working on a proper fix.

Sebagaimana diketahui, perhaps the most disrupting problem the patch has caused is one that prevents players from being able to interact with the game’s menu. Tiles become unresponsive, or outright unselectable when you try to hover near them.

Diungkapkan bahwa ironically, the top set of tiles designed to make it easy for players to quickly jump into the new content has been the most affected. Restarting the game sometimes fixes the issue, and some players report that it only happens upon first launch after installing the update.

Berdasarkan laporan, but battlefield studios later clarified that, unsurprisingly, there’s an actual reason behind the bug. Once again, a fix is being investigated, and the developer will offer an update once some progress has been made.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a little further down the list of importance is an issue that stops players from being able to skip tiers within the new winter offensive bonus path in the game’s battle pass. BF Studios took out the feature entirely while it works on a fix, so while you can continue making progress in the bonus path, you won’t be able to skip tiers.

Diungkapkan bahwa this is all a shame to see. Outside of all the problems, the meat of the new update has been almost universally praised. The visibility improvements, and netcode updates have been celebrated. Many players were also happy to see meaningful updates to footstep audio and overall clarity.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it’s also unusual for a battlefield 6 patch to run into so many issues at launch. 3. 1. 0 so far is that it’s the game’s best and worst update yet. The sentiment around 1. Hopefully those issues will be fixed before the development team breaks for the holidays.
